srog dang*/ skye ba po dang*/ gso ba dang*/ gang zag dang*/ shed las skyes dang*/ shed bu la sogs pa gang zag gi bdag ni dpyad na bden par grub pa med pas yod pa'i mtha' las grol la/ bdag med pa'i phung po la sogs pa ni snang tsam du yod pa'am/ chos nyid yongs su grub pa ni mi 'gyur bar yod pas med pa'i mtha' las grol ba nyid do// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po/ dbye ba mdor bstan ni/ yang phung po la sogs pa rnams la rab tu dbye ba rnam pa bzhi ste/ chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin gyis rab tu dbye ba dang*/ de dag gi rnam pa'am khyad par gyis rab tu dbye ba dang*/ gang zag so so'i lus kyis rab tu dbye ba dang*/ skad cig so so'i rgyun gyis rab tu dbye ba'o// gnyis pa/ ngo bo rgyas bshad la/ mtshan nyid kyis rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ dbye gzhi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams rang gi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba/ gzugs rung mtshan (358) nyid can ni gzugs// zhes pa la sogs pa tha dad pa nyid kyis mtshan gzhi chos sum cu rtsa lngar rab tu dbye ba bshad zin par gyur pa'o// rnam pas rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ dbye gzhi phung po dang khams dang skye mched de dag nyid kyi 'byed tshul ming sogs la ltos med du grub pa'i cha nas rdzas su yod pa dang*/ brda sbyar ba la ltos nas btags pa'i yod pa dang*/ tha snyad kun rdzob tu yod pa dang*/ dpyad na don dam par yod pa dang*/ dngos po dang btags pa'i sgo nas gzugs can dang*/ de las ldog pa gzugs can ma yin pa dang*/ mig yul du bstan du yod pa dang*/ ldog pa bstan du med pa dang*/ de dag la sogs pa sngar ji skad bstan pa rnams so// lus kyis rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ khams gsum gyi sems can rnams kyi lus mi 'dra ba tha dad pa ji snyed pa phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched rnams kyang de snyed de/ gzugs can gnyis na phung po lnga ci rigs par yod pa dang*/

gzugs med na ming bzhi tsam yod pa la sogs pa nyid do// rgyun gyis rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ sems can re re'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i lus gcig la'ang phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched 'dus byas rnams kyi skad cig snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma re re zhing 'byung bas so so tha dad pa'o// shes pa'i phan yon ni/ mtshan nyid kyis rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pas ci zhig yongs su shes zhe na/ 'di rnams kyi rgyu shes pa las 'bras bu spong ba 'byung bas de'i ming gis brjod pa de'o// chos gsum so so'i mtshan nyid shes pas de dang mi mthun pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bdag la mngon par zhen pa ni 'khrul par yongs su shes so// shes nas spong ngo*// de bzhin tu sbyar te rnam pa'i rab tu dbye ba la (359) mkhas pas ci zhig yongs su shes zhe na/ khyad par rnam pa du mar shes pas ril po gcig tu 'dzin pa'i 'du shes ni 'khrul par yongs su shes so// lus kyi rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pas ci zhig yongs su shes zhe na/ lus tha dad rnams rang gi las tha dad las byung bar shes pas/ las ma byas pa'i 'bras bu dang phrad pa dang*/ las byas pa'i 'bras bu'i rgyun gzhan la smin nas chud za bar 'dod pa'i 'du shes ni 'khrul par yongs su shes so// rgyun gyis rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pas ci zhig shes zhe na/ 'dus byas rnams skad cig gis skye 'gag byed par shes pas/ rtag cing brtan par 'dzin pa'i 'du shes ni 'khrul par yongs su shes so// gsum pa la/ gnyis las/ mdor bstan ni/ yang dbye gzhi phung po dang khams dang skye mched 'di dag nyid kyi grangs kyi rab tu dbye ba rnam pa drug ste/ ming gis dbye ba ni/ 'dod yon la phyi rol du bltas pas rab tu dbye ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la nang du bltas pas rab tu dbye ba dang*/ mtha' med pa rgyun ring po'i dus kyis rab tu dbye ba dang*/ mtha' yod pa dus yongs su chad pas rab tu dbye ba dang*/

yun thung bas de'i dus kyis rab tu dbye ba dang*/ gzhan snang du kun tu ston pas rab tu dbye ba'o// rgyas bshad la/ phyi rol tu bltas pas rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ phal cher te bstan pa la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa ma gtogs pa 'dod pa'i khams na spyod pas rab tu dbye ba'i chos gsum rnams te 'dod yon la sred pa mi bzad pa las byung bar gyur pa'o// nang du bltas pas rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sa pa bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i zag bcas zag med thams cad dang*/ 'dod par yang bstan pa la thos bsam sgom gsum byed (360) pas bsdus pa rnams te snyoms 'jug la nang du bltas pa nyid do// rgyun ring po'i dus kyis rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi chos gsum ste sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' thug pa med par gyur pa'o// dus yongs su chad pas rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ 'phags pa slob pa srid pa lan bdun pa la sogs pa'i chos thams cad dang*/ mi slob pa rnams kyi'ang tha ma'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams ma gtogs pa ste/ bdun dang gcig la sogs pa dus nges pa can du gyur pa'o// de'i dus kyis rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ mi slob pa rnams kyi tha ma lhag med du mya ngan las 'da' kha ma'i skad cig gis bsdus pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched ni de'i dus tsam kho na yin gyi skad cig gnyis pa nas rgyun 'chad 'gyur pa rnams so// kun tu ston pas rab tu dbye ba gang zhe na/ gang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad pa la sogs pa thob cing yon tan dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa rnams kyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag ni las dang nyon mongs pa las grub pa med kyang*/ smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis gdul bya la phan gdags pa'i phyir snang tsam du kun tu ston pa'o// bcu pa la/ bsdus pa gang zhe na/

thun mong gi dbye ba/ so so'i dbye ba/ mkhas pa'i phan yon gsum las dang po ni/ bsdus pa'i tshul ni rnam pa bcu gcig tu blta ste/ de'ang mtshan nyid kyis mtshan gzhi bsdus pa dang*/ rgyu khams kyis 'bras bu bsdus pa dang*/ spyi rigs kyis bye brag bsdus pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyis gnas skabs can bsdus pa dang*/ grogs kyis grogs can bsdus pa dang*/ phyogs kyis phyogs can bsdus pa dang*/ dus kyis dus (361) can bsdus pa dang*/ phyogs gcig gis phyogs gcig bsdus pa dang*/ mtha' dag gis mtha' dag bsdus pa dang*/ chos gsum gcig gis gcig phan tshun bsdus pa dang*/ chos nyid don dam pas chos can bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa la/ bcu gcig gi dang po/ mtshan nyid kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ thams cad kyang sdus byed gang gis bsdu bya gang zhig ji ltar bsdus tshul gyis rig par bya ste/ 'dir yang sdud byed phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams kyi so so'i rang gi mtshan nyid gzugs su rung ba la sogs pa mi 'dra ba gang yin pa de dag nyid kyis bsdu bya rgyud gzhan dang gzhan du gtogs pa'i gzugs la sogs pa de dag sdud tshul don byed nus pas dngos po rnams bsdus pa ltar mtshan nyid kyis mtshan gzhi bsdus par blta'o// de bzhin du sbyar te/ 1$0000220gnyis pa/ 1$0000270khams kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ sdud byed phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams kyi sa bon kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa des/ bsdu bya chos gsum po de dag sdud tshul gyi sa bon kun gzhi la yod pa'i phyir khams kyis 'bras bu rnams bsdus pa'o// gsum pa/ rigs kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams bem rig la sogs pa'i sgo nas so so rang gi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba tha dad pa yod kyang du ma spungs pas na phung po'i don btsan par byas nas tshor ba la sogs pa thams cad kyang phung po zhes gcig tu bsdus shing*/

de bzhin du nyer spyod 'dzin pas na khams kyi don btsan par byas nas mig la sogs pa thams cad khams zhes gcig tu bsdus pa dang*/ nyer spyad skye ba'i sgo byed pas na skye mched kyi don btsan par byas nas mig la sogs pa thams cad skye mched gcig tu bsdus pa ste/ thams cad phan tshun khyad par mi (362) 'dra bar gnas kyang*/ spyi rigs kyis bsdus pa gcig go /bzhi pa/ gnas skabs kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya bde ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po khams dang skye mched rnams ni mang po yod kyang sdud byed bde ba'i gnas skabs de dag nyid kyis bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi chos gsum zhes gcig tu bsdus pa'o// de bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi gnas skabs kyi chos dang*/ sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i gnas skabs kyi chos gsum rnams kyang sdug bsngal dang btang snyoms de dag nyid kyis bsdus pa'o// lnga pa/ grogs kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya gzugs kyi phung po 'khor dang bcas pa ste ma lus pa ni sdud byed de las gzhan pa'i phung po grogs su gyur pa tshor ba la sogs pa rnams kyis sdud tshul thams cad kyang grogs dang lhan cig phung po lnga zhes grogs kyis bsdus pas grogs can bsdus pa'o// de bzhin du de las gzhan pa tshor ba'i phung po'ang grogs lhag ma rnams dang lhan cig phung po lnga zhes bsdus pa la sogs pa dang*/ mig gi khams 'khor dang bcas pa ni de las gzhan pa'i khams grogs su gyur pa rnams dang lhan cig khams bco brgyad ces bsdus pa la sogs pa dang*/ chos kyi skye mched 'khor dang bcas pa ni de las gzhan pa'i grogs su gyur pa rnams dang lhan cig skye mched bcu gnyis zhes bsdus pa la sogs pa rnams la yang so sor dpyad de rig par bya'o// drug pa/ phyogs kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya shar phyogs kyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched gang yin pa de rnams mang po yod kyang sdud byed shar phyogs de dag nyid kyis bsdus tshul yul mtshungs pa'i phyir shar phyogs kyi chos gsum zhes phyogs kyis phyogs can tha dad med par bsdus pa'o// de bzhin du de las gzhan pa'i

(363) phyogs lhag ma dgu po rnams la yang rig par bya ste lho phyogs kyi chos gsum zhes pa la sogs pa'o// bdun pa dus kyis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya 'das pa'i dus kyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams ni/ sdud byed 'das pa'i de dag nyid kyis/ bsdus tshul dus mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'das pa'i chos gsum zhes dus dang dus can tha dad med par bsdus pa'o// de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i chos gsum dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i chos gsum rnams kyang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba de dag nyid kyis bsdus pa'o// brgyad pa phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos mdo gzhan las ming tha dad du bstan pa ji snyed pa de dag sdud byed 'dir bstan pa'i chos gsum po'i nang tshan gang yang rung bas bsdus pa ni phyogs gcig gis bsdus par rig par bya ste/ tshul khrims kyi phung po ni gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung po'ang 'du byed kyi phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa dang*/ 'dod pa dang gnod sems dang rnam 'tshe'i khams ni sems byung yin pas chos kyi khams kyi phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa dang*/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi skye mched la sogs pa bzhi ni sems sems byung gi ngo bo yin pas yid dang skye mched kyi phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa la sogs pa'o// dgu pa mtha' dag gis bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos mdo gzhan du ming mi 'dra bar bstan pa ji snyed pa de dag dang*/ sdud byed 'dir ma bstan pa'i phung po la sogs pas ma lus par bsdus pa ni mtha' dag gis bsdus par rig par bya ste/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po ni nyer len gyi phung po lnga car gyis bsdus pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i khams ni khams (364)

bco brgyad po thams cad kyis bsdus pa dang*/ 'du shes med pa'i sems can gyi skye mched ni dri ro bor ba'i skye mched bcus bsdus kyang gang de na yod pa'i skye mched ma lus pa bsdus pa'o// bcu pa gcig gis gcig bsdus pa gang zhe na/ chos gsum po re res kyang gzhan gnyis po bsdus shing*/ gzhan gnyis kyis kyang re re bsdus pas phan tshun gyis bsdus tshul rim pa ltar ston pa ste/ de la phung po lngas gzhan gnyis po bsdus tshul zhes pa la sogs par yang sbyar du rung mod/ 'on kyang don gcig pa nyid kyi phyir sngar ji ltar grags pa bzhin 'chad pa la bzhi'i/ dang po phung po lnga gzhan gnyis pos bsdus tshul ni/ gzugs kyi phung po khams du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ de ni dbang po lnga dang yul lnga ste gzugs can gyi khams bcu dang*/ de bzhin du gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu po thams cad dang*/ khams gcig dang skye mched gcig ni chos kyi ste de dag gi phyogs gcig gzugs rnam pa lnga po dag gis kyang bsdus so// tshor ba'i phung po khams du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ chos kyi khams gcig dang skye mched gcig la chos bcu drug yod pa dag gi phyogs gcig tshor ba nyid kyis bsdus so// tshor ba'i phung po ji lta bar/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang 'du byed kyi phung po yang de bzhin du/ chos bcu drug gi ya gyal re res bsdus pa yin no// rnam par shes pa'i phung po khams du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ sems kyi khams bdun dang*/ yid kyi skye mched gcig gis bsdus so// gnyis pa khams bco brgyad gzhan gnyis pos bsdus tshul la/ mig gi khams phung po du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs gcig mig gi dbang po dang mig gi skye mched gcig gis bsdus so// mig gi khams

(365) ji lta bar rna ba'i khams dang sna'i khams dang lce'i khams dang lus kyi khams kyang de bzhin du gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs re dang rang rang gi skye mched re res bsdus pa yin no// gzugs kyi khams phung po du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs gcig yul lnga'i dang po dang gzugs kyi skye mched gcig gis bsdus pa'o// gzugs kyi khams ji lta bar sgra'i khams dang dri'i khams dang ro'i khams dang reg bya'i khams kyang de bzhin du gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs re dang rang rang gi skye mched re res bsdus pa yin no// mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams phung po du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po'i phyogs gcig dang yid kyi skye mched kyi phyogs gcig gis bsdus so// mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams ji lta bar rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang de bzhin te rnam shes phung po dang yid kyi skye mched kyi phyogs res bsdus pa yin no// 'dis ni yid kyi khams kyang bshad pa yin te rnam shes phung po dang yid kyi skye mched phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir ro// chos kyi khams phung po du dang skye mched du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed de phung po gsum dang gcig gzugs kyi phyogs gcig gzugs rnam pa lnga dang*/ chos kyi skye mched gcig gis bsdus so// gsum pa skye mched rnams gzhan gnyis pos bsdus tshul la/ mig gi skye mched phung po du dang khams du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs gcig mig gi dbang po dang mig gi khams gcig gis bsdus so// mig gi skye mched ji lta bar rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus kyi skye mched rnams dang*/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya'i skye mched rnams

(366) kyang de bzhin te/ gzugs kyi phung po'i phyogs re dang rang rang gi khams re res bsdus pa yin no// yid kyi skye mched phung po du dang khams du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po gcig dang sems kyi khams bdun gyis bsdus so// chos kyi skye mched phung po du dang khams du dag gis bsdus zhe na/ snga ma ltar phung po gsum dang*/ gcig gzugs kyi phyogs gcig dang chos kyi khams gcig gis bsdus so// bzhi pa rigs gzhan yang chos gsum du bsdu ba ni/ chos gsum phan tshun bsdus pa de bzhin du sngar bshad pa'i gzugs sogs de las ming gzhan pa'i chos mdo gzhan las chos kyi phung po la sogs pa phung po bstan pa dang*/ khams mang po pa'i mdor/ 'byung bzhi la sogs pa'i khams drug cu rtsa gnyis bstan pa dang*/ yid dang chos su 'du ba'i zad par dang zil gnon la sogs pa skye mched bstan pa gang yin pa dag dang*/ gzhan yang gang dag ming chos gsum po de bzhin du ma bstan pa 'di lta ste/ don la rdzas su yod pa dang*/ ming du btags pa'i yod pa dang*/ kun rdzob tsam du yod pa dang*/ don dam du bden par yod pa dang*/ shes pa tsam gyis shes par bya ba dang*/ mngon par shes pas shes par bya ba dang*/ gzugs can du grub pa dang*/ gzugs can ma yin pa dang*/ gzhan la bstan du yod pa dang*/ bstan du med pa la sogs pa de dag kyang*/ 'dir bstan pa'i phung dang khams dang skye mched rnams kyis bsdus par mtshan nyid ji ltar mthun mthun du dpyad pa las rig par bya ste de rnams ni sngar rnam pa'i rab tu dbye ba rgyas par bstan zin pa nyid do// bcu gcig pa don dam pas bsdus pa gang zhe na/ bsdu bya gang phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams sdud byed de rnams kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyis bsdus tshul/ de'i spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa dang*// yon tan mthar thug khyab pa ste// gzugs kyi dbye ba dman pa dang*// bar ma mchog la nam mkha'

(367) bzhin// zhes pa ltar chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' ltar kun tu 'gro ba'i tshul gyis chos thams cad la khyab pas na chos nyid kyis chos can bsdus pa nyid do// yang*/ gzhi gnas 'ching ba don mthun dang*// nyer 'dzin mi 'phro mngon sdud bsdus// zhes 'grel par/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa dang mthun pa'i bsdus pa rnam pa drug kyang gsungs te/ gling gis mi rnams bsdus pa ltar/ mig gis mig shes bsdus pa ni gzhi'i gnas kyis bsdus pa dang*/ thag pas shing khur bcings pa ltar/ lus kyis mig sogs bcings pa ni 'ching bas bsdus pa dang*/ dgos pa mthun pa'i mi rnams phan tshun brten pa ltar/ mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung rnams gcig la gcig brten pa ni don mthun pas bsdus pa dang*/ rje bos bran la sogs pa bzung ba ltar/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pas yul yongs su bzung ba ni yul nye bar 'dzin pas bsdus pa dang*/ bum pas chu bzung ba ltar/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sems sems byung bzung ba ni rnam par mi 'phro bas bsdus pa dang*/ rgya mtshos 'bab chu rnams bsdus pa ltar/ gzugs kyi phung pos mig la sogs pa bsdus pa ni mngon par bsdus pas bsdus pa'o// rgya cher ni/ rang gis dpyad pa las shes pa'o// de bzhin gzhan yang ji rigs par// phung po skye mched khams rnams ni// rang gi mtshan nyid legs dpyad de// ji skad bshad par bsdu bar bya// zhes pa ltar ro// phan yon la/ de ltar bsdus pa la mkhas pas phan yon ci zhig 'thob ce na/ chos gsum phan tshun 'du ba'i tshul shes na gcig la dmigs pas thams cad la dmigs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa la sems mngon par sdud ba'i phan yon 'thob ste/ thub pa dgongs rgyan du/ dbang po rnon pos khams bco brgyad dang*/ 'bring pos (368) skye mched bcu gnyis dang*/ rtul pos dbang po lnga la dmigs nas zhi gnas skyed par yang gsungs shing*/

ji lta ji ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa la sems mngon par sdud cing mnyam par 'jog pa de lta de ltar dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ de la brten nas chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i lhag mthong la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par can gong nas gong du mngon par 'phel lo// dge ba 'phel ba las ni byang chub thob pa la sogs pa'o// bcu gcig pa/ mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ snga ma ltar dbye ba/ ngo bo/ phan yon gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos gsum gyis mtshungs par ldan pa'i tshul rnam pa drug du blta ste/ yang yul gyi sgo nas gzugs can chung ngu tha dad med pas mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ bar ma 'dres par gyur pas mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ chen po phrad pas mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ dus kyi sgo nas lhan cig 'byung bas mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas bya ba bsgrub pas mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas mthun par rtogs pas mtshungs par ldan pa'o// gnyis pa la/ drug gi dang po tha dad med pas mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ rdul phra rab kyi phyogs sam yul la/ rdul phra rab gcig tu gtogs pa'i phyogs can gzugs dang dri ro la sogs pa ji ltar srid pa rnams thams cad phyogs sam yul mthun pa'i phyir tshogs pa tha dad med par gyur pa'o// gnyis pa 'dres pas mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ rdul phra rab gnyis yan chad 'dus pa phyogs can 'byung ba dang 'byung gyur gang yin pa rnams phan tshun 'dres par gyur pa ste/ chu rnyog ma can gyi nang du chu dang sa'i rdul phran 'dres pa lta bu'o// gsum pa phrad pas mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ phyogs can 'dus pa'i rags pa rnams nyid phan (369) tshun phrad par gyur ba ste/ pha gu rnams phrad pa las rtsig pa grub pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa lhan cig 'byung bas mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ sems can re re'i lus gcig gis bsdus pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched skad cig ma gang yin pa rnams dus mnyam du lhan cig 'byung bas 'khod pa ste/

dang por skye ba dus gcig pa dang bar du gnas pa'i ngang gcig pa dang mthar 'gag pa'i dus gcig pa rnams so// lnga pa bya ba bsgrubs pas mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ dgos pa gcig la zhugs pa rnams bya ba mthun par sgrub pa yin la/ de'ang 'di lta ste/ dge slong gnyis ltung ba phyir bcos pa la sogs pa'i rtsod pa'am gzhi gang yang rung ba la phan tshun mtshungs par zhugs nas/ gtan la 'bebs pa'am ltung ba bshags pa la sogs pa'i bya ba bsgrubs pa lta bu'o// drug pa mthun par rtogs pas mtshungs par ldan pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo/ khyad par/ dbye ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbang po gnyis po la brten pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams/ dmigs pa'i yul gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa mthun par rtogs pa'o// gnyis pa khyad par ni/ mthun par rtogs pas mtshungs par ldan pa de yang*/ gtso bor gyur pa'i sems de nyid 'khor sems byung tshor ba la sogs pa gzhan gyi dngos po dang mtshungs par ldan pa yin gyi/ sems nyid sems dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ tshor ba nyid tshor ba dang mtshungs ldan mi rung bas bdag gi dngos po dang ni mtshungs par ldan pa ma yin te/ des ni sems dang sems byung tha dad du bstan zhing*/ rdzas rigs 'dra grangs mnyam pas na rdzas mtshungs pa yang yin no// de bzhin du dge ba'i sems dang sems byung lta bu dmigs rnam dang ngo bo mthun pa gnyis kyi mtshungs par ldan pa yin gyi/ 'dod (370) chags dang zhe sdang lta bu'am dge ba dang mi dge ba lta bu mi mthun pa gnyis mtshungs par ldan pa ni ma yin no// da ltar ba'i sems sems byung lta bu dus mnyam zhing 'dra ba gnyis mtshungs par ldan pa yin gyi/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa lta bu dus mi 'dra ba gnyis mtshungs par ldan pa ni ma yin no// 'dod pa'i sems sems byung lta bu mthun pa'i khams dang sa pa gnyis mtshungs par ldan pa yin gyi/ 'dod khams dang gzugs khams sam/

bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa lta bu mi mthun pa'i khams dang sa pa gnyis ni mtshungs par ldan pa ma yin no// gsum pa dbye ba la bcu yod kyang sde tshan bzhi ste/ kun 'gro dang res 'ga'i mtshungs ldan/ gnas skabs dang rgyun gyi mtshungs ldan/ phyir bltas dang nang bltas kyi mtshungs ldan/ 'dris pa dang ma 'dris pa'i mtshungs ldan no// dang po la spyir mtshungs par ldan pa kun tu 'gro ba ni 'di lta ste/ 'khor sems las byung ba tshor ba dang 'du shes dang sems pa dang reg pa dang yid la byed pa ste kun 'gro lnga dang*/ gtso bor gyur pa'i sems rnam par shes pa rnams so// zhes pa ste/ khams dang sa dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'di dag las gang rung gcig yod par thams cad 'gro zhing med na thams cad med pa'i phyir ro// yang khyad par mtshungs par ldan pa kun tu 'gro ba nyon mongs pa can ni/ gtso bo nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang*/ 'khor bdag tu lta ba la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa bzhi po rnams so// zhes pa ste/ so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs thams cad na yod pa'i phyir ro// res 'ga' mtshungs par ldan pa ni 'di lta ste/ gtso bo sems rnam shes tshogs drug la 'khor sems las byung ba res 'ga' dad pa la sogs pa dge ba rnams dang mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ res 'ga' 'dod chags la (371) sogs pa rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang*/ khro ba la sogs pa nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa rnams so// gnas skabs las kyang gyur pa'i mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ bde ba'i tshor ba mtshungs par ldan pa dang bcas pa rgyud la skyes pa'i gnas skabs na bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi mtshungs par ldan pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dang*/ sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa btang snyoms pa'i tshor ba mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa rgyud la skye ba'i gnas skabs na yang de bzhin no// rgyun mi 'chad par mtshungs par ldan pa ni/

dbang po dang bcas pa'i lus tshogs bdun la sogs pa'i sems dang bcas pa'i dus na kun 'gro lnga la sogs pa rgyun du byung ba'o// rgyun chad pa'i mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ 'gog pa la sogs pa'i sems med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pas bar du chod pa'i phyi nas slar yang sems dang sems byung skyes par gyur pa'o// phyi rol tu bltas pas mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ 'dod pa'i khams dang rab tu ldan pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba 'dod yon la sred pa'i dbang gis byung ba rnams te/ de dag las phal cher zhes pa'ang thar pa la dmigs pa'i shes rab gsum ma gtogs pa'o// nang du bltas pas mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa la mnyam par gzhag pa'i sa pa rnams dang snga ma ltar shes rab rnam pa gsum dang*/ zag med kyi sems dang sems las byung ba ting nge 'dzin dang thar pa la dmigs pa rnams so// phal cher ro zhes 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba ni rgya dpe dang gzhung gzhan la med cing gong gi rnam gzhag dang yang mi mthun pas bzhag go /'dres pa'i mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ khams gsum gyi so so'i skye bo rnams

(372) kyi sems dang sems las byung ba 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rgyud la 'dris pa rnams dang*/ 'phags pa slob pa rnams kyi sems sems byung dge ba zag bcas dang mi dge ba lung ma bstan gyis bsdus pa rnams dang*/ mi slob pa'i sems sems byung de dag las kyang kha cig ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gyis bsdus pa yun ring du 'dris shing myangs par gyur pa dag go /sngar ni slob mi slob du 'jog pa'i chos kyi dbang du byas nas dge ba kho na bshad pa ste/ 'dir ni rgyud la yod pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// ma 'dris pas mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ zag med 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba rnams te/ de rnams kyi skad cig dang por byung ba dang*/ de'i 'og ma skad cig gnyis pa phan chad du byung ba rnams dang*/ zhes smos pa ni gnyis pa la sogs pa 'dris par 'dogs pa spang ba'i ched du yin la/ de dag dang mnyam gzhag 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rjes la thob pa de bzhin nyid du snang ba rnams kyi sems dang sems las byung ba'ang sngon 'jig rten du skye ma myangs pas ma 'dres pa'o// gsum pa phan yon ni/ mtshungs par ldan pa la mkhas pas phan yon ci zhig 'thob ce na/ gtso bo sems chos tsam bdag med pa la 'khor sems byung tshor ba la sogs pa kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges pa lnga dang rtsa ba dang nye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa rnams dang*/ dad pa la sogs pa rnam par byang ba'i chos rnams kyi mtshungs par ldan pa dang ldan pa ma yin pa'i tshul legs par shes so// tshor ba tsam gyis tshor bar byed pa la sogs pa de shes na/ 'ga' zhig bdag yod la des tshor bar byed do// 'du shes su byed do// sems par byed do// dran par byed do// kun nas nyon mongs so// rnam par byang ngo*// zhes thams cad kyi byed (373) pa po bdag tu mngon par zhen pa spang zhing*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bdag med pa la rim gyis 'jug go

/bdag med rtogs pa las ni rnam grol thob pa la sogs pa'o// bcu gnyis pa ldan pa la spyi don lnga ste/ ldan pa'i ngo bo ngos bzung*/ gang la ldan pa'i gang zag ldan chos nges par bya ba/ ldan pa'i rab tu dbye ba/ ji ltar ldan tshul brtsi ba'o// dang po ngo bo la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs kyis/ thob dang ma thob rang rgyud du// gtogs pa rnams kyi 'gog gnyis kyi'ang*// dus gsum pa yi rnam pa gsum// dge la sogs kyi dge la sogs// zhes thob pa rdzas grub rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i chos stobs ldan 'gog pa gnyis la'ang yod pa/ chos de ma skyes pa dang 'gags pa na yod pas dus gsum du grub pa/ chos de dang de'i thob pa dang*/ thob pa'i thob pa ste gsum du yod cing*/ thob pas chos de dang thob pa'i thob pa dag ldan par byed la/ thob pa'i thob pas ni thob pa kho na dang ldan par 'gyur ba/ dge ba'i thob pa'ang dge ba nyid yin pa la sogs par 'dod mod/ de ni mdzod kyi 'grel ṭīka tu/ de ltar thob pa thug pa med par 'gyur bas/ thob pa'i dga' ston chen po ste/ stes te thogs pa med pas go skabs rnyed kyi/ gzhan du na sems can gnyis pa'i thob pas ni nam mkha' la'ang go skabs med par 'gyur ro// zhes pa la sogs pa bkag cing*/ bsdu bar yang*/ thob pa rdzas su yod pa de chos rnams skyed pa'i rgyu'am/ skyes pa mi 'bral ba'i rgyur 'dod/ dang po ltar na/ chos de ma skyes pa na/ de'i thob pa'ang med pas nam yang mi skye bar 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na/ chos dge mi dge lung ma bstan kyi thob pa dus mnyam nus ldan du yod pa na/ dge mi dge mi mthun pa dus mnyam du yod par 'gyur bas/ 'gal ba'i chos rnams (374) dus gcig tu gnas par 'gyur ro// zhes pas bkag go /des na 'dir ni sngar bshad pa ltar chos rnams kyi 'phel 'grib la thob pa'am ldan pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa gang zag ni/

khams kyi rab tu dbye bar 'chad pa ltar/ khams gsum gyi so so'i skye bo gsum dang*/ 'phags pa slob pa gsum dang*/ mi slob pa gsum ste dgu la brtsi zhing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyi byis pa la rang khams las 'dod chags dang ma bral ba dang*/ gnon pa chags bral rdzogs te gong ma'i sems thob pa gnyis gnyis su phye na bcu gcig tu'ang 'gyur ro// gsum pa ldan chos la/ mdzod du/ 'dod yid dge dang mi dge dang*// bsgribs pa dang ni ma bsgribs pa 'i lung ma bstan// gzugs dang gzugs med pa rnams na// mi dge las gzhan zag med gnyis// zhes pa la sogs pas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum dang*/ zag med gnyis la brtsi bar gsungs mod/ 'dir ni bsdu ba'i dgongs pa dang yang mthun par khams gong ma gnyis dang 'phags pa phal che ba la med pas mi dge bar re zhig bzhag nas/ spyir nyon mongs pa dang*/ dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan te chos gsum dang*/ dge ba'i khyad par slob pa'i chos zag med dang*/ mi slob pa'i chos zag med gnyis te chos lnga la brtsi ba yin zhing*/ dge ba dang lung ma bstan dag la'ang*/ skyes ma thag ngang gis byung ba'i dad pa la sogs pa dge ba skyes thob dang*/ kun gzhi dang mig dbang la sogs pa lung ma bstan skyes thob dang*/ tshe 'di'i 'bad rtsol las byung ba'i dad pa la sogs pa dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ bzo gnas dang sprul pa la sogs pa lung ma bstan sbyor byung gnyis gnyis su phye bas bdun (375) du'ang 'gyur ro// des na 'chad par 'gyur ba thams cad du skyes thob gnyis zhes pa ni dge ba dang lung ma bstan skyes thob gnyis la go bar bya zhing*/ sbyor byung gnyis zhes pa'ang dge ba dang lung ma bstan sbyor byung gnyis la go bar bya'o// de rnams khams kyis phye na/ 'dod pa na rang gi nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i skyes thob gnyis dang*/ sbyor byung gnyis te lnga yod pa la ni 'dod pa'i chos lnga zhes bya zhing*/

de bzhin du gzugs khams na yang rang gi nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i skyes thob gnyis dang*/ sbyor byung gnyis te lnga yod pa la gzugs kyi chos lnga zhes bya'o// gzugs med na sprul pa yod par gsungs pa ltar na lung ma bstan sbyor byung yang yod mod/ 'dir ni gzugs med na gzugs med cing byang chub sems dpa' der skyes na gzhan don mi 'grub par gsungs nas lung ma bstan sbyor byung med pa'i dbang du don gsang du/ gzugs med pa na spyod pa rnams kyi mig la sogs pa ni ting nge 'dzin las skyes ba yin no// zhes pa dang*/ bsdu bar/ de la gzugs med pa rnams na ni las kyi dbang gis 'grub pa nyid la brten nas gzugs med pa zhes bya bar zad kyi/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang la brten nas ni ma yin te/ 'di ltar de na snyoms par 'jug pas mngon par 'du bya ba mngon du gyur pa las thams cad na gzugs kyi rnam pa la dbang po dmigs pa'i phyir te/ de'ang snyoms par 'jug pa'i gzugs cha phra ba zhes bya'o// zhes gzugs cha phra bar yod par gsungs pa ni sde pa gzhan gyi grub mtha' dang sgo bstun par mngon te/ 'grel par/ 'di ni dge 'dun phal chen pa'i dri yin te zhes 'byung ngo*// lung ma bstan sbyor byung yod pa gsal bar bshad pa yang mi snang*/ byas te/ rang gi nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i skyes thob gnyis dang*/ dge ba sbyor byung ste bzhi yod pa la gzugs med kyi chos bzhi zhes bya'o// de ltar khams 'og ma dag gi chos lnga lnga dang*/ gzugs med kyi bzhi ste/ zag med bcu bzhi dang*/ sngar gyi zag med gnyis te bcu drug ni ldan pa'i chos zhes bya'o// bzhi pa dbye ba ni/ sa bon dang dbang dang mngon gyur du ldan pa gsum yin la/ de rnams kyi sa bon dang ldan pa brtsi ba (376) yin na/ zag med dang sbyor byung la mi brtsi bar/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ dge ba skyes thob gsum dang*/

lung ma bstan skyes thob gsum ste dgu po gang yod dpyad cing*/ dbang gyur du ldan pa brtsi ba ni/ nyon mongs pa dang skyes thob mi brtsi bar/ khams gsum gyi dge ba sbyor byung gsum dang*/ 'og ma dag gi lung ma bstan sbyor byung dang*/ slob mi slob kyi chos zag med gnyis te bdun yod med dpyod pa yin la/ mngon gyur du ldan pa brtsi ba na/ de gnyi ga bsdams pa'i bcu drug po'i nang nas gang dang gang mngon du gyur pa dpyad par bya'o// lnga pa ldan tshul la/ gnyis las/ dang po thun mong du bstan pa ni/ rten 'og ma pas gong ma'i dngos gzhi'i sems thob na/ gong ma'i nyon mongs pa mngon gyur du ldan la/ rang sa'i nyon mongs pa mngon gyur du mi ldan zhing*/ 'on kyang nyon yid ni/ gong du lus skyes pa de'i sa pa yin zhing*/ chags bral la'ang 'byung bas/ so skye la rtag tu mngon du 'gyur la/ bye brag pas/ gong ma'i dngos gzhi thob na 'dod khams kyi mthong spang dang*/ sgom spang gis nyon mongs pa thams cad spong bar 'dod kyang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa pas/ mthong spang gi nyon mongs mi spong bar 'dod de/ bsdu bar/ 'dod pa rnams las 'dod chags dang bral ba de'i 'dod chags dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ de dang mthun pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i nga rgyal dang*/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma rig pa ni/ kun tu mi 'byung ba'i tshul gyis spangs pa yin gyi/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba la sogs pa mthong bas spang bar bya ba dag ni de lta ma yin no// de dag kyang 'di na gnas pa lus 'di la gnas pa spangs pa de la ni lan 'ga' kun tu 'byung bar 'gyur gyi/ gong mar skyes pa la ni mi 'byung ngo*// zhes bshad pa ltar/ chags bral la'ang 'dod pa'i nyon mongs mngon gyur du ldan no// sa bon du ldan mi ldan gnyi gar yang 'jog mod/ 'dir ni re zhig mi ldan pa'i dbang du byas te brtsi ba'o// skyes thob rnams ni gang du skyes pa de kho na la ldan pa yin gyi/

(377) gong ma dang 'og ma la mi ldan zhing*/ sbyor byung rnams ni rten 'og ma dang*/ rang sa rnams la ji rigs par dbang dang mngon gyur du ldan no// zag med gnyis ni byis pa la mngon gyur du ldan pa mi srid cing*/ slob chos zag med dbang gyur du ldan pa srid la/ 'phags pa slob pa la'ang mi slob chos zag med mngon gyur du mi ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur du ldan pa srid de/ 'phags pa gnyi ga la'ang rang rang gi zag med dbang gyur dang*/ mngon gyur gnyi gar ldan par brtsi'o/ de rnams gzhir bzung bas 'og ma rnams dpyad pas shes so// gnyis pa so so la sbyar ba ni/ gang zag gang la/ chos gang ldan pa'i tshul ji ltar srid tshod kyi dbang du byas nas rim pa ltar brtsi ba yin zhing*/ de la/ byis pa la brtsi ba dang*/ 'phags pa la brtsi ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med kyi byis pa la brtsi ba gsum gyi/ dang po la gnyis las/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i so so'i skye bo'i rgyud la sngar gyi ldan chos bcu drug po'i nang nas sa bon ni du dang ldan/ dbang gyur ni du dang ldan/ mngon gyur ni du dang ldan snyam na/ sa bon ni gnyen po gang yang ma thob pas khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ rten gyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis te lnga dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur du 'dod pa'i sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs bsgoms na gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ bzod pa dang chos mchog thob pa lta bu la slob chos zag med de bzhi dang ldan la/ 1$0000220gzugs kyi lung (378) ma bstan dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung gi dbang dang mi ldan te/ gzugs kyi dngos gzhi ma thob par de gnyis kyi sa bon sbyor bas brtas pa med pa'i phyir zhes so// 1$0000270mngon gyur ni 'dod pa'i chos lnga dang*/ gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung ste drug dang ldan pa srid do// de bzhin du sbyar te/

rten 'dod khams pa de nyid rang khams la gnon pa chags bral rdzogs nas gzugs khams kyi sems thob pa la sa bon gang ma dag gi nyon mongs pa gnyis dang*/ rten gyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis te bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur 'dod pa'i sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob chos zag med de drug dang ldan la/ mngon gyur 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis dang*/ sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi nyon mongs pa dang*/ sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung ste brgyad dang ldan pa srid do// 'dod pa'i rten can gzugs med kyi sems thob pa la rigs pa de nyid kyis dpyad na shes so// gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i so so'i skye bo la/ sa bon gzugs dang gzugs med kyi nyon mongs pa gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi skyes thob gnyis te bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur yang gzugs kyi sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob chos zag med de bzhi dang ldan la/ mngon gyur gzugs kyi chos lnga dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung ste drug dang ldan pa srid do// gzugs kyi rten can gzugs med kyi sems thob pa la sngar gyi rigs pas brtsis na shes so// sa bon dbang dang mngon gyur du ldan pa/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs med du skyes pa'i so so'i skye bo la sa bon rang gi nyon mongs (379) pa dang*/ skyes thob gnyis te gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur rang gi dge ba sbyor byung kho na dang ldan la/ gzhan mi ldan pa ni 'og ma'i dge ba mngon du byed mi nus pa'i gnas yin pas so zhes grag go /mngon gyur yang gzugs med kyi chos bzhi dang ldan no// 'phags pa la brtsi ba la'ang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med kyi 'phags pa gsum las/

dang po la'ang slob pa dang*/ mi slob pa la brtsi ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi 'phags pa slob pa rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong lta bu'i rgyud la chos du dang ldan snyam na/ sa bon khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ rten gyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis te lnga dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur 'dod pa'i sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob pa dang mi slob pa'i chos zag med gnyis te lnga dang ldan la/ mngon gyur 'dod pa'i chos lnga dang*/ gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob chos zag med de bdun dang ldan no// 'dod pa'i rten can gzugs dang gzugs med kyi sems thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong ba la brtsi na'ang 'di dang sngar gyi rigs pa dpyad pa las shes so// gnyis pa/ 'dod pa'i mi slob pa shes rab kyi rnam grol la/ sa bon rten gyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur 'dod pa'i sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ mi slob chos zag med de bzhi dang ldan la/ mngon gyur 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis dang*/ sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ mi slob chos zag med de drug dang ldan no// gnyi ga'i cha las rnam grol la/ sa bon sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ dbang gyur 'dod pa'i sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi sbyor

(380) byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ mi slob chos zag med de drug dang ldan la/ mngon gyur 'dod pa'i skyes thob gnyis dang*/ sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ mi slob chos zag med de brgyad dang ldan no/ gzugs kyi sbyor byung gnyis mi ldan zer ba'ang yod do// gzugs khams kyi 'phags pa la'ang slob pa dang*/ mi slob pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ sa bon khams gong ma dag gi sgom spang nyon mongs pa gnyis dang*/ rten gyi dbang gis gzugs kyi skyes thob gnyis te bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur gzugs kyi sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob mi slob kyi chos zag med gnyis te lnga dang ldan la/ mngon gyur gzugs kyi chos lnga dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob chos zag med de bdun dang ldan no// gzugs kyi rten can gzugs med kyi sems thob pa la'ang shes so// gzugs kyi mi slob pa la'ang*/ sa bon gzugs kyi skyes thob gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur gzugs kyi sbyor byung gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ mi slob pa'i chos zag med de bzhi dang ldan la/ mngon gyur de gnyi ga bsdams pa drug dang ldan no// gzugs med kyi 'phags pa la'ang slob pa dang*/ mi slob pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ sa bon rang gi sgom spang nyon mongs pa dang*/ gzugs med kyi skyes thob gnyis te gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur yang gzugs med kyi dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob mi slob kyi chos zag med gnyis te gsum dang ldan la/ mngon gyur rang gi nyon mongs pa dang*/ skyes thob gnyis dang*/ dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ slob chos zag med de lnga dang ldan no// sa la brtsis na 'og ma'i sbyor byung dang yang ldan pa srid de/

srid rtse'i (381) 'phags pa ci yang med// mngon sum byas nas zag pa zad// ces pa ltar ro// gzugs med kyi mi slob pa la/ sa bon rang gi skyes thob gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gyur yang de'i dge ba sbyor byung dang*/ mi slob pa zag med de gnyis dang ldan la/ mngon gyur de dag bsdoms pa bzhi dang ldan no// bsdu bar/ khams la ji lta ba de bzhin du sa la'ang blta bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar brtsis na shin tu mang bar 'gyur mod/ 'dod na rang gis dpyad pa las shes pa nyid do// yang na/ sngar gyi rnam pa gzhan nas nyung ba la mos pa rnams kyis ni bye bshad du 'byung ba ltar brtsis kyang rung bas/ de'i dang po ldan chos ni/ dge ba dang mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan rnams kyis rang dang rigs mthun pa'i chos skyed pa'i rgyu kun gzhi la yod pa'i nus pa'i bye brag sa bon dang*/ sa bon de rkyen la ltos nas rgyun gyis 'bras bu sgrub pa'i dus dbang gyur dang*/ de'i 'bras bu grub pa mngon gyur te/ de ltar dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum las sa bon dang dbang gyur mngon gyur gsum gsum du phye bas dgu yin la/ gnyis pa gang zag ni/ khams gsum gyi byis pa dang 'phags pa las/ gsum pa ldan tshul ni/ 'dod pa'i byis pa 'ching ba kun ldan la 'dod pa'i chos dgu dang*/ gong ma gnyis kyi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi sa bon bzhi dang*/ dbang bzhi ste bcu bdun dang ldan no// de la gong ma gnyis kyi dbang ldan pa ni thos bsam pa la de dag gi sa bon gsos pa yod pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du gzugs kyi byis pa la rang gi dge ba dang lung ma bstan la sa bon la sogs pas phye ba'i chos drug dang*/ gzugs med kyi sa bon dang dbang bzhi dang*/ 'dod pa'i mngon gyur ma gtogs pa drug ste bcu drug dang ldan no// de la gong 'og gi dbang dang ldan pa'ang (382) thos bsam gyis gong ma'i sa bon gsos pa dang*/

phyi ma 'dod par skye ba srid pa'i phyir ro// gzugs med kyi byis pa la snga ma ltar rang gi chos drug dang*/ gzugs kyi bzhi dang*/ 'dod pa'i drug ste bcu drug dang ldan no// de la'ang 'og ma gnyis kyi dbang dang ldan pa ni phyi ma la de dag tu skye ba'i phyir ro// 'phags pa rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong la chos dgu car ldan zhing*/ phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom la mi dge ba mngon gyur bor ba'i chos brgyad dang ldan te/ nyon mongs zad kyang de dag la// las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin// zhes pa ltar ro// byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa las sa gnyis pa nas 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang bral bas mi dge ba mngon gyur mi ldan la gzhan bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ dbang thob pa rnams la lung ma bstan yang med pas dge ba'i chos gsum po kho na ldan no// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ni skyon thams cad mi ldan zhing*/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas/ dge ba mngon gyur kho na dang ldan pa'am bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya'o// gzhung don la/ ldan pa gang zhe na/ lan la'ang bzhi ste/ mtshan nyid gang du bshad tshul/ de'i dbye ba mdor bstan/ phye ba rgyas par bshad pa/ de la mkhas pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid kyis ni snga ma bzhin no// zhes bshad zin dran pa la sbyar ba ste/ 'du byed phung po'i rnam gzhag tu/ dge ba dang mi dge ba dang lung du ma bstan pa'i chos rnams kyi 'phel ba dang 'grib pa dang thob pa dang rnyed pa dang ldan pa zhes gdags so// gnyis pa/ rab tu dbye ba ni gsum ste/ nyon mongs pa dang dge ba dang lung ma bstan tshe 'di'i 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par khams der skye bas thob pa rnams sa bon dang ldan pa dang*/ dge ba dang lung ma bstan sbyor ba las byung ba (383) rkyen gyi dbang gis rgyu sa bon yongs su brtas par gyur pa dbang dang ldan pa dang*/ de dag las 'bras bu grub cing da ltar gyi chos rang mtshan mngon du gyur pa kun tu 'byung ba dang ldan pa'o// rgyas bshad la/

don dngos dang*/ dmigs bsal gnyis kyi/ dang po la sa bon dang*/ dbang gyur dang*/ mngon gyur du ldan pa gsum las/ dang po/ sa bon dang ldan pa gang zhe na/ byis pa'i ldan pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i ldan pa gnyis kyi/ dang po/ khams gsum gyi byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi rgyud la chos gang dang ldan pa brtsi ba la/ rten 'dod pa'i khams su skyes shing smin par gyur pa'i so so'i skye bo'i rgyud la ni chos 'dod pa'i khams dang rab tu ldan zhing der gtogs pa'i 'dod chags la sogs pa rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ khro ba la sogs pa nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang*/ der ma zad gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams dang rab tu ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams kyi sa bon dang ldan no// de'ang 'ching ba mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'ching ba phyogs re dang bral ba yin na ni gang dang bral ba de'i sa bon dang ldan mi ldan gnyi gar 'jog go /gzhan yang sa gang yin pa de kho nar skye bas thob pa'i dge ba rnams kyi sa bon dang ldan pas ldan pa'o// de'i shugs la bsdu ba dang bye bshad du 'byung ba ltar lung ma bstan skyes thob kyi sa bon dang yang ldan par bstan to// rten gzugs kyi khams su skyes shing smin par gyur pa'i so so'i skye bo'i rgyud la ni/ 'dod pa dang rab tu ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis bag la nyal legs par ma bcom pa'i cha nas/ de rnams kyi sa bon dang ldan (384) pas ldan pa zhes bya ba dang*/ re zhig 'jig rten pa'i gnyen pos gnon pa byas pa'i cha nas/ de dag gi sa bon dang ldan pa ma yin pa zhes kyang bya ste/ cha gnyis su bzhag pa'o// de rang sa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag can yin na gzugs dang rab tu ldan pa dang*/ gzugs med pa dang rab tu ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams kyi sa bon dang ldan par 'jog cing*/

ci ste gzugs med kyi sems thob pa yin na ni rang sa'i nyon mongs pa dang ldan mi ldan gnyi gar 'jog go /gzugs khams su skye bas thob pa'i dge ba rnams dang*/ sngar ltar lung ma bstan skyes thob kyi'ang sa bon dang ldan pas ldan pa'o// rten gzugs med par skyes shing smin par gyur pa'i so so skye bo'i rgyu+ud la ni khams 'og ma 'dod pa dang rab tu ldan pa dang gzugs dang rab tu ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'phags pa'i gnyen pos bag la nyal ba rtsad nas ma spangs pa'i cha nas de rnams kyi sa bon dang ldan pas ldan pa zhes bya ba/ byis pa'i gnyen pos re zhig mgo mnan pa'i cha nas sa bon dang ldan pa yang ma yin pa zhes kyang bya ste cha shas gnyis su bstan pa'o// mtha' gcig tu nges pa ni gzugs med pa'i khams dang rab tu ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang*/ gzugs med du skye bas thob pa'i dge ba rnams dang snga ma ltar lung ma bstan skyes thob kyi sa bon dang ldan pas ldan pa'o// 'phags pa'i ldan pa ni spang bya khams gsum pa'i gnyen po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam thob pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyud la ni/ gang zag sgom spang chen po'i chen po la sogs pa rnam pa gang dang gang gis gnyen po sgom (385) lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa byung ba na/ 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis bag la nyal legs par bcom pa'i phyir/ spang bya de dang de'i sa bon dang ldan pas ldan pa ma yin gyi/ sgom spang chung ngu'i chung ngu lta bu gang gi gnyen po sgom lam chen po'i chen po lta bu ma byung ba de'i sa bon dang ldan pas ldan pa'o// gnyen po ni sgom lam ste/ mthong lam ni rnam pa dang sa dang che 'bring chung ngus spang ba med pa'i phyir ma yin no// zhes kyang gsung ngo*// gnyis pa/ dbang dang ldan pa gang zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa la brten pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa la sogs pa tshe de'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i dge ba'i chos zag bcas/

'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gzugs med pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ zag med 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ tshad med pa dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa skyes thob dang sbyor byung gnyis po de dag las kyang kha cig bzo gnas dang sprul pa la sogs pa sbyor ba las byung ba rnams ni byis pa dang 'phags pa rnams la ji rigs par sa bon sbyor bas yongs su brtas te/ dbang gyur dang ldan pas ldan pa'o// gsum pa/ kun tu 'byung ba dang ldan pa gang zhe na/ sngar bshad pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams las skye bas thob pa dang sbyor ba las byung ba'i dge ba zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ zag pa med pa'am/ rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang mi dge ba'am/ mdor na dge mi dge de dag (386) tu lung du ma bstan pa'am/ skyes thob sbyor byung dang bsgribs ma bsgribs kyi lung du ma bstan pa yang rung*/ chos gang dang gang rang gi mtshan nyid mngon sum du gyur pa de dang de kun tu 'byung ba dang ldan pas ldan pa'o// dbang gyur dang mngon gyur de dag kyang khams gsum gyi gang zag gang la chos ji tsam ldan pa'i tshul ni spyi don du bshad zin pa nyid do// dmigs bsal ni/ med par lta bas rtsa ba gcod// ces pa ltar thar pa la skur 'debs kyi log ltas dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pa'i gang zag la ni chos kyis mtshams sbyar du yod pas dge ba'i chos rnams kyi sa bon phra mo dang ldan pas ldan pa zhes bya ba dang re zhig nyams par byas pas ldan pa ma yin pa zhes bya'o// yang kun nas nyon mongs pa dang gtan du ldan pa ni yun ring por yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can gyi gang zag khams gsum pa'i 'khor ba kho na 'dod cing don du gnyer bas 'i phyir 'dod chen pa gnyis kyi/

byang sems 'dod chen pa sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das bar du bdag mya ngan las mi 'da'o// zhes srid par smon pa ni thabs sngon du btang ba yin la sems can/ 'dod chen pa rigs chad sems can du grags pa rnams kyi ngang tshul yin par blta ste/ de dag la ni thar pa thob pa'i rgyu chos dbyings rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i thos sogs dge ba'i bag chags sad pa med pa'i phyir dus gtan du ba ste yun ring por 'khor bar gnas pas rgyu dang mi ldan pa zhes bya'o// thar pa'i rgyu ni rigs yin la/ de'ang rgyan las/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyas pa dang*// de ni rten dang brten pa dang*// yod med nyid dang yon tan ni// sgrol ba'i don la rigs zhes bya// zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla mar/ gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du// rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste// (387) thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa mchog yin no// zhes pa ltar/ chos kyi dbyings gdod ma nas rnam par dag par gnas pa rang bzhin gyi rigs dang*/ de rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i thos sogs dge ba'i bag chags 'phel ba rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin zhing*/ 'di nyid kyi 'grel par yang*/ thar pa thob pa'i rgyu gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid la nyon mongs pa'i gnas ngan len gnas pa yin te/ zhes de kho na ma dag pa dang dag pa las/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba chos nyid rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang*/ rgyud gang la gnyen po'i rjes su mthun pa'i rkyen rnyed nas legs par 'joms nus pa de ni skal ba dang ldan pa'i phyir rgyu'o// zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen brten pa la sogs pas gnyen po dge ba'i bag chags sad de/ spang bya nyon mongs pa rim gyis spong ba rgyas pa las byung ba'i rigs gnyis bshad nas/ bzlog pa ni rgyu dang mi ldan par rig par bya'o// zhes bstan pa ni yun ring por rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang mi ldan pa'o// zhes bya ba'i don te/

rgyud bla ma'i 'grel par/ log sred can gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de ni/ theg pa chen po'i chos la sdang ba log sred can gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i chos la sdang ba bzlog pa'i don du dus gzhan la dgongs pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang mi ldan pa ni mi srid de/ ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can// nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar// sems kyi rang bzhin dri med (388) dbyings// de bzhin rten kun 'gro ba nyid// ces nam mkha' ltar chos kyi dbyings kyis thams cad la khyab par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin// zhes pa la sogs pas thams cad kyi chos nyid la khyad par med par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa/ ldan pa la mkhas pas phan yon ci zhig 'thob ce na/ mtshan nyid la sogs pa bstan pa ltar dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa'i chos rnams kyi 'phel ba dang 'grib pa'i tshul legs par shes par 'gyur ro// de ltar res 'phel ba dang res 'grib pa la sogs pa'i gnas lugs shes na/ 'jig rten pa'i lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'am/ rgud cing phongs par gyur pa gang la yang mtha' gcig tu 'di kho nar bstan pa'o// zhes nges par 'du shes par mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di lta ste/ de yis chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang*// skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas// 'byor pa'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na yang*// nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis gnod pa med// ces pa ltar 'byor pa la rjes su chags pa dang*/ rgud pa la khong khro ba spong bar 'gyur ro// 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs ni chags sdang gi gnas ma yin pas ma smos pa'o// de ltar nyon mongs pa spangs te yon tan khyad par can rim gyis spel ba las ni mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i rnam par bshad pa las/
chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid mngon pa'i mdo kun las btus nas bstan pa zhes bya ba ste/ kun las btus pa dang po rdzogs par bshad zin pa'o// //

(389) ༄༅// da ni bam po gsum pa nas brtsams te rnam nges kun las btus kyi yan lag rgyas par 'chad pa la/ sngar lus rnam gzhag tu ming tsam smos pa'i rnam par nges pa gang zhe na/ lan la/ thun mong gi dbye ba/ so so'i ngo bo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ brjod bya 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi las brtsams te gtan la 'bebs shing*/ phebs pa ltar nges pa'i blo skye bas na/ bden pa rnam par nges pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ chos sde snod gsum dang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa las brtsams te gtan la 'bebs shing rnam par nges pa dang*/ 'thob pa po'i gang zag dang thob bya'i mngon rtogs la sogs pa las brtsams te gtan la 'bebs shing rnam par nges pa dang*/ de ltar rgya chen po shes pa na phan tshun 'bel ba'i gtam byed tshul las brtsams te gtan la 'bebs shing rnam par nges pa'o// ngo bo la bzhi las/ bden pa rnam nges la spyi don lnga ste/ mtshan nyid/ tha dad/ grangs nges/ go rim/ nges tshig go /mtshan nyid ni/ bsdu bar/ bstan pa dang mi mthun pa med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi don can zhes pa ltar sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid kun 'byung gis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po bstan pa dang mthun pa dang*/ kun 'byung gi mtshan nyid sdug bsngal nyer len gyi phung po skyed byed bstan pa dang mthun pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i mtshan nyid de bzhin nyid glo bur gyi dri mas dag pa bstan pa dang mthun pa dang*/ lam bden gyi mtshan nyid thar par 'gro ba'i 'jug ngogs bstan pa dang mthun pa'o// des na ma rig bag chags kyi rkyen dang*/ zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu las/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus grub ste bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho dang skye ba ni 'dir bshad pa'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ma yin no/ (390) /bsdu bar gsungs pa'i don/ yang 'gog pa de lam gyi 'bras bu yin na mi rtag par 'gyur zhing*/

rtag tu yod na 'bad med du thar pa thob par 'gyur ro zhe na skyon med de/ thar pa ni 'gog pa mngon du byas pa dri ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu yin gyi/ skyed pa'i 'bras bu ma yin pa'i phyir ro// tha dad bsam pa la/ 'gog pa ni gzhan gsum las de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa yin zhing*/ lam zag med yin pas sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung las tha dad pa la/ gnyis po'ang ci rigs rgyu 'bras su gyur pa'i cha ni tha dad yin mod kyi 'on kyang kun 'byung gang yin sdug bsngal yin pa la sogs pa'i cha nas ngo bo gcig pa yang srid do// sdug bsngal yin la kun 'byung ma yin pa yang yod pas mi gcig pa yang yod de/ byis pa'i rnam smin lung ma bstan gyis bsdus pa thams cad dang*/ da ltar skyes bu'i rtsol pa las byung ba'i bde 1 sdug lung 3 ma bstan 2 btang snyoms rnams dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten la sogs pa'o// grangs nges ni// bden pa bzhir byas pa la 'khor ba dang myang 'das gnyis su nges shing*/ 'khor ba la'ang 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang rgyu kun 'byung gnyis su nges la/ myang 'das la'ang 'bras bu 'gog pa dang rgyu lam bden gnyis su nges pas bden pa bzhi ste/ rgyan du/ gang phyir bden pa gnyis las ni// 'jig rten rnams rtag 'byung bar 'dod// gnyis kyis nub par 'gyur de'i phyir// de shes 'jig rten shes zhes bya// zhes pa ltar ro// shes bya thams cad bden bzhir 'du ba ni ma yin te/ nam mkha' dang*/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang*/ ma dag pa'i de bzhin nyid dang*/ yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la sogs pa rnams bzhi po gang du'ang ma 'dus pa'i phyir ro// go rim ni/ yul can mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dang mthun par yul bden pa (391) bzhi bstan pa ste/ bden pa ji ltar mngon rtogs rim zhes pa ltar ro// de yang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po ni nad dang 'dra bar shes par bya ba dang*/

de'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ni nad kyi rgyu dang 'dra bar spang bar bya ba dang*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol ba'i 'gog pa ni nad med pa'i bde ba dang 'dra bar thob par bya ba dang*/ de'i thabs su lam zag med sgom pa ni sman bzang po dang 'dra bar bsten par bya bar rtogs pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla mar/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la// bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba dang*// sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam// shes bya spang bya reg par bya zhing bsten par bya// zhes pa ltar ro// nges tshig la/ thun mong du rang rang gi ngo bo rnam pa bzhi bzhir bden zhing mi bslu bar gnas pas/ de rnams kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba mthong ba phyin ci ma log pa'i blo skye bas na 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya/ mdzod 'grel du drangs pa 'phags pas bde bar gang gsungs pa// de ni gzhan gyis sdug bsngal rig /gzhan gyis bde bar gang smras pa// de ni 'phags pas sdug bsngal rig /ces pa ltar ro// khyad par du mdzod 'grel du/ gnod pa'i bdag nyid yin pas sdug bsngal lo// 'di las sdug bsngal kun 'byung bas na kun 'byung ngo*// phung po zhig pas 'jug pa med pas na 'gog pa'o// bgrod pa'i don gyis na lam mo// zhes pa ltar ro// gzhung don la/ bden pa rnam par nges pa gang zhe na/ bden bzhi thun mong gi dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i rang bzhin/ zag bcas zag med kyi khyad par ro// dang po/ dbye ba ni/ 'di dag gi rang bzhin 'phags pa'i ye shes la phyin ci ma log par snang bas na 'phags pas mngon sum du gzigs pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag ste/ yongs su shes (392) par bya ba sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang*/ shes nas spang bar bya ba kun 'byung gi bden pa dang*/ spangs pas 'thob par 'gyur ba 'gog pa'i bden pa dang*/ thob bya mngon du byed pa'i thabs su bsten par bya ba lam zab mo'i bden pa'o// rang bzhin la'ang de ltar bzhi ste/

shes bya sdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ spang bya kun 'byung gi bden pa/ thob bya 'gog pa'i bden pa/ bsten bya lam bden gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gang zhe na/ brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal du gzhag pa/ mdo'i don bshad de rang mtshan ngos gzung ba/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa'am spyi mtshan bstan pa/ de dag las 'phros pa'i khyad par bshad pa'o// dang po la don dngos dang*/ dmigs bsal gnyis las/ dngos la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu gsum gyi dang po la/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa de ni g.yo ba sems can gyi 'jig rten gang skye ba dang*/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten gang du skye ba'i gnas kyis kyang bstan par rig par bya'o// rgyas bshad la/ g.yo ba bcud kyi 'jig rten dang*/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten las/ dang po la/ gzhung don gyis ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ spyi don gyis gtan la dbab pa gnyis kyi gzhung don la/ sems can skye ba gang zhe na/ sems can dmyal ba de la sems can dmyal ba pa'i 'gro ba gang zhe na/ sems can dmyal ba pa'i phung po sa bon dang 'bras bus bsdus pa rnams dang*/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las gang yin pa'o zhes sa'i dngos gzhir ro// 'grel par gal te sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'i las kyi sa bon de yang*/ sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba yin na/ ji ltar 'gro ba 'dres par mi 'gyur zhe na/ mi 'gro ba'i 'gro ba gang yin pa de kho na dang*/ de'i las tha mi dad do zhes su smra'i/ kun tu 'byung ba tsam gyis 'dres par mi 'dod de/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ de'i sa bon yang 'dod pa na spyod pa nyid yin par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ rnams su sems can skye ba ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'o zhes pa la sogs par sbyar te/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i las kyis der khrid pas sam/ na ra ka zhes pa'i na med pa dang ra ti dga' ba dang ka ra byed pa ste/

(393) dga' bar byed pa med pas sam 'dus bzangs na re skyabs mi rnyed pa'i don gyis na dmyal ba dang*/ mi ltar 'grengs te mi 'gro bar phal cher dud de 'gro bas na dud 'gro rnams dang*/ yun ring por phyir mi ldog par 'ong bas sam/ skom pa dang ldan pas na yi dwags lto gug kha khab ltar phra dang*// bshang za kun ston dri za dang*// chos za sbyin pa za ba dang*// chu 'thung bsam pas 'tsho ba dang*// mchil ma za dang phreng ba za// khrag za sha za bdug pa za// drag shul spyod dang glags lta dang*// sa 'og gnas dang mthu bo che// mtshan mo lus 'bar mir glags lta// 'dod gzugs gling bar gnas pa dang*// gshin rje'i dbyug pa byis pa za// tshangs srin 'bru yi shun pa za// mi gtsang za dang lam chen gnas// mang du za dang me mdag za// dug za dgon par gnas pa dang*// dur khrod gnas dang shing la gnas// lam gyi gzhi mdor gnas pa dang*// bdud kyi sde ste sum cu drug /ces dran pa nyer gzhag nas rig ral gyis bsdus pa'o// yi dwags lto gug dang*/ kha khab ltar phra ba dang*/ bshang ba za ba dang*/ kun ston dang*/ dri za dang*/ chos za dang*/ spyin pa za ba dang*/ chu 'thung ba dang*/ bsam pas 'tsho ba dang*/ mchil ma za ba dang*/ phreng ba za ba dang*/ khrag za ba dang*/ sha za ba dang*/ bdug pa za ba dang*/ drag shul spyod pa dang*/ glags lta ba dang*/ sa'i 'og na gnas pa dang*/ mthu bo che dang*/ mtshan mo lus rab tu 'bar ba dang*/ mi rnams la glags lta ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i gzugs can dang*/ gling gi bar na gnas pa dang*/ gshin rje'i dbyug pa dang*/ byis pa la za ba dang*/ tshangs pa'i srin po dang*/ 'bru drus pa'i shun pa za ba dang*/ mi gtsang ba za ba dang*/ lam po che na gnas pa dang*/ mang du za ba dang*/ me mdag za ba dang*/ dug za ba dang*/ dgon pa na gnas pa dang*/ dur khrod na gnas pa dang*/ shing la gnas pa dang*/ lam gyi gzhi mdo na gnas pa dang*/ bdud kyi sde ste/

de ltar mdor bsdu na yi dwags kyi rigs sum cu rtsa drug yod do/ rnams te ngan song gsum dang*/ yid shas che ba skye dgu'i bdag po'i shed kyi bu yin pas na mi dang*/ de'i khyad par gling 'di la ltos na ri rab kyi shar na yod cing*/ lus khyad par du 'phags shing bzang ba yod pas na shar gyi lus 'phags dang*/ mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram na (394) shing 'dzam bu zhes bya ba shing thog chu nang lhung ba rnams 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser du 'gyur ba yod cing des mtshon pa'i gling yin pas na 'dzam bu gling dang*/ lho mi smos pa ni gzhan gsum 'di la ltos nas bzhag pa'i don to// 'di la ltos pa'i nub na yod cing sbyin pa dang nyo tshong la sogs pa rnams gtso cher ba lang la spyod pas na nub kyi ba lang spyod/ 'di la ltos pa'i byang na yod cing skad ngan pa smra ba'am 'chi khar sgra mi snyan pa 'byung bas na byang gi sgra mi snyan te mi'i 'jig rten dang*/ 'dir lha ma smos pa ni 'gro ba gzhan gyi nang du 'du bas so// gtso bo rgyal po bzhi'i sde'am khongs su gtogs pas na rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang*/ longs spyod mchog la snyoms par 'jug cing rtse bar byed pas sam/ tshangs pa'i lus las byung bas na lha zhes bya ste gong ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// legs byas lhan cig byas pa rnams der skyes pas sam/ dbang po dang 'dzin byed dang spong gzhan la sogs nyi ma'i ming can bcu gnyis dang*/ 'phrog byed dang bde 'byung dang dbang ldan la sogs (395) pa drag po bcu gcig dang*/ yid gcugs dang nges byed dang zla ba can la sogs pa nor lha brgyad dang*/ tha skar gyi bu gzhon nu gnyis te sum 'chi med mdzod du/ dbang po 'dzin byed spong gzhan dang*// 'jog po rgyas byed bsten bya dang*// cha can rnam gnas khyab 'jug dang*// 'od can bgrod byed bshes gnyen nyid// ces pa nyi ma'i ming can bcu gnyis dang*/

yang*/ gcig pur ma skyes 'ching byed dang*// 'jog po drag po brtson 'grus ldan// 'phrog byed nyid dang bde 'byung dang*// mig gsum gzhan gyis mi thub pa// dbang ldan dang ni sa gsum pa// drag po bcu gcig rnams su bshad// ces pa dang*/ yid gcugs nges byed zla ba can// 'dzin pa nyid dang rlung dang me// tho rangs dang ni rab gsal byed// ces pa de brgyad nor lhar bshad// ces pa dang*/ tha skar gyi bu gzhon nu gnyis ni/ tshogs bdag dang smin drug gi bu'o// cu rtsa gsum yod pa'am/ chos bzang na gnas pa la sogs pa sum chos bzang 1 mtho ba 2 ri rtse 3 legs mthong dang 4 // phyogs 5 gcig shing ga 6 seb shing rta sna tshogs 7 dang*// dga' byed 8 rnam 9 mdzes yongs 10 'du 'dres pa'i 'gram 11 // tshang tshing 'gram 12 dang nor bu'i snying 13 po dang*// kun tu gsal 14 spyod gser phug khang 15 pa dang*// phreng ba'i grib 16 ma dma' 'thor rgyu ba 17 dang*// bkra 18 ba sna tshogs kyis phye sbyor ba 'jug 19 /zhi 20 spyod glu yi sgra la shin tu dga'// zhing mngon par chags pa dang gzi brjid 'bar 21 // zla gnas ltar rgyu 22 sa la bzung 23 dang ni// mig phye 24 'gro zhing btsums nas 'gro ba dang 25 // lus mdog bzang 26 dang nor bu 'chang ba 27 dang*// ris mthun 28 'khor na gnas 29 dang mtho bar byed 30 // bzi brjid mchog 31 dang gzi phreng 32 ma 'dres 33 pa'o// cu rtsa gsum yod pas na sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ (396) lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral bas na 'thab bral dang*/ de la ni bsod nams kyis song bas sam/ mel tshe thun re la bsod nams la bskul ba'i sgra 'byung bas sam/ lha mtshe mar brdzus te skye bas na mtshe ma zhes kyang bya'o// dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba'i las kyi song bas sam/ theg chen gyi chos kyi dga' ba de dang lhag par ldan pas na dga' ldan dang*/ 'dod yon rang gis sprul pa la ci dgar spyod pas na 'phrul dga' dang*/

gzhan gyis sprul pa'i longs spyod la dbang sgyur bar byed pas na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod pa'i khams dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos bsal ba'i phyir tshangs pa ste de'i rigs sam 'khor du gtogs pas na tshangs sa'i dngos gzhir/ dper na nor bu ni phyi rol na 'od yod la nor bu nyid 'od min pa de bzhin du bsam gtan dang po'i lus la phyi rol na 'od yod la lus nyid ni 'od ma yin no// ji ltar mar me ni phyi rol na 'od yod la mar me nyid kyang 'od yin pa de bzhin du bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lus kyang 'od yin par rig par bya'o// ris dang*/ tshangs pa'i mdun na 'dug ste tshig 'don cing smra bas na/ tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po las skyes shing tshe tshad lus tshad la sogs pa tshangs pa gzhan las che bas na tshangs chen te bsam gtan dang po dang*/ rang gi sa pa gong ma la ltos te 'od kyi khyon dang gsal ba gnyis ka chung bas na 'od chung dang*/ 'od kyi khyon sa 'og ma bas tshad bzung bar mi nus pas na tshad med 'od dang*/ 'od kyi khyon dang gsal ba gnyis ka che zhing gnas gzhan mtha' dag snang bar byed pas na 'od (397) gsal te bsam gtan gnyis pa dang*/ yid kyi sa pa'i bde ba ni rab tu zhi ba'i phyir dge ba zhes btags shing*/ de rang gi sa pa gong ma pas chung bas na dge chung dang*/ bde ba sa 'og ma pas tshad bzung du med pa dang ldan pas na tshad med dge dang*/ bde ba cher rgyas shing 'phel ba dang ldan pas na dge rgyas te bsam gtan gsum pa dang*/ de yan chad sa gzhi sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu 'dabs chags med pas na sprin med dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i bsod nams las skyes pas sam/ byas pa phul du byung ba las skyes pas na bsod nams skyes dang*/ gzhan dang 'brel ba'i so so skye bo las 'bras bu mchog tu gyur pas na 'bras bu che ste bsam gtan bzhi pa dang*/ de'i bye brag skyes thob kyis tshogs drug gi 'du shes 'gags te gnas pas na 'du shes med pa'i sems can dang*/

so so skye bo dang ma 'dres pa'i gnas gtsang ma gong ma rnams las yon tan gyi khyad par mi che bas na mi che ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thob pas 'gyod pa'am nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba med pas na mi gdung ba dang*/ rab tu zhi zhing mchog tu mdzes par snang bas na gya nom snang dang*/ mthong ba'am lta ba rnam par dag cing bzang bas na shin tu mthong dang*/ gnas gzhan dang 'brel ba 'di las yon tan lhag pa gong na med pas na 'og min dang*/ yang na rdul phra rab bsags pa'i gzugs kyi mthar thug pa yin pas na bsags mtha' zhes kyang bya ste/ gzugs kyi khams dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi sbyor ba'i dus

(398) su nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam pa'i rnam par byed cing*/ lam de nyid skye zhing mched pa las byung bas 'bras bu skye ba'ang de'i ming gis btags nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam shes mtha' yas so snyam pa'i rnam par byed pas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang*/ ci yang med do snyam pa'i rnam par byed pas ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang*/ 'du shes ni nad dang 'bras dang zug rngu dang 'dra zhing*/ 'du shes med pa ni kun tu rmongs pa'o snyam pa'i rnam par byed cing 'du shes kyi rgyu ba zhan pa byung bas na 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched rnams te gzugs med pa'i khams su sems can skye ba'ang sdug bsngal gyi bden par rig par bya'o// de rnams gtan la dbab pa ni/ rtog dpyod kyi sar/ grangs dang gnas dang tshad rnams dang*// tshe yi tshad dang longs spyod dang*// skye ba dang ni lus rnams dang*// rgyu dang rkyen rnams rgya cher ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po grangs kyis gtan la dbab pa ni/ thams cad kyang khams kyis phye na gsum yin zhing*/ sems mi 'dra bas phye na dgur 'gyur la/ rigs kyis phye na 'gro ba drug ste/ mdo las/ sems can tshogs kyi 'gro drug gang bstan pa// sems can dmyal ba dud 'gro yi dwags dang*// lha min ris dang mi dang lha rnams su// mi yi seng ges kun rdzob btags pa mdzad// zhes pa ltar ro// rgyud dam lam gyi sgo nas lngar yang gsungs te/ sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha gnas ngan song lam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin// zhes pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i skye 'chi thog med 'dir// 'gro ba'i lam ni rnam pa lnga/ (399) /zhes pa ltar ro// de bzhin du mdzod las kyang*/ der ni dmyal sogs 'gro ba lnga// rang gi ming gis bstan de dag

/nyon mongs can min lung bstan min// sems can zhes bya bar srid min// zhes khams gsum po der 'gro ba rnams ris lngar 'dus shing*/ 'gro ba'i ngo bo ma bsgribs lung ma bstan yin la srid pa bar ma ni skye gnas bzhis bsdus kyang 'gro ba lngas ma bsdus par bshad do// lha ma yin ni dran pa nyer gzhag la sogs par dud 'gror bsdus kyang mi blun po la ba lang zhes smad pa tsam ste/ sa sde las/ longs spyod lha dang 'dra ba la sogs pas lha'i 'gro bar bsdus shing*/ mdo las kyang*/ 'di dag ni sngon nas lha nyid lags so zhes gsungs so// klu dang nam mkha' lding dang lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa ni dud 'gror 'dus shing*/ 'chi med mdzod du ni/ rig 'dzin lha min gnod sbyin dang*// srin po dri za mi 'am ci// sha za gsang ba grub pa dang*// 'byung po lha yi skye gnas can// zhes bshad la/ grul bum dang*/ srul po dang*/ lus srul po dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ grib gnon dang*/ nam gru'i gdon dang*/ bya'i gdon la sogs pa ni yi dwags so// zhes kyang 'chad do// mdor bsdu na ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro gnyis so// gnas kyis gtan la dbab pa la/ 'dod pa'i khams na gnas gzhan sum cu rtsa drug ste// nye 'khor ba ni 'khor yin zhing*/ nyi tshe ba ni gnas gzhan na'ang yod pas logs su mi bgrang*/ tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad/ yi dwags dang*/ lha ma yin te bco brgya dang*/ dud 'gro ni lha mi dang yang lhan cig rgyu bas logs su mi bgrang bar/ mi la gling bzhi dang gling phran brgyad de bcu gnyis dang*/ 'dod lha'i gnas (400) drug po rnams so// mdzod du ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// mi rnams dang ni lha rnams drug /'dod pa'i khams yin dmyal ba dang*// gling dbye ba las de nyi shu// zhes dmyal ba brgyad yi dwags dud 'gro gnyis te ngan 'gro'i gnas bcu dang*/

mi'i gling bzhi dang lha'i gnas drug ste bde 'gro'i gnas bcu rnams bsdoms pas nyi shur bstan to// gzugs kyi khams na gnas gzhan bco brgyad de/ 'du shes med pa ni 'bras bu che ba'i nang du gtogs pas/ bsam gtan bzhi las bzhi gsum gsum du phye ba'i bcu gnyis dang*/ gnas gtsang ma lnga ste bcu bdun gyi steng du/ gnas gtsang ma las kyang 'das pa na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa kho na bzhugs pa'i 'og min chen po dang bcas pa'o// de ltar 'phags pa'i gnas drug ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dngos ma yin yang gzugs khams kyi zhar las byung ba'o// kha che ba ni tshangs chen pa mdun na 'don gyi dgon pa lta bu yin pas bcu drug tu 'dod la/ nyi 'og bye brag tu smra ba ni bcu bdun du 'dod cing*/ mdzod las kyang*/ gong ma'i gnas rnams bcu bdun ni// gzugs khams yin der so so yi// bsam gtan sa ni gsum pa yin// bzhi pa sa ni brgyad pa yin// zhes so// gzugs med pa'i khams na ni gzugs med pa'i phyir gnas gzhan tha dad pa med cing*/ skye ba len tshul gyis rnam pa bzhi yin te/ gzugs med khams na gnas med do// skye ba las ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes pa ltar ro// de rnams sa dgur 'jog pa na/ 'dod pa'i khams sa gcig dang*/ gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi po sa bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi'ang sa bzhi'o// de la khams ni sred pas ris su bcad (401) cing lta bas bdag gir byas pa yin la/ sa ni 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba na bsam gtan dang po thob pa lta bu chags bral gyi rim pa yin pas/ sa dgus khams gsum bsdus kyang khams gsum gyis ni sa dgu ma bsdus te/ bsam gtan dang po nas ci yang med pa'i bar la mthong lam la sogs pa brten pa na/ khams zag bcas yin yang sa zag med du skye ba'i phyir ro// des na bsdu bar/ kun shes pa'i dbang po la sogs pa gsum khams kyis ma bsdus shing sas bsdus par bshad do// lus tshad kyis gtan la dbab pa la/

don dngos dang*/ 'jal byed gnyis las/ dngos ni/ chos mngon pa nas ngan song gsum gyi lus tshad nges pa ma bshad cing*/ rgyal ba'i yum du'ang*/ dam pa'i chos spong ba dmyal bar skye ba'i lus tshad bshad du mi rung bar gsungs mod kyi/ dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ mtshams med gcig nas lnga'i bar du byas pa'i mnar med kyi lus la dpag tshad gcig nas lnga'i bar du yod pa la sogs gsungs shing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdor/ mtshams med brgyad byas pa'i lus la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod kyang gcig la gcig thogs pa med par bshad la/ dkon mchog ta la la'i mdor/ theg chen la skur pa btab pa'i dmyal ba'i lce la yang dpag tshad 'bum yod pa la sogs pa gsungs so// nyi ma'i snying po'i mdor/ yi dwags chung ba la mtho gang dang*/ che ba la dpag tshad stong bar gsungs shing*/ dud 'gro chung ba la skra'i rtse mo'i lnga bcu cha tsam dang*/ nyi zer gyi rdul tsam dang*/ rgya shug gi tshig gu'i tshad tsam dang*/ che ba la dpag tshad khri yod pa'i bar du gsungs la/ gzhan yang glang po che rab brtan dang*/ sa srungs kyi bu la mtha' skor du dpag tshad bdun (402) yod pa dang*/ chu srin nya'i rigs la dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ nya mid kyis de yang mid par nus pa dang*/ de mid kyis nya mid kyang mid par nus pa la sogs pa gsungs so// las brgya par/ chu srin che ba la dpag tshad nyis stong bdun brgya yod par bshad cing*/ nyi ma'i snying por/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis rgya mtsho las lus ma 'phags par stod kyis sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin nas ston pa la chos nyan pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa 'pho ba'i mdor/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nyer dga'i lus kyis ri rab kyang g.yo zhing*/ dbugs kyi dug gis rgya mtsho'ang btung du mi rung bar byed pa dang*/ lung du klu gnyis kyis ri rab la lan gsum gsum dkris pa la sogs pa gsungs so// sa sde las/ ngan song gsum gyi lus tshad ni/

sdig pa ji ltar che ba bzhin du lus che zhing de la brten pa'i sdug bsngal yang che la/ sdig pa chung ba ltar lus chung zhing sdug bsngal yang chung bas/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa med par gsungs so// bde 'gro la mi rnams kyi lus tshad ni/ 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshad// khru bzhi pa dang phyed dang bzhi// shar dang ba lang spyod dang ni// byang zhes bya ba nyis 'gyur bskyed// ces 'jam bu gling pa'i mi rnams bskal pa dang po'i dus che zhing snyigs ma'i dus na chung yang phal cher rang rang gi khru bzhi pa'am phyed dang bzhi par nges la/ shar lus 'phags po'i mi rnams la chos mngon pa gsungs dus kyi 'dzam bu gling pa'i lus nyis 'gyur dang*/ nub ba lang spyod pa la shar gyi'ang nyis 'gyur dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan pa la nub kyi'ang gnyis kyis che ba ste/ sar/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi khru phyed dang bzhi par nges shing lus shin tu che ba dang ldan par gsungs so// bsod nams ldan pa'i mi 'ga' zhig ni (403) sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang mnyam pa ste/ yab sras mjal bar/ rgyal po spyi bo skyes dang brgya byin gnyis stan gcig la 'dug pa na mig 'byed 'dzum tsam ma gtogs par khyad par mi snang bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// chung ba la/ lha ma yin rnams kyi lus tshad dang tshe tshad dang longs spyod ni sa sde las sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang 'dra bar gsungs so// 'dod lha rigs drug gi lus tshad ni/ 'dod dang ldan pa lha yi lus// bzhi cha nas ni rgyang grags dag /phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du bskyed// ces pa ltar rgyal chen rigs bzhi la rgyang grags bzhi cha dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa la rgyang grags phyed dang*/ 'thab bral ba la rgyang grags bzhi gsum dang*/ dga' ldan pa la rgyang grags gcig dang*/ 'phrul dga' ba la gcig dang bzhi cha dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa la rgyang grags phyed gnyis te/ 'dom brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga nas che ba la phyed dang brgyad brgya'i bar ro// gzugs khams pa rnams kyi lus tshad ni/

gzugs can dang po dpag tshad phyed// de yi gong ma phyed phyed bskyed// 'od chung rnams kyi ltag yan chad// lus ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te// sprin med dpag tshad gsum dor ro// zhes pa ltar tshangs ris pa'i lus la dpag tshad phyed dang*/ 'dom nyis stong*/ mdun na 'don pa la gcig dang*/ 'dom bzhi stong*/ tshangs chen la phyed dang gnyis dang*/ 'od chung pa la gnyis dang*/ tshad med 'od pa la bzhi dang*/ 'od gsal ba la brgyad dang*/ dge chung la bcu drug dang*/ tshad med dge la sum cu so gnyis dang*/ dge rgyas pa la drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ sprin med pa la de'i nyis 'gyur brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad la gsum dor bas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ bsod nams skyes pa la nyis brgya lnga (404) bcu dang*/ 'bras bu che ba la lnga brgya dang*/ mi che ba la stong dang*/ mi gdung ba la nyis stong ste/ 'dzam bu gling gi dkyus dang mnyam pa dang*/ gya nom snang ba la bzhi stong dang*/ shin tu mthong ba la brgyad stong dang*/ 'og min pa'i lus la dpag tshad khri drug stong ste/ 'dzam bu gling gi dkyus la ni de'i mtho gang ngo*// gzugs med pa'i khams na gzugs med pa'i phyir lus kyi tshad nges pa med do// de na dge 'dun phal chen pa dang*/ gos dmar can gyi sde pa la sogs pa gzugs phra bar yod par 'dod pa ni mdzod 'grel las bkag cing*/ mdo las gzugs med pa'i lha rnams kyang mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs te bcom ldan 'das la chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'ong ba gsungs pa ni/ der skyes pa'i 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa yin zhing sprul pa'i lus la tshad nges pa med do zhes kyang gsung ngo*// 'jal byed kyi tshad ni/ gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang*// skad cig phra rab rdul dang ni// rdul phran dang ni de bzhin du// lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang*// nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang*// de las shig dang de bzhin nas// sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun 'gyur// zhes pa ltar gzugs kyi mtha' rdul phra rab dang*/

dus kyi mtha' skad cig ma dang*/ ming gi mtha' yi ge yin pas/ 'dir ni gzugs kyi chung shos mthar thug par gyur pa rdul phra rab ni grub mthas brtags nas bzhag pa bstan du med cing*/ thogs pa med pa'i gzugs yin la/ de bdun la rdul phran zhes bya zhing*/ de bzhin de bdun la lcags rdul dang*/ chu rdul dang*/ ri bong gi rdul dang*/ lug gi rdul dang*/ glang gi rdul dang*/ nyi zer gyi rdul dang*/ sro ma dang*/ de las byung ba shig dang*/ (405) nas rnams kyang snga ma bdun ni phyi ma'i tshad de/ nas bdun la sor gang zhes bya'o/ */lcags byang ma la chags pa'i rdul la lcags rdul zhes sogs ni rags pa ba ste snga ma bdun 'gyur las phye zhes btags pa tsam mo// gdags pa dang*/ rgya cher rol pa la sogs par bar pa rnams kyi ming dang go rim mi 'dra bar gsungs kyang*/ grangs mthun pas sor ni mnyam pa nyid do// sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru// khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*// de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni// rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod// de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya 'o// zhes pa ltar/ sor nyi shu rtsa gcig la khru gang dang*/ khru bzhi la gzhu 'dom gang dang*/ gzhu 'dom lnga brgya la rgyang grags zhes bya zhing*/ grong las rgyang grags yan chad 'phags pa ni dgon pa'i tshad yin la/ rgyang grags brgyad la ni dpag tshad ces bya'o// tshe tshad kyis gtan la dbab pa la'ang gnyis las/ don dngos ni/ mi'i tshe tshad nas brtsams te bshad na go sla bas/ sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste// gnyis na phyed phyed spangs pa 'o// 'di na ma nges tha mar ni// lo bcu dang po dpag tu med// ces pa ltar sgra mi snyan na tshe lo stong pa dang*/ ba lang spyod na lnga brgya pa yod pa dang*/ lus 'phags po na nyis brgya lnga bcu par nges shing*/ 'dzam bu gling 'di na mtha' gcig tu ma nges par thung shos la tshe lo bcu pa dang*/ bskal pa dang po tshe lo dpag tu med pa dang*/

bar skabs brgyad khri la sogs par 'gyur ro// 'dod lha drug gi tshe tshad ni/ mi rnams tshe lo lnga bcu la// 'dod lha 'og ma'i nyin zhag ste// de yi tshe lo lnga brgya 'o// gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur te// zhes pa ltar mi lo lnga bcu ni rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig yin (406) la/ des ni zhag chen po sum cu la zla ba dang*/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i tshe lo lnga brgya thub cing*/ de bzhin du/ mi lo brgya ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i zhag gcig ste des de bsags pa'i lo stong dang*/ mi lo nyis brgya ni 'thab bral ba'i zhag gcig ste des lo nyis stong dang*/ mi lo bzhi brgya ni dga' ldan pa'i zhag gcig ste des lo bzhi stong dang*/ mi lo brgyad brgya ni 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig ste des lo brgyad stong dang*/ mi lo stong drug brgya ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i zhag gcig ste des lo khri drug stong thub pa'o// mdzod 'grel du/ ri gnya' shing 'dzin yan chad na nyi zla med kyang*/ pad ma dang ku mu ta bzhin du me tog gi kha bye zum dang*/ bya rnams skad 'byin mi 'byin dang*/ gnyid sangs pa dang bro ba las nyin mtshan du 'jog cing*/ snang ba'i bya ba ni rang lus kyi 'od kyis byed par bshad do// ngan song gsum gyi tshe'i tshad la/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// de yis de dag rnams kyi tshe// 'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin// zhes pa ltar dmyal ba yang sos pas rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo lnga brgya dang*/ thig nag pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo stong dang*/ bsdus 'joms pas 'thab bral ba'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo nyis stong dang*/ ngu 'bod pas dga' ldan pa'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo bzhi stong dang*/ ngu 'bod chen po pas 'khrul dga' ba'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo brgyad stong dang*/
tsha ba bas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo chen po khri drug stong thub bo// rab tu tsha phyed mnar
