(407) med ni// bar gyi bskal pa'o dud 'gro rnams// mchog ring bskal pa'o yi dwags rnams// zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya// zhes pa ltar rab tu tsha ba'i tshe tshad bar bskal phyed dang*/ mnar med pa'i tshe tshad bar bskal gcig ste/ gdags par dmyal ba 'di dag dang rim pa ltar tshangs ris pa dang*/ 'dun na 'don pa tshe tshad mnyam par bshad do// dud 'gro rnams ni tshe nges pa med pa yin yang mchog tu ring na bskal par gnas pa ste/ dge slong dag klu brgyad po ni klu chen po ste bskal par gnas pa sa 'dzin pa'o zhes pa ltar ro// yi dwags rnams ni mi'i zla ba la zhag gcig byas pa'i lo lnga brgya pa ste/ bshes spring du/ lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur// zhes pa ltar ro// nyi ma'i snying po'i mdor/ dud 'gro tshe thung bas yud tsam dang*/ ring ba bskal pa thub pa dang*/ yi dwags tshe thung bas lo stong dang*/ ring bas stong phrag brgyad cu thub par gsungs so// grang dmyal rnams kyi ni/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing*// til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yin te// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur bsgyur// zhes pa ltar ma gaṅgā'i til khal brgyad cus gang ba'i bang ba nas lo brgya brgya nas til re re phyung bas zad par gyur pa ni chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin la/ chu bur rdol ba la sogs pa phyi ma phyi ma rnams ni snga ma snga ma rnams las nyi shur 'gyur gyis ring ba ste/ sa las/ grang ba'i sems can dmyal bar skyes pa'i sems can gyi tshe'i tshad ni/ sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes pa'i sems can rnams la phyi ma phyi ma phyed phyed zhugs par rig par bya'o// zhes pa la/ blo brtan tsha dmyal kyi phyed phyed grang dmyal zhes dang*/ rig ral sum gnyis zhes 'chad mod bstun na phyed phyed bas grang dmyal ring bar gsal lo/ nye 'khor ba dang nyi tshe ba'i tshe tshad ni ma nges par gsungs so// khams gong ma dag gi ni/

gzugs can nyin mtshan med tshe ni// rang lus gzhal ba'i bskal pa yin/ (408) /'od chung nas bzung bskal chen te// de yi 'og ma phyed phyed yin// zhes pa ltar gzugs khams na nyin mtshan med pas lo'i sgo nas mi 'jog par rang gi lus la dpag tshad gang yod pa de'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal par gnas par 'jog go /de'i 'og ma gsum la ni bskal chen phyed la bskal bar byas pa'i phyed phyed ces bya ste/ tshangs ris pas bar bskal nyi shu dang*/ mdun na 'don pas bzhi bcu dang*/ tshangs chen pas drug cu thub cing*/ 'od chung pas bskal chen gnyis dang*/ dge chung pas bcu drug dang*/ sprin med pas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ mi che bas stong dang*/ 'og min pas bskal chen khri drug stong thub ces bya ba'i bar ni sngar gyi rigs pas shes so// gzugs med bskal pa stong phrag ni// nyi shu lhag pas lhag pa yin// zhes pa ltar nam mkha' mtha' yas pas bskal chen nyi khri dang*/ rnam shes mtha' yas pas bzhi khri dang*/ ci yang med pas drug khri dang*/ srid pa'i rtse mo bas bskal chen brgyad khri thub bo// de dag la yang*/ sgra mi snyan ma gtogs pa 'chi// zhes pas sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe tshad ni nges pa can yin la/ gzhan rnams la ni tshe tshad ma rdzogs par 'chi ba yod do// 'on kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dga' ldan na bzhugs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa dang*/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i drung du mngags pa'i pho nya ba dang*/ dad pa dang chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang 'khor los sgyur mngal na yod pa'i yum la sogs pa rnams la'ang bar skabs su 'chi ba med pa'o// (409) 'jal byed ni// skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la// de yi skad cig de rnams kyang*// drug cu la ni thang cig go /yud tsam nyin zhag zla ba gsum// gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur// zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi// zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig

/ces pa la/ rnam 'grel du/ rdul phra rab gcig bla 'og bsgres pa'i dus lta bu chung ba yi// mthar thug dus ni skad cig 'dod// ces pa'am/ mdzod 'grel du/ chos mngon pa ba rnams ni skyes bu stobs ldan gyis se gol gtogs pa tsam la skad cig drug cu rtsa bzhi snga lung bzhin 'dra'o zhes pa'i tshad dang ldan pa'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma dang*/ de'ang drug cu la thang cig dang*/ thang cig sum cu la yud tsam dang*/ yud tsam sum cu la nyin zhag dang*/ nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba dang*/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ces bya'o// lo gcig dus bzhir 'jog pa ni// dbyar dgun ston dpyid re re yang*// zla ba gsum gsum bdag nyid de/ gsum pa'i ming ni/ */ra ba 'bring dang tha chung ngo*// zhes kyang sdom du byas pa ltar rig par bya ste/ zhag mi thub dor ba'i tshul ni/ mdzod 'grel du/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi// zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das nas// zla ba phyed ni lus pa na// mkhas pas zhag mi thub par dor// zhes pa ltar/ ston zla tha chung smin drug can gi tshes bcu drug nas brtsams te zla ba bzhi bzhi ni dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar gyi dus gsum yin la/ zla ba bzhi gsum bcu gnyis po de dag gi smin drug lta bu'i mar ngo re dang yar ngo re dang slar yar mar ngo re ste/ zla ba phye dang gnyis gnyis 'das nas zla ba phyed yar ngo re lus pa na/ mar ngo phyi ma mgo de'i gnam stong chad pa la gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa zhes brjod do// pas/ zla ba gnyis (410) gnyis na zhag mi thub re re 'dor ba'o// de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rgyal po'i sras kyis/ zla ba thams cad kyang mar gyi ngo snga ma ste zhes pa ltar dkyil 'khor 'grib pa'i cha tshes bcu drug pa nas mgo bzung ste yongs su rdzogs par gang bco lnga ba'i bar ni zla ba gcig yin la/

de la nam langs nas nam langs kyi bar gyi zhag phyed dang sum cu las med pas/ zhag de lnga bcu nga dgus zla ba gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir ro// thub pa dang mi thub pa'ang zla ba re re zhing spel mar 'byung la/ de la ni/ dbyar dang dgun gyi 'bring po la thub pa re dang ston dang dpyid kyi 'bring po la mi thub/ pa re'ang 'ong ngo*// ces kyang brjod de/ ra ba tha chung gis thub mi thub kyang de dag gi shugs las dbyar zla 'bring po thub pa na tha chung mi thub pa dang ston zla ra ba thub pa zhes bya ba la sogs par shes so// de ltar mi thub pa'i zhag drug po de dag bsags pa rnams bsnan pa dang bcas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis ni lo gcig go /de ltar na lo lnga lnga la zla shol re re 'byung bar rigs so zhe na/ lus du ra bas pa'i rnam bzhag de ltar yang gsungs shing*/ 'on phran tshegs kyi rigs pa rnams ni nang rig pa'i dbye ba yin pas kyang shol 'dor ba la sogs pa ni rgyal po'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o zhes gsungs la/ 'dul tshig me tog phreng rgyud du/ lo dang zla ba zla shol dag /rgyal po'i bka' yis kyang ni bsngags// bka' btsan grags ldan shes rab ldan// dpung ldan de yi rjes 'brang bya// zhes kyang gsungs mod/ de'ang zhag mi thub kyang bsags pa las zla shol 'byung ba ni ma yin gyi/ dgun nyi log nas log gi bar la lo gcig tu byas pa la dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis kyis mchog par zhag mi thub drug dang*/ de nas kyang zhag lnga tsam bsnan dgos par byung bas/ lo gsum gsum na zla (411) shol re re 'byung ba yin te/ rta bya byi ba yos la shol/ zla re 'byung bas rim pa ltar// rta lo la ston zla 'bring ba gnyis dgun byi ba lo la dpyid dang dbyar 'bring po gnyis// zhes zer ro// bskal pa'i tshad ni gzhung du 'chad par 'gyur ro// longs spyod kyis gtan la dbab pa la/

sdug bsngal dang*/ bde ba dang*/ kha zas dang*/ 'khrig pa'i longs spyod bzhi las/ sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod ni/ tsha dmyal brgyad na 'og thams cad lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi me lce rab tu 'bar bas khyab cing*/ phyogs thams cad lcags kyi ra bas kun nas bskor te/ me lce dpag tshad du mar 'phro ba'i nang du/ bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me bas kyang yang sos kyi mes tsha zhing*/ de bas kyang 'og ma 'og ma bzhi 'gyur gyis tsha ba'i mes rgyun mi 'chad par bsreg pa'i sdug bsngal dang ldan la/ khyad par du yang sos pa rnams la las kyi dbang gis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha rnon po sna tshogs pa lag tu byung ste/ thams cad phan tshun dgra'i 'du shes su gyur nas bsnun res byas pas shin tu sdug bsngal nas brgyal zhing sa la 'gyel ba na/ nam mkha' las khyed rnams yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra 'byung ba'am/ rlung grang mo langs pas slar yang sos te snga ma ltar sdug bsngal drug po las ma zad kyi bar du 'byung ba dang*/ thig nag pa rnams kyi lus la dmyal srung rnams kyis thig cha bzhi'am brgyad dam bcu drug la sogs pa du mar btab nas lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas gshog pa dang*/ ste'u dang s+t+wa re la sogs pas 'jog pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ bsdus 'joms pa rnams kyi lus rgyu tshogs pa na dmyal srung rnams kyis lcags kyi ri ra'i gdong pa lta bu dang*/ lug dang rta dang glang po che dang seng ge (412) dang stag gi gdong pa lta bu'i bar du 'jug cing*/ de ma thag ri de dag gis btsir bas bu ga thams cad nas khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa dang*/ yang 'dus pa na lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor chen pos bur shing ltar 'tshir ba dang*/ yang 'dus pa na lcags bsregs kyi gzhi la lcags kyi pha bong gi char 'bab pas brtul zhing 'joms pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ ngu 'bod pa rnams kyis gnas tshol du phyin pa na lcags kyi khang pa rnyed de der zhugs ma thag sgo 'gags shing phyogs thams cad nas me 'bar bas bsregs pas ngu zhing nyam thag pas 'bod kyang skyabs mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/

ngu 'bod chen po pas gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la lcags kyi khang pa nyis rim la sogs par chud pas sdug bsngal shin tu drag por myong ba dang*/ tsha ba pa rnams kyi lus lcags kyi phru ba dpag tshad du ma yod pa me 'bar ba'i nang du bcug nas nya bzhin du 'tshod pa dang*/ lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar bas gsham nas spyi bor phug ste bu ga dang ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas me 'bar ba dang*/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la bsgyel nas lcags kyi tho ba chen po me 'bar bas brdungs pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ rab tu tsha ba pa rnams kyi lus la lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pa me 'bar bas gsham nas spyi bo dang phrag pa gnyis su phug ste dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas me rab tu 'bar ba dang*/ lcags kyi leb ma me chen po 'bar bas lus la kun nas 'khri ba dang*/ lcags zangs 'gyur byed khol mas gang bar spyi tshugs su bcug nas 'tshed pa dang*/ sha khrag zad nas keng rus tsam lus pa lcags kyi sa gzhi la bkram pas sha khrag 'phral du skyes ma thag slar yang 'tshed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ mnar med pa rnams kyi lus la lcags kyi sa gzhi las phyogs (413) thams cad nas me rab tu 'bar ba 'ongs te des lpags pa dang sha dang rgyus pa dang rus pa dang rkang gi bar bsregs te me'i phung po chen po 'ba' zhig tu snang la nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin pa las sems can du mngon tsam dang*/ lcags kyi zhib ma chen por lcags kyi mdag ma me 'bar ba dang bsres nas rngod pa dang*/ lcags kyi ri me chen po 'bar ba la 'bab 'dzeg byed du bcug pa dang*/ lce phyungs te lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la brgyangs nas lcags kyi phur pa mang pos 'debs pa dang*/ lpags pa bshus te lcags kyi sa gzhi me 'bar ba la gan rkyal du bsgyel nas/ kha lcags kyi 'byed spyad kyis phye bar lcags kyi tho lum 'bar ba dang*/ zangs zhun bskol ba blugs pas kha dang lkog ma dang nang khrol rnams sreg cing smad nas phyir 'byung ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drag cing rtsub la rgyun mi 'chad pa myong ba ste/

gshin rje'i skyes bus lpags pa ma lus bshus pas shin tu nyam thag cing*// rab tu tsha ba'i me yis bzhus pa'i zangs zhugs lus la blugs gyur la// 'bar ba'i ral gri mdung thung gis bsnun sha yi dum bu brgyar blags pa// shin tu 'bar ba'i lcags kyi sa gzhir lhung ba mang pos mi dges 'gyur// zhes pa ltar ro// 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal 'ga' zhig yan man du'ang yod la gong ma gong ma'i sdug bsngal thams cad ni 'og ma 'og ma la tshang bar yod cing*/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi po thams cad tshang bas kyang sdug bsngal bar gnas pa'o// nye 'khor ba ni/ brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na// me ma mur dang ro myag 'dam// spu gri lam sogs chu bo yin// zhes pa ltar dmyal ba brgyad po thams cad kyi phyogs re re na'ang me ma mur la sogs pa bzhi bzhi yod (414) pas na bcu drug ste/ de'ang me ma mur gyi thang chen po pus mo nub tsam la phyin pa na rkang pa bzhag ma thag lpags pa dang sha khrag rnams sreg cing bteg ma thag 'tsho ba dang*/ ro myag phyi sa'i 'dam rdzab shin tu dri nga bar bying ba srin bu mchu rnon po can rnams kyis lpags pa nas rkang gi bar du phug ste za ba dang*/ spu gri'i so gyen du bstan nas bslangs te gtams pa'i lam la phyin pa na rkang pa bzhag ma thag gcod cing bteg ma thag 'tsho ba dang*/ ral gri'i lo ma'i nags tshal du grib ma la 'khod pa nas ral gri rnams lhung bas yan lag dang nying lag thams cad gcod cing*/ der brgyal te 'gyel ba na khyi sre bo dag lhags nas bshul sha 'thog cing za ba dang*/ lcags kyi shing shal ma la'i nags tshal du phyin pa na tsher ma rnon po sor bcu drug pa yan man du lta ba la 'bab 'dzeg byas pas lus kun nas 'bigs shing*/ der khwa lcags kyi mchu can 'ongs te phrag pa la 'khod nas mig 'bras 'thog cing za ba rnams ni mtshon char 'dra bas gcig tu byas pa dang*/

chu bo rab med ces bya ba thal tshan nam 'gyur byed kyi chu khol pas gang bar lus lhung ste ngos gnyis na skyes bu mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas srung zhing sha khrag thams cad zad nas khong rus rnams me tog kun da ltar gyur gyi bar du 'tshed la/ bar bar du lcags kyus phyung nas gan rkyal du bzhag nas ci 'dod ces dris pa na/ bdag cag gis ni ci'ang mi shes mi mthong mod/ 'on kyang bkres so skom mo zhes pa la thu lum 'bar ba dang zangs zhun khol ma khar ldug pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// dmyal srung rnams ni bye brag tu smra ba 'ga' zhig sems can du 'dod la/ chos ldan rab 'byor gyis/ gang dag khro zhing gtum pa dang*// sdig las mngon par dga' ba dang*// duḥkha ba la dga' de dag /gshin rje'i srin por skye bar 'gyur// zhes pa ni gshin rje'i sgo nas dmyal bar 'khrid mkhan la dgongs kyi/ der las byed mkhan ni min zer ro/ (415) /mdo sde pa ni las kyi mthus 'byung ba sa la sogs pa nyid de ltar snang bar 'dod cing*/ sa sde las kyang*/ las kyi dbang gis grub pa sprul pa lta bu 'byung bar gsungs la/ nyi shu par/ sems nyid de dag tu snang bar gsungs so// grang dmyal brgyad ni/ nyi zla la sogs pa'i snang ba med pa'i gnas mun pa'i khrod 'khyag pa'i sbubs chen po rnams su/ lus dang sgra'i rnam 'gyur dang mthun par shin tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal 'og ma 'og ma rnams ches drag par myong ba ste/ de yang sa nyid na yod pa'i rlung chen pos btab nas grang bas nyen pas lus thams cad chu bur du gyur pa can dang*/ de bas kyang grang bar gyur pas chu bur de yang rdol pa can dang*/ shin tu grang ches pas so tham tham pa dang*/ a chu zer ba dang*/ kyi hud zer pa dang*/ lpags pa sngon por gyur nas kha lnga'am drug tu gyes pa ut+pal ltar gas pa dang*/ sngo ba las kyang thal nas dmar por gyur cing kha bcu'am de bas kyang lhag par gyes pa pad+ma ltar gas pa dang*/

shin tu dmar bar gyur nas brgya'am stong la sogs par gyes pa pad+ma ltar cher gas pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa dang ldan pa'o// nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ gshed ma 'ga' zhig thal gong dang kha sna la bya gcan gyis 'thog par skyes pa dang*/ bshan pa'i slob ma rus gong dri nga ba la bya rog la sogs pas 'thog par skyes pa dang*/ nya pa 'ga' zhig lus lcags kyis dkris par skyes pa la sogs pa mdo sder gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dge 'dun srungs dang gro zhun skyes kyi rtogs brjod las 'byung ba lta bu'o// bshes spring du/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab

(416) sdug bsngal gang yin pa// de ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu'i yang*// 'ol yang mi bgyi char yang mi phod do// zhes pa ltar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med cing shin tu nyam nga ba ste/ rgyas par ni dam pa'i chos dran pa nyer gzhag la sogs pa las shes par bya'o// yi dwags la/ dran pa nyer gzhag tu gsungs pa ltar/ lto gug kha khab ltar phra dang*// bshang za kun ston dri za dang*// zhes pa la sogs pa rigs sum cu rtsa drug yod kyang bsdu na gsum las/ zas skom la phyi'i sgrib pa can ni bkres pa dang skom pas nyam thag pas lpags pa dang sha khrag rnams skams nas lus sdong dum mes tshig pa ltar gyur te kha skams pa la lces ldag cing rdzing bu la sogs par brgyugs pa na/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas bsrungs nas 'thung du mi 'jug la/ gal te ma bsrungs kyang chu rnams rnag khrag la sogs par mthong nas btung du mi rung ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la// lto ba ri yi ltos tsam bkres pas nyen// mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang*// 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so// zhes pa ltar gal te zas skom rnyed kyang khar mi shong ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas bza' btung mi nus pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ zas skom nyid la sgrib pa can ni/ gal te bza' btung nus kyang de dag me lce'i phreng ba la sogs par gyur nas sreg pa dang*/ bshang gci dang dri nga ba dang dug dang mchil ma dang ngar snabs la sogs pa ljan ljin za ba'i sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'o// dud 'gro rnams ni chu srin la sogs pa che bas chung ba mid de za ba dang*/ chung bas che ba'i lus phug ste za ba la sogs pa phan tshun gcig gis gcig gsod cing za ba'i sdug bsngal dang ldan zhing*/ khyad par klu rnams (417) ni nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyi char pas thams cad rus par thug par sreg pa dang*/ nam mkha' lding gis za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang ldan la/

kha 'thor ba rnams kyang rang dbang med par gsod pa dang rdeg 'tshog dang bkol ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs dang ldan pa ste/ kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan ni rdog pa lag pa dang*// lcag dang lcags kyu rnams kyis btag ste bkol// zhes pa ltar ro// mi rnams kyang bkres skom dang*/ tsha grang dang*/ 'gro 'ong dang*/ ngal dub dang*/ 'thab rtsod dang*/ gnod 'tshe dang*/ skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal brgyad dang yang ldan zhing*/ mdor na 'byor ldan rnams ni 'khor dang longs spyod ji tsam che ba ltar de dag bsrung ba'i sdug bsngal yang che la/ dbul po rnams ni 'dod pa'i yo byad kyis phongs nas nyam thag pas btsal yang ma rnyed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang ldan pa ste/ gcig ni bsrung bas nyon mongs la// gnyis pa tshol bas sha thang ngo*// phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung*// gang na'ang dga' ba med 'gyur ba// zhes pa ltar ro// 'dod lha rnams la/ bshes spring du/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang*// stan la lha gzhan mi dga' pa dang me tog phreng rnyings dang*// gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni// mchan khung gnyis nas/ sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi ba// mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed 'chi ltas lnga// zhes pa thabs kyis mi zlog pa rtsa ba'i 'chi ltas lnga dang*/ gos dang rgyan las sgra mi snyan pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'od chung ba dang*/ khrus kyi chu thigs lus la 'chags pa dang*/ g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can yang blo yul gcig la gnas pa (418) dang*/ mig 'byed 'dzum ste thabs kyis zlog rung nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga gang ba spel lha'i zhag lnga'i gong du 'byung ba dang*/ rang gi lha mo rnams lha gzhan dang dga' mgur spyod pa na sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba chen po 'byung zhing*/ khyad par ngan song du skye na skye gnas kyi sdug bsngal mngon sum du mthong nas sems kyi gdung ba dmyal ba bas kyang cher drag pa 'byung ba ste/

dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ lha yi gnas nas ltung ba dang*// sdug bsngal rab tu skye ba gang*// de la sems can dmyal ba yi// bcu drug char yang mi phod do// zhes pa ltar ro// gzhan yang lha bsod nams che ba mthong na chung ba rnams la dpa' gong ba dang mthu che bas chung ba skrod pa'i sdug bsngal yod cing*/ 'og ma gnyis la/ lha ma yin dang 'thab pa na gcod 'dral dang gsod pa'i sdug bsngal yang yod do// de yang lha rnams lha ma yin gyi bu mo mdzes ma 'dod pa dang*/ lha ma yin rnams lha'i bdud rtsi bzang po 'dod pas zhe 'gras nas/ ri rab kyi 'og gi khong gseng nas lha ma yin gyi dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi gser dang dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya dang man shel gyi go cha gyon te/ ral gri dang mdung dang 'phang mdung dang mda' gzhu la sogs pa'i mtshon cha thogs nas chas pa dang*/ dmag gi shugs kyis brgya byin gyi gdan 'gul ba las dmag 'ong bar shes so// de nas klu dang bang rim bzhi'i lha ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i srung ma lnga go mtshon sngar dang 'dra ba bzung ba rnams dang rim gyis 'thab cing*/ dang po klu dang 'thab pas lha min pham na rang gi gnas su ldog la/ gal te rgyal na chu mtshams nas 'thon te rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phags nas bang rim gyi lha rnams dang 'thab bo// de'i tshe dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ (419) lha'i gnas gsal bar bya ba'i ched du sgra can 'dzin gyis nyi ma dang zla ba lag pas sgrib cing*/ de dag gi rgyal 'pham dang skye dgu'i bde sdug 'dzam bu gling pa'i dge sdig la rag las par yang gsungs la/ des na zla ba'i mdor/ zla ba gzas zin pa na dge ba 'bum 'gyur dang*/ nyi ma zin pa na bye ba 'gyur du gsungs so zhes kyang 'chad do// de dag gis ma thub pa na rgyal chen bzhis brgya byin la/ lha'i dbang po mkhyen par mdzod cig bdag cag srung ma rnams ni lha min gyis pham par byas nas ri rab kyi steng du 'ongs so// zhes gsol ba btab pa dang*/

dbang pos gzhan rnams la bka' bsgo zhing*/ glang po che rab brtan yang dbang po'i bsam pa shes nas 'khor dang bcas pa 'phral la 'ongs te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i dpung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa chas nas rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du phyin pa na 'thab par 'dod blo skye zhing*/ de nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu thon nas ri rab kyi lho'am nub kyi phyogs su 'thab bo// dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ lha ma yin ri 'phen zhing*/ de rnams brgya byin gyi rdo rjes bcom pa'i dum bu rol mtsho rnams su lhung bas srog chags mang po shi nas mtsho rnams dmar por 'gyur bar gsungs so// lha rnams ni mgo dang rked pa chad na 'chi'i/ yan lag dang nying lag bcad pa las ni sdug bsngal drag po 'byung yang slar skye zhing 'tsho la/ lha ma yin rnams ni mi ltar gnad du phog pa las 'chi ste/ de rnams kyi gzugs brnyan gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du mtsho kun snang zhes bya ba la shar ba mthong nas/ dmag ma log pa'i gong du nye du rnams mya ngan gyis gdung bar gsungs so// phal cher ni lha rgyal zhing*/ gang pham pa de dag rang (420) gi grong khyer du zhugs pa las phan tshun gnod pas mi tshugs so// lha ma yin rnams ni lha'i 'byor pa chen po mthong nas phrag dog gis yid mi bde bas kyang rtag tu sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'o// gzugs dang gzugs med pa dag na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal med kyang nyon mongs pa dang ldan zhing sgrib pa dang bcas pas 'chi 'pho dang skye ba la rang dbang med pa'i phyir/ 'du byed gnas ngan len gyi sdug bsngal dang ldan pas 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal la spyod pa ste/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu me mtshon rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes bzhin// zhes pa ltar ro// bde ba'i longs spyod la/ sa sder/ dmyal ba bzhin bde ba myong ba med ces gsungs pa ni rnam smin las skyes pa med pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/

rgyu mthun las skyes pa cung zad yod de/ shā ri'i bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus bde ba myong ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs las lhas sbyin gyis bde ba myong bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mdzod 'grel du/ mnar med na bde ba gtan med la/ gzhan yang sos pa rnams la rlung bsil bas reg pa la sogs pa'i bde ba rgyu mthun las skyes pa yod par gsungs so// yi dwags rdzu 'phrul che ba chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang*/ dud 'gro klu'i rgyal po 'ga' zhig la ni lha'i dpal la spyod pa'i bde ba yod cing*/ glang po che rab brtan dang sa srung gi bu dang*/ rta rin po che la sogs pa la yang bde ba ji rigs pa yod do// mi rnams ni/ gdags par/ 'dzam bu gling na gtso cher gser dang dngul la nyo tshong dang longs spyod du byed cing*/ shar na ras dang be'u ras dang*/ nub ba lang spyod na nor bu la spyod de/ byang na ni longs spyod yongs su 'dzin pa med do// (421) 'di na kha zas 'bras chan dang*/ khur ba dang zan dang phye dang sha chang la sogs pa yod pa ltar shar dang nub na'ang yod la/ byang na ni ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu 'ba' zhig spyod do// 'di na char 'bab mkhas gling rnams su char 'bab pa'i rgyu brgyad de/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ grul bum lha mi rnams kyi nus mthu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ chos nyid dang*/ bden pa bskul bas 'bab pa rnams so// rgyu brgyad kyis char mi 'bab ste/ me'i khams 'phags nas skoms pa dang*/ rlung drag pos dgon pa stong par 'dor ba dang*/ sgra gcan gyis lag pas blangs nas rgya mtshor 'dor ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa'i lha'i bu bag med par 'gyur ba dang*/ mis chos min spyod pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyis dang*/ chos nyid kyis dang*/ bden pas bskul bas mi 'bab pa rnams so// bskal pa dang po'i mi bsod nams che bas sprin rnams dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis nas char 'bebs/

de nas dpag tshad gcig dang*/ bzhi cha dang*/ dpag tshad gcig dang dpag tshad bzhi cha gsum/ dpag tshad phyed dang*/ rgyang grags gcig dang*/ rgyang grags bzhi cha nas so// sa g.yo ba'i rgyu brgyad ni nam mkha' la rlung langs pas chu 'khrugs nas dang*/ rdzu 'phrul can gyis sa chung la chu che bar 'du shes bskyed pas dang*/ byang sems lhums su 'jug pa/ bltams pa dang*/ byang chub pa dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ sku tshe btang ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa na/ klu dbang che ba rnams mchod pa'i phyir steng du 'ongs pas chu 'khrugs nas g.yo ba'o/ mi mkhas las lo nyes dang de dag la brten pa'i longs spyod la 'phel 'grib dang*/ nyo tshong dang*/ kha dog du ma dang*/ khang pa ched du byas pa dang*/ gos stan lci ba dang*/ bag ma gtong len dang*/ rje khol dang*/ de dag la zhen pa yod pa ltar shar dang nub na'ang yod cing*/ byang na ni med de/ de na kha dog kyang dkar po kho na dang*/ khang pa'ang ched du ma byas pa'i sa khang 'ba' zhig dang*/ gos kyang dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i srang gcig pa kho na yod la/ gang la yang yongs 'dzin med par byis pa rnams kyang skyes ma thag 'dor zhing rang gi mthe bo las nu (422) zho 'byung bas 'tsho bar bshad do// mi'i nang nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i bde ba ni mchog yin zhing*/ de 'jig rten du 'byung ba na rin po che sna bdun 'byung ste/ sa 'grel du/ de tshes bco lnga la khrus byas nas gso sbyong la gnas shing blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor te 'dug pa na/ lha'i 'khor lo rin po che rtsibs stong dang ldan pa lte ba myu khyud dang bcas pa dag cing gtsang ba/ brgya byin gyi bkas las thams cad pas sprul te rgyal chen bzhi la brgyud nas lha'i pho nya bas shar phyogs nas 'bul bar gsungs shing*/ dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ gser gyi 'khor lo dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ rtsibs stong dang ldan zhing mdzes pa/ nyi ma gcig gis nam mkha' la dpag tshad 'bum du 'gro bar nus pa/

de'i mthus gling bzhi dang lha'i ris su yang glang po che la sogs pa de thams cad 'gro ba/ rgyal pos ma thos pa thos par byed cing 'gran zla su yang med par byed pa'o// nor bu ni zur brgyad dang ldan pa 'od sna tshogs 'phro zhing mtshan mo dpag tshad brgyar 'od 'byung ba dang*/ nyin par tsha ba na bsil bar byed cing skom pa na chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'byung ba/ rgyal pos ji bsam pa thams cad 'byung zhing las thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'grub pa dpag tshad brgyar nad med par byed cing myang ma dang g.yang sa'i yul thams cad kyang ljon shing mtshe'u la sogs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba/ mi rnams la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba med par byed cing srog chags gdug pa can dag gis kyang gnod pa med pa zhig dbang pos gnang bar 'gyur ro// btsun mo ni lus la tsan+dan dang kha la ut+pa la'i dri 'byung zhing reg pa na nyon mongs pa med par 'gyur ba/ gling de'i bkres skom dang mya ngan sel bar byed cing rgyal pos (423) mthong ba na grang dus dro ba dang dro dus bsil bar byed pa ma dang sring mo ltar thams cad kyi bsam pa dang mthun zhing bu mang po btsa' ba/ khyim thab bud med gzhan dang 'grogs kyang phrag dog mi 'byung zhing 'dod yon gyi dbang du mi 'gyur ba zhig blon pos 'bul te shi 'phos nas lhar skye ba'o// blon po ni mkhas shing gsal la yid gzhungs pas bya ba thams cad ma bslabs par shes nas rgyal po'i bsam pa dang mthun par sgrub pa la skyo ba med pa/ mi dge ba spangs shing skye rgu thams cad la pha ltar phan 'dogs pa'o// glang po ni cang shes shing bka' nyan pa glang po che stong gi stobs yod pa chu dang skam dang bar snang la g.yul 'gyed cing pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa/ nyin gcig la 'dzam bu gling lan du mar bskor bar nus pa/ skud pas kyang dkrir rung zhing rgyal pos zhon pa na gang 'dod par bskul mi dgos par dal gyis 'gro ba zhig brgya byin gyi bkas gnang bar 'gyur te/

sa 'grel du/ glang po che rab brtan gyi bu thu bo'o zhes so// rta mchog kyang ku mud dang dung ltar dkar ba glang po che dang yon tan mtshungs pa zhig dbang pos gnang ste/ sa 'grel du/ rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyi bu thu bor gsungs so// khyim bdag ni longs spyod che zhing lha'i mig gis gter mthong ba/ bang mdzod thams cad rin po ches 'gengs shing nor gyi sgo nas rgyal po'i don sgrub pa/ g.yo sgyu med cing gzhan la mi gnod pa skye bo thams cad dga' bar byed pa'o// rgyal po'i sras kyis/ khyim bdag ni mdzod kyi spyan lta bu dang blon po ni dmag gi spyan lta bu'o zhes bshad do// de bzhin du/ ral gri lpags pa khang pa tshal// mal cha gos dang l+h+wam gyi mchog /ces pa'i nye ba'i rin po che bdun yang 'byung ste/ (424) rgyal po dang 'gal ba byed 'dod pa der song nas ma btab kyang kun gyis 'dud par byed pa'i ral gri dang*/ klu'i lpags pa chur dpag tshad 'bum dang zheng du lnga yod pa/ char gyis mi brlan zhing*/ rlung gis mi bskyod pa/ grang dus na dro zhing dro dus na bsil bar byed pa/ bud med mi sdug pa mi mthong zhing nyi zla'i 'od snang ba'i lpags pa dang*/ chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis dang zheng du dpag tshad lnga yod pa/ rin po che dang zla ba dang rgyu skar rnams kyang lta bar 'dod na de nyid du 'ong ba/ bde bar gnyid du 'gro zhing rmi lam dge ba mthong ba/ grang dus su dro zhing dro dus su bsil ba'i khang pa dang*/ lha rdzas kyi me tog dang ljon shing la sogs pas brgyan zhing*/ lha'i bu mo rnams 'ongs nas rol mo sna tshogs pa byed pa dang lhan cig 'dod yon la rtse ba'i tshal dang*/ yang zhing 'jam la bsam gtan dang mthun pa/ der 'dug na rnam par grol zhing blo gsal la kun nas nyon mongs pa mi 'byung ba'i mal cha dang*/ thags bzang zhing 'jam la dri ma med pa/ gyon pa na tsha grang dang bkres skom dang ngal dub kyis mi gnod la/

mes mi 'tshig cing mtshon gyis mi chod pa'i gos dang*/ gon pa na chu la mi 'bying zhing*/ yud tsam gyis dpag tshad brgyar 'gro ba la yang ngal ba cung zad kyang mi 'byung ba'i l+h+wam rnams so// gzhan yang btsun mo'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang*/ mi stong phrag re thub pa'i bu stong dang*/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang*/ dgra sde zil gyis gnon pa'i mda' gzhu dang*/ rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo las/ rin po che'i khyad par in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa 'khor dang longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'o// 'byung ba'i dus ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung ba ni// stong phrag brgyad cu las mi 'phyi//

(425) zhes pa ltar ro// de man chad du phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par rnams mi rdzogs pas tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri'i bar la 'byung ngo*// khyad par ni/ gser rgyang grags bzhi dngul gsum zangs gnyis lcags gcig 'khor lo can// de dag gling gcig gling gnyis dang*// gsum dang bzhi la mas rim bzhin// lhan cig gnyis min sangs rgyas bzhin// zhes pa ltar gling bzhi ka la dbang byed pa gser gyi 'khor lo can dang*/ byang ma gtogs pa gsum la dbang byed pa dngul gyi 'khor lo can dang*/ 'di dang shar la dbang byed pa zangs kyi 'khor lo can dang*/ 'di kho na la dbang byed pa lcags kyi 'khor lo can dang bzhi'o// de rnams kyang zhing khams gcig tu sangs rgyas gnyis gcig car mi 'byung bye brag smra bas lo ka ba'i khams thams cad du dus gcig la sangs rgyas gcig las mi 'byung ste/ phrin las thogs med yin pas gdul bya thams cad gcig kho nas 'dul nus pa'i phyir de dang mnyam pa 'ga' yang med pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro// phal chen pa lo ka'i khams gcig la dgongs kyi gzhan na ni yod zer te/ theg bsdus su gling bzhi pa gcig la dgongs/ ba ltar/ mnga' ris gcig la rgyal po gnyis gcig car mi 'byung bar rim gyis 'byung ste/ 'gran zla med pa'i las kyis grub pa'i phyir ro// de dag gis rgyal bar byed tshul yang*/ phas bsu rang 'gro g.yul bshams dang*// mtshon brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med// ces pa ltar gser gyi 'khor lo can gang bgrod pa'i phyogs der khams kyi rgyal phran rnams kyis bsus nas phyag 'tshal te/ 'byor pa rgyas pa dang bde ba dang lo legs pa dang skye bo mang pos gang ba'i ljongs 'di dag ni lha'i lags kyis/ lhas 'di dag la legs par rjes su bstan du gsol/ bdag cag ni lha'i rjes su mchi ba lags so zhes (426) gsol ba dang*/ des gtso bo dag de'i phyir khyed cag rang rang gi ris su gtogs pa rnams la chos kyi rjes su ston cing*/

chos ma yin pa ma byed cig khyed kyis chos ma yin pa spyod pa dang log par spyod pa rnams yul du 'dug tu ma gzhug cig ces bka' bsgo zhing*/ de bzhin du rjes su sgrub par yang byed do// dngul gyi 'khor lo can gyis de dag gi thad du rang nyid song ba tsam gyis 'dul zhing*/ zangs kyi 'khor lo can gyis song ste g.yul bshams pa tsam gyis 'dul la/ lcags kyi 'khor lo can gyis g.yul bshams nas rdeg mi dgos par mtshon cha brtsams pa tsam gyis 'dul te/ thams cad kyi phyogs las rgyal yang gnod pa med par khrims dge ba bcu la bkod nas rgyal srid chos dang mthun par skyong bas phyi ma la lhar skye bar gsungs so// de dag ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kyang mi gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ 'khor los bsgyur ba thams cad la// 'di dag yod par 'dod mod kyi// dag dang mdzes dang gsal ba ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyi char mi phod// ces pa ltar ro// 'di'i rgyu ni mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang*/ byams pa bsgoms pa la sogs pa ste/ mdzangs blun dang*/ seng ge yi dam brtan pas rang nyid gsod pa'i rngon pa la byams pa bsgoms pas bskal pa mang du 'khor los bsgyur bar skyes par bshad pa ltar ro// 'dod lha'i bde ba ni thams cad na sa gzhi shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar reg na 'jam pa/ tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis mig mangs ris su bris pa dang*/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba'i rdzing bu yid du 'ong ba dang*/ mtsho me tog sna tshogs dang bya skad snyan pa 'byin pas brgyan pa dang*/ 'dod yon la rtse ba'i (427) skyed mos tshal phun sum tshogs pa rnams yod cing*/ gnas gser dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ man shel las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang bsil khang dang stegs bu dang skar khung dra ba can nor bu'i tshogs kyis spras pa/

'od zer sna tshogs pa'i snang ba 'gyed pas mchog tu mdzes shing nyams dga' bar/ lus phyi nang thams cad gtsang zhing rngul dang dri ma dang rus pa dang rtsa rgyus dang nang khrol dang bshang gci med pa/ 'od dang ldan zhing rab tu mdzes pa/ gos srab cing 'jam la srang phyed nas drug cu rtsa bzhi cha'i bar shin tu yang ba reg na bde ba kha dog sna tshogs pa gser gyis spras pa rnams gyon zhing*/ rgyan rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i nor bu dang rna rgyan dang gdu bu dang mgul rgyan dang ska rags dang do shal la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa/ 'khor lha'i bu dang bu mo gzhon nus sil snyan dang rol mo sna tshogs pa 'dzin pas yongs su bskor te/ longs spyod bza' ba bdud rtsi sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang dmar po rnams 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ btung ba sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang la sogs pa 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ bzhon pa shing rta dang khyogs dang khyogs g.yog la sogs pa 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ gos dang rgyan gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ spos dang bdug pa dang me tog dang phreng ba rnams 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ bzhad gad dang glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang*/ snod spyad dang yo byad sna tshogs pa 'byung ba'i ljon shing rnams las gang 'dod pa mdun du 'byung ba la spyod cing*/ dus dus su bag med pa las skul bar byed pa'i rnga bo che'i sgra la brten nas dam pa'i chos kyi bde ba la spyod do// thams cad na ba dang rga ba dang bkres pa dang skom (428) pa dang phongs pa'i sdug bsngal ni med la/ sa gzhi thams cad me tog man dā ra ba pus mo nub tsam gyis mdzes par khebs pa'i rnying pa rnams rlung gis 'dor zhing gsar pa rnams 'grems pa'i bde ba dang yang ldan te/ dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang rkyen gyis// lha yi grong du rlung chen ldang*// me tog rnying pa 'dor byed cing*// me tog gsar pa legs par 'grems// zhes pa ltar ro// khyad par sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i rtsi tshul ni/

gdags pa dang dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs su/ shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal na glang po che sa srungs kyi bu gzugs bzang mdzes pa dkar ba/ yan lag rkang lag mjug ma zegs pa rlig pa 'doms kyi gnas na 'dug pa dang*/ sna lag par gnas pa ste'o/ bdun legs par gnas pa/ mgo dmar ba mche ba drug dang ldan pa/ srid du dpag tshad gcag dang khor yug tu bdun yod pa/ 'khor glang po brgya stong dang ldan pa gnas te/ skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba na de'i mgo bo sum cu rtsa gsum du sprul zhing*/ mgo bo re re la mche ba drug drug dang*/ mche ba re rer rdzing bu bdun bdun dang*/ rdzing bu re re la pad ma'i sdong po bdun bdun dang*/ pad ma re re la lha mo bdun bdun dang*/ lha mo re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang*/ g.yog mo re re la 'khor sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun yod par sprul nas/ mgo dbus ma la dbang po dang*/ gzhan rnams la nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ glang po che gzhan rnams la 'khor rnams zhon te/ 'gro ba mi mngon pa lta bu'i mgyogs pas yud kyis skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong bar phyin nas/ glang po'ang lha'i lus su sprul zhing*/ thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod par gsungs so// de bas kyang gong ma gong ma (429) rnams 'dod yon gyi bde ba lhag par yod la/ dga' ldan ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi drung na rtag tu theg pa chen po'i chos la spyod pas kyang lhag cing*/ der 'gro bar 'dod pas ni dam pa'i chos la 'bad par rigs te/ dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang*// shes rab ldan zhing thar pa 'dod// yon tan rnams la dga' ba'i mi// de rnams dga' ldan nye bar 'gro// zhes pa lta ro// khams gong ma dag ni 'dod yon gyi bde ba la 'dod chags dang bral nas ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa ste/ de yang*/ sa sder/ gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi po rnams su btang snyoms dang dran pa yongs su dag pa dang zhi ba'i bde ba mi g.yo ba can myong ba dang*/

gzugs med pa rnams su zhi ba dang rnam par thar pa'i bde ba khyad par can myong bar gsungs so// kha zas kyi longs spyod la/ sa sder/ dmyal ba ni/ rlung rgyu ba'i kha zas phra bas gnas par gsungs shing*/ mdzod 'grel du ni/ thu lum dang zangs zhun dag kyang bkres pa dang skom pa sel bas kha zas yin la/ nyi tshe ba rnams la kha zas mi dang 'dra ba yod par yang bshad do// yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi rnams ni kha zas rags pas 'tsho zhing*/ bskal pa dang po'i mi dang*/ mer mer po la sogs pa'i sems can dang*/ bar do dang*/ lha rnams ni kha zas phra bas 'tsho la/ khams gong ma dag ni kham zas la 'dod chags dang bral ba'o// 'khrig pa'i longs spyod ni/ dmyal ba na sdug bsngal drag po rgyun du 'byung bas med la/ yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi rnams la yod cing khu ba pho ba'ang yod do// 'dod lha rnams la/ gnyis (430) gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang*// dgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin// zhes pa ltar dang po ris bzhi rtsa gsum gnyis na gnyis gnyis sprod pa dang*/ gong ma bzhin rim pa ltar 'thab bral na 'khyud pa dang*/ dga' ldan na/ lag pa nas 'dzin pa dang*/ 'phrul dga' na/ dgod pa dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed na/ mig tshugs su lta ba'i 'khrig pa yod de/ khu ba 'byung ba ni med cing mtshan gyi sgo nas rlung nyi tshe 'byung bas gdung ba dang bral bar byed do// gling gsum dang yi dwags rdzu 'phrul che ba dang 'dod lha 'og ma bzhi la bag ma gtong len dang*/ chung ma 'chang ba yod kyi/ sgra mi snyan pa dang gong ma gnyis na med cing*/ lha mo rnams la mngal gyi gnas med pas phrag pa'am pang par brdzus te skyes pa la pha ma'i tha snyad byed do// de yang 'dod lha drug tu rim pa ltar ris bzhi pa na byis pa lo lnga pa nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed na lo bcu'i bar gyi bong tshod du skye la/ gzugs khams yan chad 'khrig pa la 'dod chags dang bral zhing*/

lus yongs su rdzogs pa gos dang bcas pa skye ste/ lha thams cad 'phags pa'i skad du smra/ byis pa lo lnga lon pa nas// lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar// de dag tu skye gzugs can rnams// kun rdzogs gos dang bcas pa nyid// ces pa ltar ro// 'dod khams ni ngo tsha khrel yod shas chung bas phal cher gcer bur skye zhing*/ rgyal bu don grub dang khye'u gser mdog la sogs pa gos dang bcas pa skye ba'ang yod la/ brgya byin ni yongs su rdzogs par skye bas snga phyi brje ba'ang mi shes te/ 'dod lha gzhan rnams kyang lus myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ro// skye tshul gyis gtan la dbab pa ni/ 'dod pa skye ba gsum po ni// 'dod pa'i lha dang mir bcas rnams// bde ba skye ba gsum po ni// bsam gtan (431) gsum la sa dgu yin// zhes pa ltar mi dang 'dod lha dang po bzhi 'dod pa grub zin nye bar gnas pa la dbang byed pa'i skye ba dang*/ 'phrul dga' 'dod pa rang gis sprul pa la dbang byed pa'i skye ba dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa 'dod pa gzhan gyis sprul pa la dbang byed pa'i skye ba ste 'dod pa'i skye ba gsum dang*/ bsam gtan dang po na dben pa las skyes pa'i bde ba can dang*/ gnyis pa na ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i bde ba can dang*/ gsum pa na dga' ba med pa'i bde ba can gyi skye ba de gsum la gnas gzhan gsum gsum du skye bas dgu'o// gzhan yang*/ der ni sgo nga las skyes sogs// sems can skye gnas bzhi dag tu// mi dang dud 'gro rnam pa bzhi// dmyal ba rnams dang lha rnams dang*// srid pa bar ma brdzus te skye// yi dwags mngal nas skye ba'ang yin// zhes pa ltar sems can thams cad skye gnas bzhis bsdus shing*/ mi dang dud 'gro gnyis la bzhi tshang bar yod de/ mi sgo nga las skyes pa ni khrung khrung mo la skyes pa gnas brtan brag dang nye ba'i brag dang*/

ri dwags 'dzin ma'i bu sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ rgyal po lnga len gyi bu brgya lta bu yin zhing*/ drod gsher las skyes pa ni rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo nas nga las nu dang*/ de'i brla g.yas pa las mdzes pa dang*/ g.yon pa las nyer mdzes dang*/ chu shing gi sdong po las a mra skyong ma skyes pa lta bu yin la/ brdzus skyes ni bskal pa dang po'i mi dang*/ phyis kyang 'phags pa lha sing ga gling pa'i rgyal po'i ldum rar pad+ma las skyes pa lta bu'o// dud 'gro spyi rigs la'ang skye gnas bzhi ka yod cing*/ khyad par klu dang nam mkha' lding lta bu re re la'ang tshang bar yod de/ gdags par/ nam mkha' lding (432) brdzus skyes kyi klu skye gnas bzhi ka dang*/ drod gsher skyes kyis brdzus skyes ma gtogs pa gsum dang*/ mngal skyes kyis mngal skyes sgong skyes gnyis dang*/ sgong skyes kyis sgong skyes kho na za bar bshad pa lta bu'o// brdzus skyes la ro med kyang ma shi ba'i bar bza' ba'i ched du 'dren pa'am ma shi bar du za ba'o// dmyal ba dang lha dang bar do thams cad brdzus skyes yin la/ yi dwags kyang phal cher brdzus skyes yin zhing*/ mngal skyes kyang yod de/ mau'u 'gal gyi bu la/ yi dwags mos smras pa/ bdag gis mtshan mo bu lnga dang*// de bzhin nyin mo bu lnga dag /bskyed nas de dag za mod kyi// 'on kyang bdag ni tshim pa med// ces pa ltar ro// sgong skyes dang mngal skyes dang drod gsher skyes dang brdzus skyes rnams ni rim pa ltar phyi ma bzang zhing*/ khyad par brdzus skyes la brten pa ni mang bar yang gnas so// de ltar brdzus skyes mang zhing bzang yang*/ gzhon nu don grub mngal skyes la brten pa ni nye du'i 'brel pas shākya'i rigs chen po chos la gzud ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rigs yin no zhes rim gro skyed du gzhug pa'i phyir dang*/

mir gyur pas kyang grub pa 'di thob bo zhes gdul bya rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ mu stegs pa'i gzhung las bskal pa brgya 'das nas sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu mas 'jig rten thams cad bslu bar 'gyur ro// zhes 'byung bas de lta bur dogs pa spang pa'i phyir dang*/ sku gdung ring bsrel gyis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa mtho ris dang thar pa la dgod par bya ba'i phyir ro// lus kyis gtan la dbab pa ni/ lus thob pa 'chi 'pho tshul gyis sgo nas phye na mu bzhi ste/ de yang lus thob pa gang rang gi sems kyis 'chi 'pho'i gzhan gyi sems kyis ma yin pa (433) 'dod pa'i lha rtsed mos myos pa dang*/ yid 'khrug par byed pa rnams dang*/ gzhan gyi sems kyis 'chi 'pho'i rang gis ma yin pa mngal na gnas pa dang*/ sgo nga na gnas pa rnams dang*/ rang gi sems dang gzhan gyi sems gnyis ga'i rkyen gyis 'chi 'pho ba 'dod pa'i khams su skyes shing dbang po rdzogs pa phal che ba rnams dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ga'i sems kyis ma yin par 'chi 'pho ba gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i lha rnams dang*/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang*/ rgyal bas btang ba'i pho nya ba dang*/ mthong lam pa dang*/ 'gog pa dang byams pa dang nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang*/ bar do dang*/ sngar dus min dang*/ 'chi bar bshad pa rnams so// rgyu rkyen gyis gtan la dbab pa rnams ni/ mdor bsdu na sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin yang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa 'byung zhing*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i las zag pa dang bcas pa spyad pa las/ 'khor ba pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams grub pa ste/ rgyud bla mar/ tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi rang bzhin la gnas te// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed kyis// las dang nyon mongs rab tu phye// las dang nyon mongs chu las ni// phung po skye mched khams rnams 'byung*// zhes pa ltar ro// de yang las mi dge ba spyad pa las ngan 'gro'i phung po sogs 'grub cing*/

dge ba spyad pa las bde 'gro'i phung po sogs 'grub pa ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun// de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do// dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang*// rnam pa kun tu bde ba dag /ces pa

(434) ltar ro// de bas na sdug bsngal spang bar 'dod pa rnams kyis ni sdig pa mi dge bar 'gyur ba mtha' dag spang bar bya'o// spyod 'jug tu/ sdig pa byed pa bde 'dod kyang*// gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba// de dang der ni sdig pa des// sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam 'joms gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bde ba la spyad par 'dod pa rnams kyis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba la ci nus kyis 'bad par bya ste/ yid la bsam pa'i dge byas pas// gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba// de dang der ni dge ba des// 'bras bu'i yon gyis mngon mchod 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rgya cher ni bshad zin zhing 'chad par yang 'gyur ro// brtan pa'i 'jig rten la/ skye ba'i gnas gang zhe na/ sems can gyi gnas sam snod du gyur cing rab tu 'jig pa dang ldan pas na snod kyi 'jig rten to zhes spyir bstan nas so sor 'chad pa la/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten bstan pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bshad pa'o// stong gsum gyi gnas tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho'i phyag gi mthil na rlung gi dkyil 'khor mang po brtsegs pa'i steng na sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po gnas shing*/ de'i steng na spos chu'i rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa yod pa'i re re'i steng na'ang stong gsum 'khor dang bcas pa nyi shu brtsegs ma re re gnas te/ de thams cad la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhes bya'o// de'i tshe nang gi dbus ma ze ba yid du 'ong zhing 'od zer mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i pad+ma la/ phyogs kun nas rin po che 'bar ba'i 'od rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i zhing*/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs kyis bskor ba yod la/ (435) de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams ming can nyi shu re re la'ang zhing gcig nas nyi shu'i bar rang rang gi grangs kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskor ba yod cing*/

de rnams kyi steng 'og gi bar na yang 'jig rten gyi khams zhing gi rdul snyed re re yod pa las/ mi mjed 'di ni zhing ming can rnams kyi 'og ma nas bgrang ba'i bcu gsum pa yin par gsungs shing*/ 'di ma dag pa'i zhing yin yang*/ bsod nams kyi 'gyur khyad gzhan pas che ste/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa'i/ mdo las/ gang gis bskal pa bye bar zhing gzhan du// sems ldan dam chos 'dzin par 'gyur ba bas// su dag snga dro tsam zhig mi mjed du// 'di ni de bas mchog tu mkhas pa dgongs// zhes pa ltar ro// khyad par gling bzhi pa re re'i gnas tshul ni ri rab thams cad kyi dbus na grong gi gtso bo ltar gnas shing*/ de'i phyi rol nas gser gyi ri bdun ni lcags chung bdun rim pa ltar gnas la/ de nas gling bzhi gling phran rnams ni phyogs so so na grong gi 'khor lta bur gnas te/ phyi ma khor yug chen po ni grong gi lcags ri lta bur gnas so zhes bkod tshul thun mong du bstan nas/ de dag khyad par du 'chad pa la/ rten gzhi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ brten pa snod kyi gnas tshul bshad pa'o// rten ni mdo las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten// de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten// zhes pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi khams chags pa'i thog mar nam mkha'i dbyings su rlung gi dkyil 'khor tshan po che chen po'i rdo rjes kyang gzhig par mi nus shing sra ba/ rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum yod pa/ rgyar grangs kyi gnas tha ma'am bgrang du med (436) pa dang bcas pa zhig chags te/ de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi// gnas par 'dod pa'i 'og dag gi /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su ni// sa ya drug 'bum grangs med do// zhes pa ltar ro// de la ni chu'i dkyil 'khor brten to// zhes pas de'i steng du char chen po 'bab pa rnams 'og gzhi dang glo na gnas pa'i rlung gis skyor ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor rngams su 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag nyi shu yod pa zhig chags la/

de la ni sa'i dkyil 'khor ro zhes pa de nyid rlung gis bsrubs pa las stod kyi cha rnams gser gyi sa gzhir gyur nas rngams su sum 'bum nyi khrir mthug pa zhig chags shing*/ de'i tshe chu'i dpangs 'bum phrag brgyad par 'gyur te/ chu rngams 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang*// stong phrag dag ni nyi shu 'o// phyis ni rngams su 'bum phrag brgyad// lhag ma dag ni gser du 'gyur// zhes pa ltar ro// de dag gi thad ka'i rgyar ni/ chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gyi// thad kar 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang*// stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag ni// phyed dang lnga rnams kho na 'o// zhes pa ltar ro// khor yug ni sum 'gyur ro// zhes zlum po thams cad kyi mtha' skor la thad ka'i sum 'gyur yin pas/ dpag tshad sa ya gsum dang drug 'bum khri sum brgya lnga bcu'o// sar dpag tshad kyi grangs ma gsungs la/ kha cig gsum ka stong gsum dang rgya mnyam par bzhed cing*/ kha cig gsum ka gling bzhi ka dang grangs mnyam par yang bzhed do// brten pa la gling bzhi pa dang*/ stong spyi phud dang*/ stong gnyis pa bar ma dang*/ stong gsum bshad pa'o// dang po la/ ri gling rgya mtsho'i gnas tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i gnas gzhan so sor bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la ni ri rab dang zhes pa (437) gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du char 'bab pa rnams rlung gis bsrubs pa las dbus su ri rab lhun po gru bzhi pa/ shar dngul dang lho bai ḍūr+ya dang nub shel mdo las shel dmar po gsungs dmar po dang byang gser las grub pa/ gdags par shar shel dang nub dngul du bshad/ de'i mthu las nam mkha' dang rgya mtsho yang phyogs so so'i kha dog dang mthun par snang ba ste/ lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin// chu yi nang du brgyad khri dag /nub bo chu yi steng du yang*// dpag tshad dag ni brgyad khri 'o// zhes pa ltar ro// gser gyi ri bdun dang*/

zhes pa ni ri rab mtha' skor du/ gser las grub pa thig shing ltar rang rang gi dpangs dang rgya mnyam pa'i gru bzhi nar mo/ chu nang du thams cad kyang dpag tshad brgyad khri nub pa/ rtse mo'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba las ming du btags nas/ de la lhun po gnya' shing 'dzin// gshol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldeng can// de bzhin lta na sdug ri dang*// rta rna dang ni rnam 'dud dang*// mu khyud 'dzin ri'o zhes pa ltar te/ sa sder/ bar ma lnga'i ming de las go rim zlog par yang gsungs so// brgyad po 'phang du phyed phyed dbri// de dag rngams su 'phang dang mnyam// zhes pa ltar chu mtshams yan chad phyi ma phyi ma rnams phyed phyed kyis dma' bas mchod rten bang rim ltar gnas pa ste/ gnya' shing 'dzin gyis ri rab kyi phyed du sleb pa la bzhi khri dang*/ phyi ma rnams la rim pa ltar nyi khri dang*/ khri dang*/ lnga stong dang*/ nyis stong lnga brgya dang*/ stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang*/ drug brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// gling bzhi dang zhes pa ni phyogs bzhi na thams cad kyang rtsa ba gser gyi sa gzhi la gnas pa/ rtse mo dbyibs dang tshad mi 'dra ba ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling de ngos gsum la// stong phrag gnyis so shing rta'i dbyibs// gcig (438) la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi// zhes pa ltar ngos ring ba gsum la stong phrag gnyis gnyis te drug dang*/ thung ba phyir bstan pa la dpag tshad phyed bzhi yod pa dang*/ shar gyi lus 'phags zla gam 'dra// ngos gsum 'di dang 'dra gcig la// dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu 'o// zhes pa ltar ngos ring ba gsum la stong phrag drug dang thung ba nang du bstan pa la sum brgya lnga bcu yod pa dang*/ ba lang spyod gling zlum po ste// stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yin no// de yi dbus la phyed dang gsum// zhes pa mtha' skor du bdun stong lnga brgya dang dbus kyi thad ka la stong phrag phyed dang gsum yod pa dang*/ sgra mi snyan brgyad gru bzhir mnyam// zhes pa ltar ngos re la stong phrag gnyis gnyis te brgyad yod pa'o// sa sder/

lho la drug stong lnga brgya dang shar la bdun stong yod par yang bshad cing*/ sgra chen po'i mdo/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo/ rdo 'phang ba'i mdo/ rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ mdo las/ lho la bdun stong dang*/ shar la brgyad stong dang*/ nub la dgu stong dang*/ byang la stong phrag bcu par yang gsungs so// byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdor// de tshe 'dzam bu'i gling 'di yang*// chu zheng tha gru mnyam par ni// dpag tshad stong phrag bcu pa 'o// zhes kyang 'byung ngo*// gling 'di'i khyad par ni/ mdzod 'grel las/ de'i dbus su gser gyi rang bzhin can gyi sa gzhi gang la byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skyed par mdzad pa rdo rje'i gdan mngon par 'grub ste/ ting nge 'dzin de ni lus sam sa phyogs gzhan gyis bzod par nus pa ma yin no// zhes pa ltar/ dbus na ni gnas gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i gdan yod cing*/ gzhan yang*/ 'di nas byang na ri nag po// dgu 'das gangs ri'o de nas ni// spos ngad ldan pa'i tshu rol (439) na// chu zheng lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho// zhes pa ltar yul dbus sam mnyan yod la sogs pa 'di nas byang phyogs su ri nag po gsum tshan gsum 'das pa na ri'i rgyal po gangs ri yod la/ de'i byang phyogs na ri spos kyi ngad ldan yod cing*/ de'i dpag tshad bcu'i tshu rol mtsho ma dros pa der rdzu 'phrul med pa'i mis bgrod par mi nus te/ lung sman gzhi las/ gnod sbyin gtum po mi bzad gnas pa yid 'ong zhing*// me tog sna tshogs shing gis rnam par mdzes byas pa// de la rgya mtsho dug can dag tu 'gro ba yi// chu bo chen po bzhi ngo 'di dag phyogs bzhir 'bab// gad+gā sin+dhū de bzhin pak+ṣu dang*// si tā de las rdzu 'phrul stobs thob pa// ma gtogs mi rnams kyis ni mi bgrod pa// der ni thub pa dge bdun bcas pa bzhugs/

zhes so/ zhes bya ba chu zheng la dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa/ 'og gzhi gser gyi bye ma brdal ba la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ ngos thams cad rin po che'i rtsig pa lta bur gnas pa/ bsil zhing mngar ba la sogs pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa yod de/ gdags par/ de'i dbus na klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa'i pho brang rin po che las grub pa yod cing*/ phyogs bzhi nas rim pa ltar glang po che dang rma bya dang rta dang seng ge'i kha nas shar du chu gad+gā dang*/ lhor sin+dhū dang*/ nub tu pak+ṣu dang*/ byang du shī ta rnams chu klung lnga brgya lnga brgya dang lhan cig rgya mtshor 'bab par bshad la/ phal po cher/ de rnams kyang rin po che sna tshogs kyi bye ma 'dren zhing*/ mtsho la g.yas skor lan bdun bdun byas nas phyogs bzhir 'gro bar gsungs so// gangs ri dang nye ba na brag gser gyi bya skyibs su 'dug pa lha min gyi ngos zhes bya ba tshad mtsho ma dros pa dang mnyam pa 'phangs byed dang bzhi pa khor yug na gser gyi brag bya skyibs brgyad stong yod pa shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba yod la/ de'i byang phyogs na dpag tshad nyi shu shing (440) sā la'i rgyal po rab brtan zhes bya ba/ rtsa ba 'dom bzhi bcu rtsa dgu mthur du zug pa/ sā la'i phreng ba rim dang po 'dom bcu gsum thur du zug pa phyi ma rnams 'dom re re phri ba yal ga rnams phyi ma la reg pa'o/ bdun gyis bskor ba yod cing*/ de'i shar phyogs na rdzing bu dal gyis 'thor zhes bya ba chu bsil zhing mngar bas gang ba/ pad+ma shin tu che bas khebs pa/ rdzing bu lnga brgyas bskor ba yod de/ de rnams su glang po che rab brtan glang po che lnga brgyas bskor nas pad+ma'i rtsa ba za zhing gzugs 'dod rgur bsgyur te bde bar spyod do// gzhan yang gling 'di na gnas 'jog gi mdor yul chen po bcu drug yod par bshad la gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par/

tho gar dang rgya yul la sogs pa yul phran stong yod par gsungs shing*/ khyad par rgya gar na lung phran tshegs su/ mnyan yod dang*/ ser skya dang*/ yangs pa can dang*/ rgyal po'i khab dang*/ wā ra ṇā sī dang*/ tsam pa ste grong khyer chen po drug yod par gsungs/ gling 'di'i byang gi 'gram na rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi shing thams cad kyi mchog shing shal ma la'i rtse mo shin tu mtho ba la mkha' lding skye gnas bzhi yod do// bar gyi gling brgyad dang zhes pa ni gling bzhi po rnams kyi bar bar na/ lus dang lus 'phags sgra mi snyan// sgra mi snyan gyi zla dang ni/ gdags pa las/ gcig na ni mi ma yin pa rnams gnas so zhes pa dang*/ yid kyi sar gcig ni srin mo'i gling yin no zhes pa dang*/ mdzod du thams cad mir 'dod do// rnga yab dang ni rnga yab gzhan// g.yo ldan dang ni lam mchog 'gro// zhes pa ltar phyogs bzhir gnyis gnyis te brgyad yin la/ dbyibs ni gling gtso bo dang mthun pa ste/ gling gi dbyibs bzhin du de na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi gdong pa'i dbyibs kyang de dang 'dra'o// nang gi rgya mtsho dang zhes pa ni/ de dag bar bdun rol mtsho yin// dang po stong phrag brgyad cu 'o// de ni nang gi rgya mtsho yin// de yi ngos (441) la sum 'gyur ro// rol mtsho gzhan ni phyed phyed dbri// zhes pa ltar gser gyi ri bdun gyi nang gi mtsho bdun po rnams ni shī ta zhes pa rmos kyi rol dang 'dra bas rol mtsho zhes bya ba ste/ mtsho nang ma ri rab dang gnya' shing 'dzin gyi bar na yod pa'i kha zheng la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod cing*/ de'i phyi rol gyi ngos kyi phyogs gcig la'ang zheng gi sum 'gyur yin pas nyis 'bum bzhi khri yod la/ thams cad kyang gru bzhi yin pas mtha' skor du ni de'ang bzhi 'gyur ro// phyi ma rnams la phyed phyed phri bas gnyis pa la bzhi khri dang*/ bdun pa la stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i bar te/

mtha' skor ni dpyad pas shes shing thams cad kyang*/ bsil dang zhim dang yang dang 'jam// dang ba dang ni dri nga med// 'thung na lto la mi gnod dang*// mgrin pa la ni mi gnod pa'o// zhes pa ltar yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba/ mdog shin tu sngo ba/ me tog dang sman sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa klu'i rgyal po chen po rnams gnas pa'o// phyi'i rgya mtsho bzhi dang zhes pa ni/ lhag ma phyi yi mtsho chen yin// 'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag ni// nyi shu gnyis so// zhes pa ltar mu khyud 'dzin nas lcags ri'i bar gyi mtsho ni phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po yin zhing*/ phyogs kyis phye bas bzhir yang 'gyur la/ kha zheng du sum 'bum nyi khri nyis stong yod pa ste/ ba tshwa can gyi chus yongs su gang ba/ klu dang chu srin la sogs pa'i srog chags sna tshogs pa dang*/ rin po che'i rigs du ma yod pa klu gtsang sbra can gnas pas shi ba'i ro dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa/ rlabs kyi rim pa che chung rnams gdags par/ chung ba nang bar dang phyi ma red kyi dus rlabs ni rgya mtsho nas sems can bkres shing*/ nyam chung bas

(442) zas tshol ba nang par mtsho nas 'thon zhing phyi ma red bkres bzhin du ldog pas 'byung la/ chen po tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi sogs la rgya mtsho nas sems can thang la byung nas lha la phyag 'tshal zhing gso sbyong byed pas 'byung ngo*/ dus las mi 'da' bar 'byung ba'o// der chu klung dpag tu med pa babs shing*/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis char gyi rgyun mang po phab kyang lhag par 'phel bar mi 'gyur ba ni/ gdags par/ de na gnas pa'i srog chags kyis longs spyad pa'i lhag ma rlung dang nyi tshan gyis skem par bshad cing*/ mdo las/ dmyal ba'i mes skem pa dang*/ rin po che'i khyad par 'ga' zhig gis mi snang bar byed par gsungs la/ a bha yas/ sprin gyis chu ni ma blangs kyang*// rgya mtsho'i chu ni zad mi 'gyur// zhes rgya mtsho'i chu nyid 'khor bar yang bshad do// ri rab kyi bang rim dang zhes pa ni/ 'di la bang rim bzhi yod de// bar gyi tshad ni stong phrag bcu// stong phrag dag ni bcu drug dang*// brgyad dang bzhi dang gnyis 'phags so// zhes pa ltar 'og nas rim pa bzhin khri drug stong dang brgyad stong dang bzhi stong dang nyis stong phyi rol du 'phags shing*/ gong 'og gi bar la khri phrag re re yod pa ste/ gdags par/ de dag kyang rin po che sna bzhi las grub par bshad do// gnyis pa/ gnas gzhan la/ bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro'i gnas gzhan gnyis las/ dang po la/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi gnas gzhan dag dang zhes sbyar te/ bang rim bzhi la 'og nas rim pa bzhin// de la lag na gzhong thogs dang*// phreng thogs dang ni rtag myos dang*// rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams gnas// ri bo bdun po rnams la yang*// zhes pa ltar bang rim bzhi pa la rgyal po chen po bzhi pa rang nyid 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas yod cing*/ 'og ma rnams ri bdun la yang de'i ris su gtogs pa'i grong dang grong (443) rdal la sogs pa yod la/

gzhan yang ri dang chu klung dang*/ shing dang nags tshal dang*/ sa bla dang nam mkha' dang*/ rgya mtsho dang nyi zla dang skar ma la sogs pa rnams la yang de dang de'i lha'i gnas yod de/ mdzod 'grel du/ de nyid kyi phyir lha'i ris de ni thams cad pas che'o zhes pa ltar ro// sa dang gdags par/ gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng gi shar na yul 'khor srung gi pho brang yang yul 'khor srung zhes bya ba dang*/ lho na 'phags skyes po'i pho brang 'phags par skyes zhes bya ba dang*/ nub na spyan mi bzang gi pho brang sna tshogs gzugs zhes bya ba dang*/ byang na rnam thos sras kyi pho brang lcang lo can zhes bya ba thams cad kyang chu zheng du dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu yod pa/ dpag tshad stong gi mtha' nas gser gyi ra ba dpag tshad phyed pas bskor ba/ dbyibs kun nas gru bzhir mnyam pa/ rin po che las grub pa'i rtsig skyabs dang mda' yab dang zam pa brgyud ma bzhi dang ldan pa/ g.yas g.yon na rdzing bu chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ba la me tog dang bya skad snyan pa sna tshogs pas brgyan pa yod par gsungs so// sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas gzhan rnams dang zhes pa don bzhis 'chad pa la phyi'i tshad ni/ lhun po'i rtse na sum cu gsum// de yi ngos la brgyad khri 'o// phyogs bral brtsegs pa bzhi la ni// lag na rdo rje gnas zhes pa ltar ri rab kyi steng gi rgya dang mnyam par sum cu rtsa gsum gyi ngos re la'ang dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pas mtha' skor du sum 'bum nyi khri yod cing*/ de'i mtshams bzhi na khang pa brtsegs ma bzhi ni rin po che bzhi las grub pa/ chu zheng du dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa/ dpag tshad phyed dang lnga gyen du 'phags pa gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnas pa ste/ sa dang mdzod 'grel (444) du dpag tshad lnga brgya yang gsungs so// nang gi grong ni/ dbus na/ grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa// ngos la nyis stong lnga brgya pa// dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis gser gyi// rang bzhin gzhi bkra mnyen pa yod// ces pa ltar sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dbus na grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba/

chu zheng la dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya yod pa/ mtha' skor du khri yod pa/ gser gyi ra ba 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pas bskor ba/ sa gzhi tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis rnam par bkra ba/ mnan na nem zhing bteg na 'phar ba dang ldan pa yod de/ sar/ ri rab de'i steng na lha'i pho brang gnas pa'i tshad ni chu zheng du dpag tshad khri khri yod do// gzhan dag ni lha de dag gi grong dang grong rdal dang ljongs rnams yod do// zhes kyang gsungs la/ gzhag par/ de ni gser gyi ra ba dpag tshad phyed gsum pas bskor ba/ rtsig skyabs gser dang dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya dang shel las byas pa/ mda' yab bzang po bzhi dang ldan pa/ sgo stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba yod pa/ sgo'i dpangs su dpag tshad phyed dang gsum dang*/ zheng du phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ sgo re re la srung ma go mtshon thogs pa lnga brgya lnga brgya yod pa/ lam srang zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis dang srid du nyis stong dang lnga brgya yod pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba dang ldan pa la sogs par bshad do// gtso bo'i gnas ni/ de na rnam par rgyal byed de// ngos la nyis brgya lnga bcu 'o// zhes pa ltar lta na sdug gi dbus na lha'i dbang po'i khang bzangs rnam par rgyal byed ces bya ba/ chu zheng du dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu yod pa/ mtha' skor stong yod pa/ grong las dpag tshad phyed dang lnga gyen du 'phags pa/ rmang rin po che (445) bzhi las byas pa/ them skas dang ldan pa/ ka ba rnams gser dang dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya dang shel las byas pa/ ka rten dang ka zhu dang bre phul dung la sogs pa las byas pa/ ba gam brgya rtsa gcig gis mdzes pa/ ba gam sa nas brgya brgya re re la gdags par khang pa brtsegs ma bdun bdun dang*/ khang mig re re la lha'i bu bdun bdun dang*/ lha'i bu re re la lha mo bdun bdun dang*/ lha mo re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang*/

g.yog mo re re la sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun yod pa la sogs pa grong gi mngon par dga' ba dang ldan pa'o// tshal sogs 'khor ni/ phyi rol shing rta sna tshogs dang*// rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dga' bas brgyan// zhes pa ltar grong khyer las dpag tshad nyi shu'i phyi rol na lha rnams 'dod yon la rtse ba'i skyed mos tshal yod de/ shar na 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal dang*/ lho na lus dang sems rtsub par 'gyur ba'i tshal dang*/ nub na chol par 'dres te spyod pa'i tshal dang*/ byang na yid rab tu bde zhing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i tshal lo// 'di dag gi ni phyogs bzhi na// nyi shus bcad na sa gzhi bzang*// zhes pa ltar tshal bzhi las dpag tshad nyi shu'i phyi rol na sa gzhi bzang po bzhi'ang*/ shing rta sna tshogs dang rtsub pa dang 'dres pa dang dga' ba zhes bya ba ste/ thams cad tshad rnam rgyal dang mtshungs pa/ gser gyi ra ba dpag tshad gcig pas bskor ba/ rtsig skyabs dang mda' yab dang zam pa brgyud ma rnams rin po che bzhi las byas pa/ nang na lam srang dang rdzing bu la sogs pa'i 'dod yon sna tshogs dang bcas pa'o// byang shar mtshams na yongs 'du ste// lho nub mtshams na chos bzang ngo*// zhes pa ltar grong khyer gyi phyi rol byang shar gyi (446) cha la dpag bsam gyi shing yongs 'dus brtol zhes bya ba/ sboms su dpag tshad nyi shu yod pa/ rtsa ba lnga bcu thur du zug cing dpangs su brgya gyen du 'phags pa/ yal ga dang lo 'dab kyis brgyad cur khyab pa/ me tog rgyas pa'i dri rdzi phyogs su dpag tshad brgya dang phyogs gzhan lnga bcur ldang ba/ de'i drung du lha rnams dbyar zla ba bzhi rtse zhing dga' bar byed pa yod la/ lho nub na chos bzang lha'i 'dun sa dbyibs gru gsum ngos re la sum brgya/ gyen du grong las dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi 'phags pa/ zhes bya ba/ sa gzhi dang thog la sogs pa phal cher shel las grub pa/

dbus na bai ḍūr+ya'i ka ba zur brgyad pas mdzes pa/ gser gyi khri bzang po dang ldan pa/ dpag tshad gcig pa'i 'obs chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang zhing me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba yod de/ der lha rnams chos kyi don la 'jal rtog nges par sems par byed cing*/ khyad par brgya byin lha dang mi'i don la sems par byed pa yod do// de dang nye ba na ar mo ni ka lta bu zhes bya ba'i rdo leb dkar po ngos re la dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa/ 'phangs su drug dang bco brgyad cha yod pa/ bzang zhing lta na sdug pa/ brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa'i khri gdan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa yod cing*/ rnam rgyal khang bzang gi steng na rnga de gzugs med bstan du mi rung yang*// de ltar rnga sgra don chen brgyad byed na// zhes so// rnga bo che chos kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bstan du med cing thogs pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs/ ma brdungs par sgra 'byung ba/ lha rnams 'dod yon la yengs na chos la skul zhing*/ lha ma yin gyis gtses na dbugs 'byin pa yod pa la sogs pa khyad par du ma dang ldan pa'o// khor yug gi ri dang zhes pa ni/ phyi rol na 'khor lo lta bu'i khor yug ste/ bdun (447) ni gser yin de lcags so// zhes pa ltar gling bzhi gling phran thams cad kyi phyi rol nas 'khor lo lta bur bskor ba'i khor yug lcags ri las grub pa chu mtshams yan chad la dpag tshad sum brgya phyed dang bcu gsum yod pa ste/ sar ni mu khyud 'dzin dang tshad mnyam par yang bshad cing*/ lung phran tshegs su/ 'di la'ang lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba rgyal chen bzhi pa'i ris kyi lha gnas par gsungs so// gling bzhi pa 'di ni bcom pa dang ldan zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di dang 'dabs chags par phyogs bzhi na shin tu bsrungs dang*/ dga' ba bzod dka' dang*/ snying po dam pa dang*/ gnyen ldan zhes bya ba la sogs pa yod par bshad do// nam mkha' la gzhal med khang rnams dang*/

zhes pa ni 'og gzhi la ma brten par bar snang la gnas pa nyi zla dang gza' skar nas 'og min gyi bar gyi gnas gzhan thams cad spyir bstan pa ste/ de la thog mar nyi ma dang zla ba dang*/ de dag la brten pa'i dus kyi khyad par la sogs pa 'chad pa la don lnga las/ dang po/ nyi zla'i gnas lugs ni/ nyi zla lhun po'i phyed na 'o// dpag tshad lnga bcu gcig dang bcas// zhes pa ltar gnyis ka'ang lhun po'i phyed kyi thad ka'i nam mkha' nas 'khor ba/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni chu shel las grub pa/ dbus kyi thad ka la dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni me shel las grub pa/ thad kar lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pa/ gnyis ka'i mtha' skor du de dang de'i sum 'gyur ldan pa/ dpangs su drug phyed dang drug zer dang bco brgyad cha yod pa/ gser gyi ra ba dpag tshad phyed zer gcig pas bskor ba/ rin po che'i gzhal med khang dang*/ lam srang dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ rdzing bu dang*/ me tog la sogs pa lha'i longs spyod du ma dang ldan pa'o/ (448) /gnyis pa/ gling bzhi por 'khor tshul la rang 'gros rgyu skar gyi steng nas longs spyod pas g.yon skor du 'khor ba ni zla ba mgyogs shing nges med du 'gro la phal cher zhag nyer bdun na khyim bcu gnyis 'khor/ bas zla ba rer khyim bcu gsum bgrod cing*/ nyi mas khyim re re bgrod la/ rlung 'gros sems can gyi las dbang gis bar snang la 'phul dang 'degs pa dang sbyor ba'i rlung gi stobs kyis g.yas skor du 'khor ba ni/ nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang*// nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig /ces pa ltar byang gi nam phyed pa dang shar gyi nyi ma nub pa dang*/ lho'i nyi ma phyed pa dang nub kyi nyi ma 'char ba rnams dus gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'khor zhing snang ba'i bya ba byed de/ de dang tshul mtshungs par zla ba dang gza' skar rnams kyang nyin zhag re la lan re 'khor ro// nyin mtshan gyi ring thung ni/

rang 'grel du// 'dus bzang dang*/ phyogs glang gi 'grel pa las/ dbyar gyi gnyis pa dbyar zla tha chung dang*/ dgun gyi bzhi pa dgun zla tha chung du bshad la/ gdags par yang*/ dgun zla tha chung yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la mtshan mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod do// zhes 'byung yang 'gyur khyad min pa don 'dra'am snyam ste/ yang de nyid las ston zla ra ba yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod do// zhes pas so// dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi// tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring*// dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa na// thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo ldog /ces pa ste// lo gcig la dus bzhir 'byed pa na/ khrums dang tha skar smin drug ston// mgo dang rgyal dang mchu ni dgun// dbo dang nag pa sa ga dpyid// snron dang chu stod gro bzhin dbyar// zhes bya ba yin la/ 'dir de dag dus gsum du sdud pas na smin drug gi tshes bcu drug nas dbo'i tshes bco lnga'i bar zla ba bzhi ni dgun gyi dus dang*/ de'i bcu drug nas chu stod kyi bco lnga'i bar zla ba bzhi ni dpyid kyi dus dang*/ de'i bcu drug nas (449) smin drug gi bco lnga'i bar zla ba bzhi ni dbyar gyi dus so// de la gro bzhin gyi phyed phyi ma nas khrums kyi phyed snga ma'i bar ni dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis yin la/ de'i tha ma khrums kyi yar ngo'i tshes dgu la ston nyin mtshan mnyam zhing*/ de nas mtshan mo ring du song ba nas brtsams te zla ba gsum na mgo'i yar ngo'i tshes dgu la dgun gyi nyi ma ldog go /mchu'i phyed phyi ma nas dbo'i phyed snga ma'i bar ni dgun gyi zla ba bzhi pa yin la/ de'i tha ma dbo'i yar ngo'i tshes dgu la dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam zhing*/ de nas mtshan mo thung du song ba nas brtsams te zla ba gsum na snron gyi yar ngo'i tshes dgu la dbyar gyi nyi ma ldog go

/de dag ni rags pa ste/ zhib mor na nyi ma ldog pa dang*/ zhag mi thub 'dor ba dang zla lhag byung ba la sogs pa ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byed rtsis las shes par bya'o// bzhi pa/ de'i tshad dang rgyu mtshan ni// nyin mtshan ring ba thang cig go /nyi ma lho byang 'gro tshe 'o// zhes pa ltar zhag re la thang cig res ring thung du byed cing*/ nyin mtshan mnyam pa na gnyi ga la yud tsam bco lnga dang*/ ring thung du gyur pa na thung shos la yud tsam bcu gnyis dang*/ ring shos la yud tsam bco brgyad du 'gyur ro// de yang nyi ma lhor bgrod pa na dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang bco brgyad chas/ gling las yol te 'od zer rgya mtsho la 'bab pas gting gi chu dro la/ gling gi mtha' myur du spong bas nyi ma thung zhing grang ba'o// byang du bgrod pa na rgya mtsho las yol te 'od zer gling gi steng du 'bab pas gting gi chu grang la/ gling gi dbus dal bus spong bas nyi ma ring zhing dro ba'o// myang 'das su/ dgun myur du 'gro bas nyi ma thung zhing grang ba dang*/ dbyar dal bus 'gro bas nyi ma ring zhing dro bar yang gsungs la/ bcom ldan/ kha cig (450) dpag tshad bcu gnyis mtho dman du byed cing dma' ba nas 'gro ba na mgyogs pas thung ba dang*/ mtho ba nas 'gro ba na bul bas ring ba'o zhes kyang bzhed do// lnga pa/ zla ba'i cha 'phel 'grib ni/ nyi ma dang nye bas nyi ma'i 'od gzhal yas khang la babs pas bar ngos su grib mas bsgribs pas ma gang bar mthong la nyi ma dang bral nas de'i 'od zer phog pa'i grib ma med pa'i phyir gang bar snang ste/ sgron me dang ka ba'i grib ma bzhin no// nyi ma dang ni nye ba las// rang gi grib mas sgrib par snang*// zhes pa ltar nyi ma dang phan tshun du nye ba las nyi ma'i 'od zer zla ba'i mtha' skor la phog pa na gang mtha' skor gyi grib mas bsgribs pa rnams snang zhing*/ 'od zer phog pa rnams ni chu shel gyi rang bzhin dwang ba'i rgyun mtshan gyis mi snang ba'o// zla ba'i nang gi ri mo ni/

sar/ rgya mtsho'i nya dang ru sbal la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar bar bshad cing*/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' ri bong gi gzugs brnyan bris par gsungs so// skar ma rnams ni che ba la rgyang grags bco brgyad dang*/ bar pa la bcu dang*/ chung ba la bzhi yod par gsungs shing*/ mdzod 'grel du/ chung ba la rgyang grags gcig par yang bshad do// thams cad kyang shel las grub pa/ gser gyi ra bas bskor ba/ gzhal med khang la sogs pa nyi zla dang mtshungs pa/ lha dang lha mo rnams 'dod yon la spyod pa dang bcas pa'o// nyi zla gza' skar rnams gdags par/ lo ka bar mtshams thams cad du// nyi zla de bzhin skar ma dang*// rgyu skar tshogs ni rgya chen dang*// khor yug mi 'da' lo ka yin// bar mtshams thams cad mun par 'dug /ces so// lcags ri'i khor yug las mi 'da' bas de phan chad ni gling bar gyi mun pas khebs pa'o// ltas kyi rnam pa bstan pa las/ skar ma thams cad bsdoms na dung phyur gnyis dang*/ bye ba phrag brgya dang*/ sa ya lnga yod par yang bshad do// ri rab kyi thad ka'i steng gi

(451) nam mkha' la 'thab bral ba'i gnas gzhan dang*/ de'i steng na dga' ldan dang*/ de'i steng na 'phrul dga' dang*/ de'i steng na nam mkha' la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams gnas/ gzhan ni 'og ma 'og ma las yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa dang ldan pa yod de/ kha cig thams cad ri rab kyi steng gi rgya dang mnyam par yang 'dod mod/ gzhan dag ni gong ma rnams nyis 'gyur gyis yangs par bzhed do// gzugs na spyod pa'i gnas gzhan rnams dang zhes sbyar te/ kha cig bsam gtan dang po gling bzhi pa tsam dang*/ gnyis pa stong spyi phud tsam dang*/ gsum pa stong gnyis pa bar ma tsam dang*/ bzhi pa stong gsum tsam mo zhes kyang 'dod mod/ gzhan dag ni dang po stong spyi phud tsam dang*/ gnyis pa stong gnyis pa bar ma tsam dang*/ gsum pa stong gsum dang*/ bzhi pa tshad med par bzhed do// steng 'og gi bar thag ni/ gnas nas gnas 'og ji srid pa// de nas de yi gong de srid// ces pa ltar sum cu rtsa gsum nas 'di'i bar la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod cing*/ 'thab bral nas de'i bar la 'bum drug khri yod pa ltar de nas dga' ldan gyi bar la'ang de tsam zhig yod ces bya ba nas/ mthar shin tu mthong nas 'di'i bar la ji tsam yod pa ltar/ de nas 'og min gyi bar la'ang de tsam zhig yod pa'o// rdzu 'phrul gzhan rten ma gtogs pa// de dag gong ma mthong ba med// ces pa ltar rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'am/ des khrid pas gong ma mthong gi gzhan gyis ni ma yin la/ gong ma 'og tu 'ongs pa'ang 'og sa'i lus su sprul na mthong zhing*/ gzhan du na ma yin no// lha ma yin rnams kyi gnas gzhan dag dang zhes pa ni ri rab kyi 'og gi cha chu mtshams man (452) chad la yod de/ dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ dpag tshad sum khri na 'od ldan gyi grong na sgra gcan dang*/ de nas bzhi stong na skar phreng gi grong na mgul phreng dang*/ de nas bzhi stong na brtan pa'i grong na rab gnon dang*/

de nas bzhi stong na zab pa'am gser ldan gyi grong na lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzangs ris gnas par gsungs so// lha rnams mtho ba bzang ba ltar 'di rnams dma' ba bzang zhing*/ bzhi pa thags bzangs ris ni gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng na sum cu rtsa gsum la 'gran pa'i longs spyod dang ldan pa ste/ de la lta sdug gi dod la grong khyer gser ldan dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi dod la khang bzangs gtams pa can dang*/ chos bzang gi dod la 'dun sa nor bzangs dang*/ yongs 'du'i dod la tsi tra pa tra dang*/ rdo leb dkar po'i dod la rdo leb bzang po dang*/ tshal bzhi'i dod la kun dga' dang*/ rab dga' dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ kun dga' ra ba dang*/ sa gzhi'i dod la kun dga' can la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ rab brtan gyi dod la g.yul gyi glang po ti se gangs brtsegs dang*/ sa srungs kyi bu'i dod la bzod par dka' ba dang*/ sprin gyi shugs can gyi dod la rta'i rgyal po brag 'jings zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i khyad par du ma dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa/ ngan 'gro'i gnas gzhan la sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi gnas gzhan dag dang zhes pa ni spyir bstan te/ kha cig ri rab kyi 'og gi cha la yod do zhes kyang bzhed do// tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi gnas ni sa sder/ gangs ri'i 'og dpag tshad sum khri nyis stong na yang sos/ de nas dpag tshad bzhi stong gi 'og na gzhan bdun yod par gsungs shing*/ mdzod du/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na// mnar med pa 'o de tsam mo// de yi gong (453) na dmyal ba bdun// zhes gling 'di'i dpag tshad nyi khri'i 'og na chu zheng du'ang nyi khri pa'i mnar med kyi gnas yod pas/ 'di nas de'i 'og gzhi la ni bzhi khri yod cing*/ de'i steng na gzhan bdun po yod par bshad la/ kha cig ni mnar med kyi logs na gnas par 'dod do// grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi gnas ni sa sder/ yang sos kyi thad ka dpag tshad khri'i pha rol na grang dmyal dang po/

de nas dpag tshad nyis stong nyis stong gi 'og na gzhan bdun po yod par gsungs shing*/ mdzod 'grel du ni tsha dmyal rnams kyi thad ka na yod par yang bshad la/ kha cig ni rgya mtsho dang nye bar gnas pas grang ba yin no zhes kyang zer ro// nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi gnas ni nges pa med par chu ri dang mya ngan gyi phyogs dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang*/ mi'i gnas la sogs pa na'ang yod do/ dpa' bzhed ltar na chu tshan rnams kyang yin no// dud 'gro rnams kyi rtsa ba'i gnas ni rgya mtsho chen po yin la/ de las 'phros pa'i gnas ni chu dang thang dang nam mkha'i spyod yul la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed man chad kyi lha dang mi'i yul na'ang yod cing*/ mi'i lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri yod par gsungs pas de dag kyang yin no// yi dwags de dag kha cig gi gnas gzhan rnams dang zhes pa ni gling 'di 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya na rtsa ba'i gnas rgyal po'i khab yod cing de na gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa gnas nas sems can skye ba mi dran pa rnams la las 'bras bshad de phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa yod la/ kha cig ces pa'i sgras mkha' la rgyu ba la sogs pa mi'i yul dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram na'ang yod de/ bye brag tu smra ba ni yi dwags dang dud 'gro gnyis ka dmyal ba'i gnas na yod par 'dod do// (454) mdzod 'grel du 'dzam bu gling 'di tsam gyi 'og tu mnar med pa la sogs pa de tsam shong ba ni/ gling rnams 'bru'i phung po ltar zhabs rgya che bar gnas pa yin te/ de'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po rim gyis gzhol bar yang bshad do// nam mkha' la shing rta'i 'khor lo'i khyon tsam la'ang*/ 'gro ba/ mi snang ba'i sems can zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa/ stong gsum gyi sems can gzhan thams cad pas kyang mang ba yod par yang gsungs so// de ltar gling bzhi pa gcig gi gnas lus rgyas par bshad nas/

de las rim gyis bsgres te/ stong spyi phud bshad pa ni/ nyi ma 'jig rten rnam par snang byed nam mkha' la kun tu rgyu zhing gcig gi phyogs snang bar byed nus pa ni gling bzhi pa gcig yin la de ji snyed pa de snyed kyi stong gi 'jig rten na nam mkha' la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor stong dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor stong dang*/ sa gzhi la ri'i rgyal po ri rab stong dang*/ gling 'di la ltos pa'i shar gyi lus 'phags stong dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling stong dang*/ nub kyi ba lang spyod stong dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan stong dang*/ ri rab kyi bang rim la sogs pa la rgyal chen bzhi pa'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi gnas gzhan stong dang*/ ri rab kyi steng gi sum cu rtsa gsum stong dang*/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la gong nas gong du 'thab bral dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi gnas gzhan stong dang*/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi gnas gzhan bsam gtan dang po man chad stong pa 'di ni stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya'o zhes pa ste/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang*// ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang*// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni// stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod// ces pa ltar ro// stong gnyis pa bar ma bshad pa ni// stong (455) spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de'ang stong du bgrangs pa'i gling bzhi pa la sogs pa gang yin pa de ni stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ste/ de stong la ni stong gnyis pa// bar ma'i 'jig rten khams zhes bya// zhes pa'o// stong gsum bshad pa ni/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams de'ang stong du bgrangs pa'i stong spyi phud sa ya'am/ gling bzhi pa la sogs pa bye ba phrag brgya'am ther 'bum gcig gang yin pa 'di ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ste/
