de stong la ni stong gsum mo// zhes pa'o// stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni rdo rje las grub pa'i khor yug chen pos gna' mchan las dpangs tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang mnyam zhes/ kun tu bskor ro// stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di ni me la sogs pas 'jig pa na yang thams cad dus mnyam du 'jig cing stongs la/ 'chags pa na yang thams cad dus mnyam du 'chags shing gnas te/ mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin// zhes so// phal po cher/ stong gsum mi mjed 'di dang 'dabs chags su phyogs bzhi na 'jig rten gyi khams khebs ldan dang*/ phan pa lhag ldan dang*/ kun tu song ba dang*/ rdul bsal ba la sogs pa yod par gsungs so// phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud du/ stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi mtshams sbyor ba gcig dang*/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud gcig pa dang*/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud bar ma gcig dang*/ zhes pa'ang yod/ de bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi'i snying po me tog gi rgyan bkod pa gcig ste/ de ni longs sku rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par smin pa'i zhing yin la/ de yang rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho'i phyag gi mthil gyi rdul (456) phra rab gcig la gnas so// zhes kyang bshad do// gang yang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa la sogs pa 'di dang mi 'dra ba gsungs pa dang*/ sa dang gzhag pa la sogs par nang gses cung zad mi 'dra bar bshad pa ni phyi'i don bden par ma grub pas/ sems can so so'i snang ba dang mthun par bstan pa ste/ mdo las/ zhing rnams 'di kun sems kyis rnam par brtags// zhes pa ltar ro// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bshad pa ni/ stong gsum 'di 'chags 'jig mnyam pa bzhin du phyogs gzhan na yang de lta bu tshad med par gnas pa 'di lta ste/

dper na/ 'jig rten 'chags pa'i tshe char gyi rgyun chen po sboms su gnya' shing tsam yod pa 'bab pa na/ bar snang la char gyi rgyun 'bab pa rnams kyi thad ka la bar dang steng 'og la mtshams med pa de bzhin du/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig pa dang 'chags pa rnams kyi yang thad ka la bar dang steng 'og la mtshams med pa zhig yod de/ da lta nyid du'ang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag ni 'jig bzhin par 'dug go /gzhan dag ni zhig nas stongs par 'dug go /gzhan dag ni rim gyis 'chags so// gzhan dag ni chags nas gnas par 'dug go /bye brag tu smra ba/ kha cig 'jig rten gyi khams la thad kar mtha' med kyang steng 'og tu mtha' yod par 'dod mod/ 'di ni shar phyogs su 'jig chags brjod kyis mi long ba yod pa ji lta bar lho phyogs la sogs par phyogs bcu thams cad kyang de bzhin te/ da lta nyid la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig pa dang stongs pa dang 'chags pa dang gnas pa rnams bar mtshams med pa zhig yod pa yin no// de bas na/ bar sdom ni/ rten dang dbyibs dang gling dang tshad// longs spyod snang ba rgyan dang ni// sangs rgyas gnas yun gnas (457) tshul gyis// zhing rnams mtha' yas shes par bya// zhes pa ltar zhing khams rab 'byams te de rnams ni brten gzhi'i sgo nas kyang mtha' yas pa ste/ phal po cher/ la la ni nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i 'od can la brten pa dang*/ la la ni nor 'bru'i rgya mtsho la brten pa dang*/ la la ni pad+ma'i rgya mtsho la brten pa dang*/ la la ni sangs rgyas kyi sku'i byin la brten gsungs pa'o// dbyibs kyi sgo nas kyang zlum po dang gru gsum dang gru bzhi dang*/ nor bu lta bu dang*/ pad+ma lta bu dang*/ 'khor lo lta bu dang*/ zur brgyad pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa ste/ phal po cher/ la la zlum po la la zur gsum ste// de dag la la phyogs ni gru bzhir gnas// nor bu pad+ma 'khor lo yan lag brgyad// kun kyang las rnams rgya mtshos rnam par bris// zhes pa ltar ro// gling yod med la sogs pas kyang rnam pa tha dad pa ste/

'di lta bu na gling bzhi pa du mar bcad pa dang*/ bde ba can la sogs pa 'ga' zhig na thams cad lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing yid du 'ong bar gsungs pa'o// gling du bcad pa la yang tshad mi 'dra ba mang po ste/ sangs rgyas ri rab 'od yang dag par 'phags pa'i zhing rab tu dga' ba na 'dzam bu gling la dpag tshad bye ba yod cing*/ gzhan gsum la brgyad khri re yod par gsungs pa dang*/ 'das pa'i dus su sangs rgyas seng ge'i blo gros 'jig rten du byon pa na 'dzam bu gling la'ang dpag tshad drug khri brgyad stong yod par gsungs pa la sogs pa'o// longs spyod kyi sgo nas kyang mtha' yas pa ste/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na mi rnams gser dang dngul gyi skas la 'dzegs nas sum cu rtsa gsum du song ste 'dod yon la spyod pas lha la mi smon zhing*/ lha rnams ni 'dzam bu'i gling na sangs rgyas bzhugs shing dam pa'i chos kyi bde ba la spyod pa'o (458) zhes mi smon par gsungs pa la sogs pa'o// snang ba yod med kyi sgo nas kyang sna tshogs pa ste/ las mi dge ba mthun par bsags pa'i dbang gis/ zhing rnams la la 'od med de// mun pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu che// reg na sdug bsngal spu gri 'dra// blta na mi bzod skyi yang g.ya'// zhes pa lta bu dang*/ snang ba yod pa'i khyad par yang*/ lha la sogs pa'i 'od dang*/ ljon shing dang ri bo dang nor bu dang mar me dang pad+ma dang spos chu'i 'od dang ldan pa la sogs pa ste/ zhing rnams la la lta 'od can// la la khyim gyi 'od can te// la la nyi zla'i 'od dang ldan// zhing rnams la la rang gi 'od// ces sogs 'byung ba lta bu'o// gzhan yang sangs rgyas 'jam dpal gyi zhing gi bkod par/ nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po'i zhing na nyi zla med par de'i smin mtshams kyi nor bus gsal bar byed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i zhing mi 'dzum pa na stong gsum ril po nyi zla zung gcig gis snang bar byed par gsungs pa la sogs pa'o// rin po che dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa'i rgyan yod med kyi sgo nas kyang tha dad pa mang ba ste/

zhing gi rgyan mang bye bas brgyan// zhing rnams la la rnam par bris// rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad par// sna tshogs mig yor lta bur snang*// zhes pa la sogs pa ltar ro// sangs rgyas yod med dang*/ yod pa la'ang mang nyung gi sgo nas kyang mtha' yas pa ste/ zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas med// zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas bcas// la la'i zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la lar sangs rgyas mang po 'o// zhes pa ltar ro// gnas pa'i yun ring thung gi sgo nas kyang rnam pa sna tshogs pa ste/ zhing rnams la la bskal pa tsam// la la bskal pa bcu pa ste// zhing rnams la la rdul mnyam pa'i// bskal pa bye bar brjod (459) pa yin// zhes pa ltar ro// gzhan yang gnas tshul gyi sgo nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thad ka ba 'di lta bu rnal mar gnas pa dang*/ 'di la ltos nas logs la rkang pa btsugs te 'gro ba snrel zhi'i 'jig rten dang*/ steng du rkang pa btsugs te 'gro ba spyi'u tshugs kyi 'jig rten la sogs pa las dang smon lam dang snang tshul gyi dbang gis tshad med par shes par bya'o// de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' med pa rnams kyang khams gsum du 'du ba las/ mdzod 'grel du/ 'dod khams gcig las 'dod chags dang bral ba na thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur zhing*/ khams gong ma gnyis la'ang de dang mtshungs la/ bsam gtan dang po'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa ni zhing khams gang du skyes pa de'i tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du 'gro'i/ gzhan du ni ma yin par gsungs so// gnyis pa/ don bsdu ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i nang g.yo ba sems can gyi 'jig rten gang yin pa dang phyi brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten gang yin pa de dag ji ltar sa bon khyad par gyis// 'bras bu sna tshogs 'byung ba ltar// de bzhin las kyi khyad par gyis// sems can rnams dang zhing 'byung ngo*// zhes pa ltar rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i 'gro ba rnams ni las zag pa dang bcas pa dang de kun nas slong ba'i nyon mongs pas mtshams sbyar nas dngos su bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/

de rnams kyi gnas ni gnas pa po thams cad kyi thun mong ba'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i phyir te mdor na kun 'byung gi rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud 'di mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'o zhes pa ste/ zhing gi khams rnams la la ni// kun nas nyon mongs rnam par gnas// sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs las// chos nyid de rnams de na snang*// zhes pa ltar ro//

(460) dmigs bsal ni/ zhing rnams la la 'od btang bas// rin chen rang bzhin dri ma med// rnam pa sna tshogs dri med dag /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs dag byas// zhes pa ltar bde ba can nam 'og min la sogs pa yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi snod bcud yin yang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma yin par blta ste/ kun 'byung gi 'bras bu ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de yang gang zag de dag ni las dang nyon mongs pas rgyu'am rkyen byas nas dngos su bskyed pa ma yin zhing*/ snod de dag kyang las dang nyon mongs pa'i bdag rkyen gyi dbang gis 'byung ba ma yin gyi/ klu'i rgyal pos sprin phung rnams// nam mkha'i dbyings su ston pa ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas smon lam gyis// zhing rnams kun tu 'byung ba yin// zhes pa ltar sngon gzhan don du smon lam rnam dag btab pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po bsags pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba dag go /zag med kyi las las byung yang snod bcud du snang ba de lta bas na de dag gi ji lta ba'i tshul ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na'i spyod yul ye shes nyid de ltar snang ba yin te shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid ces gsungs so// yin pa'i phyir/ skye ba'i gnas yongs su dag pa'i zhing khams de dag ni sangs rgyas las gzhan pas bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de dag ni bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag pa rnams kyi bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi spyod yul ma yin na/ 'jig rten dngos por rab tu 'jal ba rtog ge pa rnams kyis thos pa dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab rtog dpyod kyi spyod yul ma yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ des na gnas skabs su lung rnam dag la yid ches pa'i sgo nas spyi'i tshul du shes par bya (461) zhing*/

mthar thug ji lta ba'i don ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bsgrubs te shes par bya'o// gnyis pa/ mdo'i don bshad pa la brgyad drug gsum gnyis te/ bzhi las thog mar sdug bsngal brgyad du dbye ba la mdo dgod pa dang*/ don bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sngar bshad par ma zad yang mdo las/ skye ba ni sdug bsngal lo// rga ba ni sdug bsngal lo// na ba ni sdug bsngal lo// 'chi ba ni sdug bsngal lo// zhes nang la brten pa'i sdug bsngal bzhi dang*/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa ni sdug bsngal lo// sdug pa dang bral ba ni sdug bsngal lo// gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal lo zhes phyi la brten pa'i sdug bsngal gsum dang*/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni sdug bsngal lo zhes thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am rgyur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gcig rnams gsungs pa ste/ sdug bsngal yang yang smos pa ni sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa nges par gzung bas gdul bya rnams 'khor ba la skyo ba skyed pa'i don du'o// mdo'i don bshad pa la/ ci'i phyir skye ba sdug bsngal zhe na/ mngal du 'dug pa na zas zhu ma zhu'i bar dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sna tshogs kyis btsir zhing*/ btsa' ba na yang mngal gyi sgos dam du btsir bas dog pa'i sdug bsngal nyid kyi phyir dang*/ skyes nas kyang de las gzhan pa rga shi dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams zhar las 'byung ba nyid kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir ro// ci'i phyir rga ba sdug bsngal zhe na/ na tshod dam lang tsho dar ba las rgud par 'gyur te lus kyi mthu nyams pas sdug bsngal ba nyid kyi phyir ro// ci'i phyir na ba sdug bsngal zhe na/ rlung mkhris bad kan gyis khams ma snyoms par 'gyur te zug rngu drag pos gzir ba'i sdug bsngal ba nyid kyi phyir ro// ci'i phyir 'chi ba (462) sdug bsngal zhe na/ srog gi dbang po 'gyur ba na gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal mtshon rnon pos btab pa lta bu myong ba nyid kyi phyir ro// ci'i phyir mi sdug pa dang phrad pa sdug bsngal zhe na/

dgra dang mtshon cha la sogs pa yid du mi 'ong ba dang phrad pa las lus sems sdug bsngal ba nyid kyi phyir ro// ci'i phyir sdug pa dang bral ba sdug bsngal zhe na/ gnyen bshes dang nor rdzas la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba dang bral ba las lus sems sdug bsngal ba nyid kyi phyir ro// ci'i phyir gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal zhe na/ sems kyi 'dod pa lus ngag gis btsal yang ma rnyed pa na yid la re ba'i 'bras bu grub pa med pas sdug bsngal ba nyid kyi phyir ro// ci'i phyir mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal zhe na/ de ni nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa'i phyir/ de las de dag rgyas par 'gyur bas na gnas ngan len nam sa bon gyi sgo nas sdug bsngal ba nyid kyi phyir ro// de dag la ni dog pas sdug bsngal zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rgyu'i don la rnam dbye gsum pa sbyar ro/ ye shes bshes gnyen/ gnyis pa/ de rnams drug tu bsdu ba la/ sdug bsngal de dag ni phye na brgyad yin yang bsdu na drug tu 'gyur zhing*/ bsdu na drug yin yang phye na brgyad du 'gyur te/ skye ba dog pa'i sdug bsngal dang rga ba na ba 'chi ba rnams na tshod khams dang srog 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ yid la re ba 'bras bu med pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba gnas ngan len gyi sdug bsngal lo// sdug bsngal gsum du bstan pa la/ gang mdo las sdug bsngal nyid gsum gsungs na/ ci sdug bsngal nyid gsum po dag gis sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad bsdus sam/ 'on te sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad kyis sdug bsngal nyid gsum bsdus (463) zhe na/ de dag phan tshun gcig gis bsdus pas ma tshang ba'i skyon med de/ de'ang brgyad kyi skabs su/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/

rga ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ na ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal zhes gsungs pa 'dis ni/ sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rang gi mtshan nyid yin pas gsum gyi skabs su sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to// de bzhin du sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal zhes gang gsungs pa 'dis ni/ bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos 'gyur ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid yin pas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to// mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal lo zhes gang gsungs pa 'dis ni/ bde sdug las ma grol zhing mi rtag pa nyid rjes su 'brel te grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pas/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to// gsum pa/ de dag gnyis su bsdu ba ni/ yang mdo las/ kun rdzob kyi bden par sdug bsngal dang*/ don dam pa'i bden par sdug bsngal ba zhes gang gsungs pa la/ brgyad po de dag las kun rdzob kyi bden par sdug bsngal ba ni gang yin/ don dam pa'i bden par sdug bsngal ba ni gang zhe na/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal nas 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'i bar ni rtogs par sla bas 'jig rten pa'i shes pas kyang sdug bsngal du rig cing de'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob kyi bden par sdug bsngal ba'o// mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal lo zhes gang gsungs pa ni/ mdzod 'grel du/ byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis// 'du byed sdug (464) bsngal spu mi rtogs// 'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba yis// de yis shin tu yid kyang 'byung*// zhes pa ltar 'jig rten pas rtogs par dka' la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes pas sdug bsngal du rig cing de'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i bden par sdug bsngal ba'o// gsum pa/ spyi mtshan bstan pa la/

sngar las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu zhes pa la sogs pas rang gi mtshan nyid bshad nas/ da ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ thun mong gi dbye ba ni/ gang 'dus byas yin pa de mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid can dang*/ gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal ba'i mtshan nyid can dang*/ gang sdug bsngal ba de stong pa'i mtshan nyid can dang*/ gang stong pa de bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid can no// zhes rnal 'byor pa rnams rnam pa 'di bzhis dpyod pa ste/ 'dus byas rtag pa la sogs par 'dzin pa'i gnyen po nyid do// so so'i ngo bo la/ mi rtag sdug bsngal/ stong pa/ bdag med bzhi las/ dang po mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ mdor bstan ni/ med dang rnam 'jig 'byung bral nye ba dang*// chos nyid skad cig rgyun dang nad la sogs// sems ni sna tshogs rnam par 'byung ba dang*// 'byor pa rgud dang snod kyi 'jig chags nyid// ces pa/ bar sdom du byas te/ mtshan nyid bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas mi rtag pa sdug bsngal gyi bden pa rig par bya ste/ gang med pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ rnam par 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ 'bral ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ nye ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ chos kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ skad cig gi mtshan nyid dang*/ rgyun gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ nad la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ sems sna tshogs kyi rnam par 'byung ba'i mtshan (465) nyid dang*/ longs spyod 'byor pa rgud pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ snod 'jig pa dang 'chags pa'i mtshan nyid rnams kyis 'chad pa nyid do// rgyas bshad la med pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ mi rtag pa'i mi zhes pa dgag tshig yin la/ rtag pa zhes pa dus thams cad pa yin pas/ rtag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i don te/ mi rtag don ni med don dang*// zhes pa ltar dgag gzhi gang nyer len gyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams la dgag bya'i chos rtag gcig rang dbang can la sogs pa'i bdag dang bdag gi ba dus rtag tu med pa'o// rnam par 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/

skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can dang*// zhes pa ltar 'du byed rgyu rkyen las skyes pa rnams kyi byung nas med par 'gyur ba'i rnam par 'jig pa'o// 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ gang 'du byed rnams kyi gsar pa las rnying pa dang lang tsho las rgan po la sogs pa rgyun gzhan dang gzhan du mi 'dra ba 'byung ba'o// 'bral ba'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ gang 'du byed dngos po'i khyad par zas gos dang chung ma la sogs pa'i longs spyod rnams la/ rang nyid rgas pa la sogs pas zil gyis mnan nas dbang byed pa nyams pa dang*/ kha cig tu ni rgyal srid la sogs pa gzhan dag gis phrogs nas bdag gir byas pas nyams pa'o// nye ba'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ nad la sogs pa sngon du song nas 'chi ba lta bu de nyid kyi tshe mi rtag pa myong zhing mi rtag pa nyid kyis non te de las ma 'das pa'o// chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rgyu med phyir na 'jig pa ni// rang gi ngo bos rjes 'brel nyid// ces pa ltar dngos po rnams mi rtag pa nyid gdon mi za bar myong 'gyur du 'byung ba/ rkyen gzhan la mi ltos par rang (466) rgyus 'brel pa ste/ me'i tsha ba lta bu'o// skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ 'du byed rnams skyes dus kyi skad cig las gnyis pa phan chad du mi gnas par de ma thag 'jig pa'o// rgyun gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'ongs shing slar yang mtha' med du 'gro ba can gyi 'du byed rnams kyi tshe rabs snga ma nas phyi mar brgyud de skye ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'o// nad la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ na bas khams ma snyoms par 'gyur ba dang*/ rga bas na tshod rgud par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'chi bas srog gi dbang po 'gag pa la sogs pa rnams su 'gyur ba'o// sems sna tshogs kyi rnam par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rkyen gyi dbang gis res 'ga' spang bya 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems dang*/

res 'ga' gnyen po 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te khong khro zhe sdang dang bcas pa dang*/ zhe sdang dang bral ba byams pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ rmongs pa gti mug dang bcas pa dang*/ gti mug dang bral ba shes rab kyi ngo bo dang*/ nang du dmigs pa la sems bsdus te zhi gnas la 'jog pa dang*/ phyi rol du 'dod yon la sems 'phros te rnam par g.yengs pa dang*/ gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa bying ba dang*/ dang bar 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa la sems rab tu bzung ba dang*/ sngon gyi rtse rtse rjes su dran pas rgod pa dang*/ de gnyen pos 'dul bar byed pas mi rgod pa dang*/ bying rgod kyi mthar lhung bas nye bar ma zhi ba dang*/ bying rgod kyi mtha' dang bral bas nye bar zhi ba dang*/ nang du ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ de las langs te tha mal du gnas pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang*/ gzhan yang las su rung ba dang mi rung ba dang*/ bsgoms pa dang ma bsgoms pa dang*/ grol ba dang ma grol ba (467) la sogs pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs par sems pa 'byung ba gang yin pa'o// longs spyod kyi 'byor pa rgud pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ dar ba rgud par ma gyur su zhig yod// ces pa ltar 'jig rten pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi mtha' ni gtan du gnas pa ma yin pas rgud par gyur pa'i nyes pa dang ldan pa nyid do// snod 'jig pa dang 'chags pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ 'jig pa'i tshul dngos dang*/ bskal ba'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la gsum las/ dang po/ gzhung don gyi dbye ba mdor bstan ni/ sa chen po la sogs pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'di 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen rnam pa gsum ste/ mes 'tshig par byed pa dang*/ chus 'drul bar byed pa dang*/ rlung gis skem zhing 'thor bar byed pa'o// 'jig pa na lus pa gsum ste/ de yi skyon dang chos mthun phyir// zhes pa ltar bsam gtan dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu yod pas de man chad mes 'tshig cing gnyis pa yan chad lus pa dang*/

gnyis pa na dga' ba chu lta bu yod pas de man chad chus 'drul zhing gsum pa yan chad lus pa dang*/ gsum pa na dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rlung yod pas de man chad rlung gis bskams shing bzhi pa yan chad lus pa dang*/ de yang*/ bzhi pa na med mi g.yo'i phyir// zhes pa ltar phyi rol gyi rkyen gyis 'jig pa ni med do// 'on kyang*/ mi rtag de yi gzhal med khang*// sems can bcas te 'byung 'jig phyir// zhes pa ltar bsam gtan bzhi pa ba'i sems can skye ba na yang de'i gzhal med khang rnams dang lhan cig dus mnyam du 'byung ba dang*/ 'chi ba na yang gzhal med khang rnams dang lhan cig dus mnyam du 'gag pas 'jig cing 'chags so// gnyis pa/ de'i don rgyas par bshad pa ni/ 'jig (468) pa'i bskal ba dmyal ba yi// srid pa med nas snod zad pa// zhes pa ltar gnas pa'i bskal pa rdzogs pa dang dmyal bar sems can gsar pa mi skye zhing*/ rnying pa las zad pa rnams shi 'phos nas 'gro ba gzhan du skye la/ ma zad pa rnams 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan gyi dmyal bar skye ste/ thog mar 'di'i dmyal ba ma lus pa 'jig go /dud 'gro dang yi dwags rnams kyang de dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang gnas na gnas pa rnams sngon la 'jig cing*/ bde 'gro dang lhan cig pa rnams ni de dag dang lhan cig 'jig go /de nas mi 'ga' zhig chos nyid kyis thob pa'i bsam gtan gnyis pa bskyed de/ gzhan rnams kyang de'i rjes su slob cing shi 'phos nas 'od gsal gyi lhar skye la/ 'dod lha rnams kyang de dang 'dra'o// mdzod 'grel du/ gling gsum gyi mi rnams bsam gtan dang po bskyed cing*/ sgra mi snyan pa la chags bral gyi lam med pas thog mar 'dod lhar skye ste/ 'dod lha rnams kyang bsam gtan dang po bskyed nas shi 'phos pa dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye la/ der chos nyid kyis thob pa'i bsam gtan gnyis pa bskyed nas 'od gsal du skye bar yang bshad do// de bzhin du chus 'jig pa na bsam gtan gsum pa'i bar thob nas der skye zhing*/

rlung gis 'jig pa na bzhi pa'i bar thob nas der skye ste/ thog mar bcud kyi sems can ma lus pa 'jig go /de nas snod kyi 'jig rten mes 'jig pa na/ sems can gyi 'phen pa zad pas yo byad gsar pa rnams mi 'byung zhing char mi 'bab pas/ sman dang rtsi shing nags tshal rnams nyi ma 'di nyid kyis sreg la/ 'di bas bzhi 'gyur gyis tsha ba'i nyi ma drug rim gyis shar nas/ nyi ma gnyis pas lteng ka che chung dang*/ gsum pas chu bo che chung dang*/ bzhi pas mtsho ma dros

(469) pa dang*/ lnga pa dang drug pa'i phyogs gcig gis rgya mtsho chen po rnams bskems shing*/ drug pa dang bdun pas ri rab dang sa chen po yang bsregs te/ me lce rlung gis khyer bas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad bsregs nas du ba dang thal ba'i lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par 'jig go /de'i tshe 'od gsal ba lha gzhon pa rnams me lce byung bar dogs pas skrag pa la/ lha rgan pa srid pa 'chags 'jig la mkhas pa rnams kyis/ grogs po dag ma 'jigs shig me lce 'di ni sngon yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong pa lan mang du bsregs nas de nyid du mi snang bar 'gyur ro zhes dbugs 'byin par 'gyur te/ de dag ni lus 'dra zhing gcig kyang 'du shes tha dad du gyur pa'i lha zhes bshad do// chus 'jig pa na bsam gtan gnyis pa nyid las byung ba'i chus snod thams cad lan tshwa bzhin du zhu nas 'jig cing chu de'ang mi snang bar 'gyur la/ rlung gis 'jig pa na bsam gtan gsum pa nyid las byung ba'i rlung gis gsar lus rlung nad kyis bskams pa ltar snod thams cad bskams nas med par byed cing*/ mdzod 'grel las 'thor bar bshad/ rlung de'ang mi snang bar 'gyur ro// de bas na/ gdags par/ de ltar lhun po rgya mtsho che dwangs pa// de bzhin mtho ris zad 'gyur shes nas ni// skye bo dam pa rnams kyis brten pa yi// 'phags pa'i gnas la rtag tu blo zhog cig /ces pa ltar rig par bya'o// 'jig par byed pa'i me dang chu dang rlung yang rang rang gi sa pas yin gyi/ sa ris mi mthun pas 'jig pa ni med de/ 'on kyang phan tshun 'brel par 'byung bas de nyid kyis zhes bshad pa'o// gsum pa/ de dag gi grangs dang rim pa ni/ me yis bdun no chu yis gcig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas yang*// me yis bdun no de nas ni/ (470) /mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa yin// zhes pa ltar mes 'jig pa lan bdun bdun gyi rjes su chus 'jig pa lan re re 'byung zhing*/

de ltar me yis bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang*/ chus bdun thal nas/ slar yang mes lan bdun 'jig la/ de thams cad kyi rjes su rlung gis lan gcig 'jig ste/ de lta bu'i bskal chen drug cu rtsa bzhi la/ mes 'jig pa ni lnga bcu rtsa drug dang*/ chus 'jig pa bdun dang*/ rlung gis 'jig pa gcig go /rdo rje gdan dang bya rgod phung po'i ri dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams ni de dag gis mi 'jig par yang gsungs so// gnyis pa/ bskal pa'i rnam gzhag la bzhi ste/ bar bskal gyi rdzogs byed/ gnas skabs bzhis bskal chen/ bskal pa'i zhar 'byung*/ zhar las byung ba'i 'phros pa'o// dang po ni/ bskal chen gyi dbus su 'byung bas bskal pa bar ma ni gsum ste zhes mdor bstan nas/ de dag rim gyis 'byung tshul rgyas par 'chad pa ni/ sngar byung sems can gzugs can bzhin// de nas rim gyis ro la chags// le los sog 'jog byas nas ni// 'dzin bcas rnams kyis zhing dpon bstabs// zhes pa ltar bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams ni gzugs khams kyi lha lta bu yid las byung ba/ yan lag dang nying lag dang dbang po rnams tshang ba/ rang gi lus la 'od yod pa/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ zas su dga' bde za ba/ tshe lo dpag med thub pa yod pa las/ bar skabs su las kyi dbang gis sa'i bcud kha dog mar gsar pa lta bu/ ro sbrang rtsi bskol ma ltar mngar ba/ sa'i steng chus khyab pa la rlung gis spris ma ltar byas pa 'byung ste/ ro la chags pa 'ga' zhig sor mos blangs nas zos pas gzhan rnams kyang de ltar byed cing*/ kham zas zos pas lus rtsub pa dang lci bar gyur nas 'od yal zhing (471) mun pa byung pa na spyi'i las kyis nyi ma dang zla ba 'byung ngo*// ro la chags pas sa'i bcud de nub pa dang*/ sa'i zhag ser po sbrang rtsi'i ro can byung zhing*/ ldum po'i tshal dmar po sbrang rtsi'i ro can 'byung la/ de nub pa dang ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu phub ma dang shun pa med pa 'byung ste/

zas rags pa de zos pas rgyu mthun 'byung ba'i bshang gci'i lam dang pho mo'i dbang po byung nas/ sngon goms dang tshul min yid la byed pas 'khrig pa spyod pa 'byung zhing*/ de la smad pas bsrung ba'i ched du khyim byed pa 'byung ngo*// 'bras sā lu de nang za bar bya ba nang len zhing*/ nub za bar bya ba nub len pa na/ le lo can 'ga' zhig gis sog 'jog byas pa dang thams cad de bzhin du byed pas slar mi skye'o// de nas zhing bgos te 'dzin pa la ma byin len bsrung ba'i ched du ston thog gi drug cha bstabs nas zhing dpon bskos pas mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal rigs byung ngo*// der kha cig khyim gyi nyes dmigs mthong nas yid phyir phyogs pas phyi rol pa'i bram ze'i rigs dang*/ kha cig las rnam pa sna tshogs byed kyang dman pa'i las mi byed pas rje'u rigs dang*/ kha cig ngan las gnod pa'i las 'ba' zhig byed pas dmangs rigs dang*/ kha cig rgyal po'i rngan pa la bltas nas mi gsod pa gtum po gdol pa'i rigs rnams kyang 'byung ngo*// de nas las kyi lam lhag pas// tshe thung lo ni bcu yin no// zhes pa ltar phyis rgyal po 'ga' zhig gis chags pa'i dbang gis zhing ma bgos par mang du zung bas rkun po byung zhing*/ de la mtshon gyis 'debs pas na ma brkus so zhes rdzun du smra ba la sogs pa mi dge ba bcu 'byung la/ de lhag par spyad pas ngan song gsum 'grub cing*/ tshe lo dpag med nas (472) bcu pa'i bar du rim gyis 'grib ste/ bar gyi bskal pa dpag med nas// tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'o// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar 'grib pa'i tshe lo sum cu pa nas mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma lo bdun dang zla bdun zhag bdun 'byung ste/ mis chos min spyad pa na lhas char mi 'bebs shing 'bru mi smin pas/ bkres shing nyam chung ba rnams 'dus nas 'chi ba dang*/ gab tse'i nang du sa bon bzhag nas rin po che ltar srung bas gab tse ba dang*/

sha zad nas shi ma thag rus pa snum med dkar por 'gyur ba dang*/ rus pa dkar po chu nang bcug ste bskol nas 'thung bas rus gong dkar po ba dang*/ thur mas nyi ma res mos su zad 'gyed pa dang*/ thur mas rtsig srub nas 'bru brus te chu nang bskol te 'thung ba thur mas 'tsho ba zhes bya ba gsum gyis phal cher 'chi zhing*/ shi ba rnams kyang yi dwags su skye'o// lhag ma rnams 'dus te skye ba cung zad bskyed nas mi dge ci rigs pa spangs pas re zhig tshe'ang mi 'grib cing mu ge'ang 'chad do// de nas yang skyo ba med par chos min spyad pa las tshe lo nyi shu par 'gribs pa na/ nad kyi bskal pa bar ma zla bdun dang zhag bdun 'byung ste/ mi ma yin rnams kyis yams dang gnod pa dang 'go ba'i nad gsor mi rung ba sna tshogs btang nas/ sman ster ba dang g.yog byed pa la sogs pa med par/ zug rngu drag pos gzir zhing phal cher 'chi'o// lhag ma rnams 'dus te skyo ba bar par bskyed nas mi dge ba ci rigs su spangs pas re zhig tshe'ang mi 'grib cing nad kyang 'chad do// de nas skyo ba med par chos min shas cher spyad pas tshe lo bcu par 'grib pa na/ tshe rgud pa ring na lo bcu dang*/ lus rgud pa mtho gang chang gang dang*/ longs spyod rgud pas mar dang 'bru mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bu ram dang lan tshwa ni med cing*/ zas kyi (473) mchog khre rgod dang*/ gos kyi mchog skra'i lwa ba dang*/ rgyan gyi mchog mtshon cha la byed de/ bu mo rnams kyang zla ba lnga lon nas bag ma la gtang bar 'byung ngo*// de'i tshe mtshon gyi bskal pa bar ma zhag bdun 'byung ste mi rnams phan tshun rngon pas ri dwags mthong ba ltar gnod sems drag po skyes nas/ gang blangs pa thams cad mtshon cha rnon po brdar bar gyur pas gcig gis gcig gsod cing phal cher 'chi'o// nad dang mtshon gyis shi ba rnams kyang dmyal bar skye'o// de'i tshe gling gnyis su bkres skom tsam dang*/

mdog ngan zhing nyam chung ba tsam dang*/ gnod sems tsam 'byung ngo*// mdzod 'grel du gsum ka tshe lo bcu pa la 'byung bar bshad cing*/ dge 'dun la bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang*/ sman 'bul ba dang*/ nyi ma 'ga' zhig srog gcod spangs na de dag las thar bar yang gsungs so// gdags par/ tshe lo bcu pa re re la res mos su 'byung bar bshad cing*/ rgyal po'i sras kyang de ltar bzhed do// de dag gis ni gnas pa'i bar gyi bskal pa gcig tshar phyin zhing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes pa ste/ bskal pa mtshon dang nad dang ni// mu ge rnams kyis tshar phyin te// zhag rnams dang ni zla ba dang*// lo bdun dag ste go rim bzhin// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa/ bskal chen ni bshad zin pa ltar/ brgyad khri pa nas bcu pa'i bar du rim gyis mar 'bri ba'i bar gyi bskal pa gcig ste ya thog ring po dang slar yang yar 'phel ba dang zhes pa ni mtshon gyi rjes su phan tshun 'dus nas skyo ba shas cher bskyed pa las/ 'di lta bu la mtshon na/ snying rje pad+ma dkar por/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi nang du/ rje btsun byams pa khru gang pa cig byon nas lus che zhing tshe ring ba'i rgyu ni mi dge (474) ba bcu spangs pa'o zhes chos bstan pa dang*/ lus kyi gsum spangs pas nyi shu pa dang lnga bcu pa dang brgya bar 'phel zhing*/ ngag gi bzhi spangs pas rim pa bzhin phyed dang sum brgya/ lnga brgya/ stong*/ rim pa bzhin/ nyis stong pa dang*/ yid kyi gsum spangs pas lnga stong*/ khri/ nyi khri/ chos ma yin pa'i chags pas chags pa dang 'dod pas zil gyis non pa dang log chos ldan pa spangs pas/ bzhi khri bar 'phel la/ pha dang mar bzung nas byams pa bsgoms pas brgyad khri bar 'phel te/ lus dang mdog dang stobs dang dbang phyug dang dbang byed pa rnams kyang 'phel nas/ sa gzhi thams cad bya gag 'phur bas sleb tsam gyi bar yod pa'i grong gis khyab pa dang*/

snye ma re la 'bru bre bzhi bzhi 'byung ba dang*/ bu mo rnams kyang lo lnga brgya lon nas bag mar gtong ba la sogs par gsungs pa'o// de nas yang mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam lhag par spyad pa'i dbang gis tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du mar 'bri ba gnyis ni bar gyi khug pa ste/ de lta bu bco brgyad dang slar yang dge ba'i dbang gis/ de rnams tshe ni brgyad khri'i bar// zhes pa ltar yang skye ba gcig ni ma thog ring mo ste/ de lta bu'i bar gyi bskal pa bcu dang*/ gcig la snod 'jig pas nyi shur 'jig rten 'jig go /thog mtha'i rkyang pa re dang bar gyi khug pa re ni dus mnyam par bshad cing*/ de dag la lo brgya'am nyis brgya zhing lo re res 'phel 'grib byed par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ dge sdig stobs che chung gi dbang gis 'phel 'grib stobs che chung du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ thog mtha'i rkyang pa gnyis kyi 'phel 'grib ni bul bar bshad/ bar gyi khug pa rnams kyi 'phel 'grib ni 'grib pa la mi dge ba stobs che bas myur la yar 'phel pa na yang dge stobs che bas myur ro zhes gsungs so// bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur 'jig rten zhig nas stongs par 'dug go zhes pa ni de'i bar la 'phel 'grib mi (475) 'jug kyang yul mnyam pa'o// bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur 'jig rten 'chags so// zhes pa ni gcig la snod dang bcu dgu la bcud kyi 'jig rten te/ 'chags pa dang po rlung nas ni// dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du 'o// zhes pa ltar sems can gyi las kyi dbang gis snod 'chags pa'i snga ltas su gyur pa'i rlung 'jam po dal bus langs pa las thog mar nam mkha' la gnas gzhan rnams yas rim bzhin 'chags shing*/ de'i rjes su rlung nas ri rab kyi bar mas rim bzhin 'chags so// de'ang gang mjug tu zhig pa de dang por chags pas/ rlung gis zhig pa'i rjes yin na bsam gtan gsum pa man chad dang*/

chus zhig pa'i rjes yin na gnyis pa man chad dang*/ mes zhig pa'i rjes yin na dang po man chad nas 'thab bral gyi bar gyi gzhal med khang rnams bar snang la sprul pa ltar 'chags so// de nas rim gyis sngar bshad pa ltar rlung dal bus langs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa las 'og gzhi'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'chags shing*/ de'i steng du sprin gser gyi snying po can las char chen po babs pas chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i steng rlung gis 'thas shing sra bar byas pas sa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i steng du sprin khams sna tshogs can las char babs pas rgya mtsho chen po rnams 'chags te/ snying rje pad+ma dkar por/ chu de'i nang na gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong snang nas/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis ci'i snga ltas yin zhes brtags pa na/ bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung bar shes te/ bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes bsgrags so zhes kyang 'byung ngo*// rgya mtsho'i khams bzang shos rnams rlung gis bsrubs pa las ri rab dang*/ bar ma rnams bsrubs pa las gser gyi ri bdun dang*/ (476) ngan pa rnams bsrubs pa las gling dang gling phran dang khor yug gi ri rnams 'chags so// sems can 'chags pa ni/ rlung gis zhig pa'i rjes su bsam gtan bzhi pa nas gsum pa la sogs par skye zhing chus zhig pa'i rjes su gsum pa nas gnyis pa la sogs par skye la/ 'di ni mes zhig pa'i rjes yin pas/ gnyis pa 'od gsal ba'i lha tshe dang bsod nams dang las zad pa zhig shi 'phos nas tshangs pa chen por skyes te shed bdag tu rtog go /de gcig pu skyo bar gyur nas 'di skyo ba ni yid bde ma yin gyi skyo ba yin no// sems can gzhan yang 'dir skye bar gyur cig snyam du smon pa na slar yang 'ga' zhig gong ma nas der skyes pa ni shed las skyes su rtog cing*/ de dag lus kyi rnam pa tha dad kyang tshangs pa chung bar 'du shes mthun pas/

lus sha dang cing 'du shes gcig pa'i lha zhes gsungs so// de nas yas rim gyis 'dod lha drug dang*/ byang dang nub dang shar dang lho'i mi rnams 'chags shing*/ der mi dge ba spyad pa'i dbang gis ngan song gsum rim gyis 'chags te/ dmyal bar sems can gcig skyes pa dang*/ 'chags pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gnas pa rtsom pa dang*/ tshe lo dpag med nas 'grib pa mgo tshugs pa rnams mnyam pa'o// bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur 'jig rten 'chags nas gnas par 'dug go zhes pa ni/ de nas yar skye mar 'bri ba'i// bskal pa gzhan ni bco brgyad dang*// yar skye ba ni gcig yin te// de ltar 'jig rten 'chags pa 'di// bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur gnas/ zhes pa ltar te/ sar/ khug pa nyi shur gnas par yang gsungs so// gnas pa'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la ni sangs rgyas stong 'byung ste/ de yang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdor/ sngon bskal pa mdzes par snang ba la 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par brgyan par sangs rgyas (477) yon tan mtha' yas rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba byon te/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung du 'gyur pa la sras stong yod pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub la zhugs par shes nas/ gang sngon la 'tshang rgya ba brtag pa'i phyir bum pa'i nang du mtshan byang rnams bcug ste rim gyis bton pa na/ dang por rgyal bu che shos rnam par dag pa'i blo gros byung ba ni rgyal ba 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ mthar chung shos blo mtha' yas pa byung ba ni sangs rgyas mos pa dang*/ btsun mo dam pa ma smad pa'i pang du brdzus te skyes pa'i khye'u chos kyi sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas stong gi sku dang bstan pa srung bar smon lam btab pa dpal phyag na rdo rje dang*/ btsun mo dpe med ma'i pang du skyes pa chos kyi blo gros ni sangs rgyas stong la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar skul bar smon lam btab pa tshangs pa gtsug phud can no zhes gsungs so// de rnams re re zhing yang bskal pa bzang po'i mdor/

yul rigs 'od dang yab yum sras// rim gro shes rab rdzu 'phrul mchog /'khor 'dus sku tshe dam chos gnas// sku gdung bcu gsum don gyis bshad// ces bya ste ston pa 'di la mtshon na/ yul ni grong khyer ser skya'o// rigs ni rgyal rigs so// 'od ni 'dom gang ngo*// yab ni zas gtsang ma'o// yum ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo'o// sras ni sgra gcan 'dzin no// rim gro pa ni kun dga' bo'o// shes rab can rnams kyi mchog ni shā ri'i bu'o// rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog ni mau'u gal gyi bu'o// 'khor 'dus pa ni brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum mo// sku tshe ni lo brgyad cu dang*/ dam pa'i chos ni lo stong phrag lngar gnas so// sku gdung ni rgyas par 'gyur ro// zhes pa la sogs pa'o// snying rje pad+ma dkar por/ bar

(478) bskal dang po 'di'i tshe lo bzhi khri pa la sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ sum khri pa la gser thub dang*/ nyi khri pa la 'od srungs dang*/ brgya pa la shākya'i rgyal po byon par gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdor/ ston pa 'di nyid rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa na rgyal ba shākya thub pa chen po la sems bskyed de/ grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pa las tshong dpon shes rab bzang por gyur pa na sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag gi drung du sa dang po thob cing*/ grangs med gnyis pa song ba dang bram ze'i khye'u gzhon nu sprin du gyur pa na sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi spyan sngar sa brgyad pa thob nas grangs med gsum song ba las mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gsungs so// phyis tshe lo brgyad khri par 'phel ba na rgyal ba byams pa 'jig rten du byon te/ 'khor 'dus pa dang po la dgra bcom pa khrag khrig phrag dgu dang*/ ther 'bum chen po phrag drug 'byung zhing*/ de nas rim gyis seng ge dang*/ rab gsal dang*/ me tog dang*/ me tog gnyis pa la sogs pa 'byung la/ mthar thams cad kyi gcung po mos pa'am snang mdzad 'byung ste/ de ni 'khor dang sku tshe dang mdzad pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas stong gi gzhan thams cad dang mnyam par gsungs so// bskal pa bzang po 'di'i 'og tu bskal pa drug cu rtsa lngar sangs rgyas mi 'byung zhing*/ de nas bskal pa snyan grags chen po la sangs rgyas khri phrag gcig 'byung ngo*// de'i 'og bskal pa brgyad cur yang sangs rgyas mi 'byung zhing*/ de nas bskal ba skar ma lta bu la sangs rgyas brgyad khri 'byung ngo*// de 'og tu bskal pa sum brgyar sangs rgyas mi 'byung zhing*/ de nas bskal pa yon tan bkod pa la sangs rgyas brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ngo*// de ltar na sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i bskal pa ni nyung zhing*/ (479) mun pa'i bskal pa ni shin tu mang bas sangs rgyas 'jig rten tu byon nas bstan pa gnas pa'i dus su dal 'byor thob pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos la 'bad par rigs so// de ltar 'jig rten 'jig pa dang stong pa dang 'chags pa dang gnas pa'i gnas skabs bzhi po de dag ni bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu ste/

de rnams thams cad la ni bskal pa chen po gcig ces bya'o// de'ang zhing khams 'di'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi mtha' gcig tu nges pa ni med de/ brgyad stong 'grel par/ bskal pa skar ma lta bu'i mar 'grib la'ang da lta'i bar bskal nyi khri yod par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ thub dbang 'od dpag med dang rdo rje rab 'joms dang*// sku mchog phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo rab sgrogs dang*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan seng ge rnam snang snying po dang*// chos kyi 'od zer pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa dang*// mngon par mkhyen pa kun gyi gzi brjid rgyal po dang*// zla ba'i thugs mnga' bzang po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bar skabs kyi sdom ste/ phal po cher/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhing mi mjed kyi bskal chen la/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bde ba can gyi zhag gcig go zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas bcu gcig de rnams kyi snga ma snga ma'i bskal chen la phyi ma phyi ma'i zhag rer gsungs shing*/ sangs rgyas de dag byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can gyis thos kyi/ gzhan gyis ni mi thos par yang gsungs so// bskal chen las 'phros nas/ de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas// 'byung ngo mar ni 'grib pa yi// brgya yi bar la de dag 'byung*// rang sangs rgyas rnams gnyis ka la// zhes pa'i grangs med ni grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cu'i tha ma yin la/ de'ang lung sil bur 'byung ba ltar sdom du byas na/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum (480) dang*// sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams// rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya// ther 'bum dang ther 'bum chen po zhes sogs khrag khrig rab bkram dang*// gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang*// pang steng der 'dren mtha' snang dang*// rgyu rig 'o mdzes dbang po dang*// legs phyin rtogs 'gro 'bying rdul dang*// rgya rtags stobs 'khor brda shes dang*// rnam 'byung dang ni stobs mig rnams// chen po'i zla dang bcas pa ste// grangs med pa ni tha ma yin// zhes pa ltar te thams cad kyang bcu 'gyur du bsgre zhing*/

bar nas brgyad ma rnyed pa ni ming gang yang rung ba gzhug par gsungs so// de yang mdo dang byang sar/ grangs med dang pos sa dang po'i bar dang*/ gnyis pas sa bdun pa'i bar dang*/ gsum pas sa bcu pa'i bar rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs shing*/ dbyig gnyen dang seng bzang*/ kha cig ni gsum tshan du chos mthun pas gsum zhes brjod kyi/ don la sum cu rtsa gsum yin te/ dang po gsum gyis mos spyod kyi sa dang*/ de nas gsum gsum gyis sa bcu po re re rdzogs par bzhed cing*/ 'ga' zhig tu bskal bzang bdun dang sde pa tha dad bklag par bcus rdzogs par gsungs pa'ang yod do// de lta na yang brtson 'grus dang thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis yun thung ngu la'ang bskal pa mang po'i tshogs 'dums pa yod de/ gsang chen thabs mkhas kyi/ mdo las ston pa de nyid bram ze'i khye'u skar mar gyur pa na tshong dpon gyi bu mo dang lhan cig 'dus pas bskal pa khri'i tshogs 'dums pa dang*/ ded dpon thabs la mkhas par gyur pa na mi nag po bsad pas bskal pa 'bum gyi tshogs 'dums pa dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod par thob pa ni 'dod na zhag bdun gyis 'tshang rgya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de'ang yar 'phel la gdul bya rnams skyo bar dka' ba'i phyir/ (481) brgyad khri pa nas brgya pa'i bar gyi mar 'grib la 'byung*/ brgya pa man chad la tshe dang dus dang nyon mongs pa dang lta ba dang sems can gyi snyigs ma lnga shin tu shes che ba'i phyir mi 'byung la/ rang sangs rgyas ni yar 'phel dang mar 'grib gnyis ka la 'byung ngo zhes pa ni thun mong ba'i rnam gzhag ste/ theg chen pa'i lugs la ni/ snying rje pad+ma dkar por/ 'jig rten gyi khams mthe bong can zhes bya bar mthe bong gi tshad tsam mi rnams kyi nang du tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su sangs rgyas skar ma la dga' ba byon pa dang*/ tshe lo sum cu pa dang lnga bcu pa la sogs pa la'ang sangs rgyas 'byon par gsungs shing*/

bskal bzang du/ mi yi 'dren pa snang mdzad pa'i// mi rnams tshe lo dpag tu med// sangs rgyas dgu brgya dgu bcu dgus// ji snyed mdzad kun des mdzad 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so// gsum pa/ zhar byung ni/ bskal pa bgrang ba'i tshul des gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad dang*/ gzugs med pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad ni gong du rgyas par bshad zin pa nyid do// de dag gi tshangs chen pa'i tshe tshad bar bskal drug cur gsungs kyang lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la btags pa ste/ snod 'chags 'jig gi bar bskal gnyis dang stongs pa'i bar bskal nyi shu de'i tshe tshad du mi rung ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin du 'od gsal ba'i bskal chen brgya dang*/ dge rgyas pa'i bskal chen drug cu rtsa bzhi la'ang chags 'jig gi bar bskal gnyis dang stongs pa'i bar bskal nyi shu re dbri dgos mod/ 'on kyang nye ba la de dag tu btags pa'o// de las 'phros pa ni/ bskal pa mang por gnas pa de dag la 'chi ba med dam snyam na/ khams gong ma'i sems can de dag rang sa'i tshe zad cing 'gal rkyen gyi bsod nams zad la myong 'gyur gyi las kyang zad nas (482) gzugs dang gzugs med kyi gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar 'gyur ro// de 'chad pa la tshe zad pas ji lta bu zhe na/ tshe'i 'phen pa ci tsam yod pa rdzogs te/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na dus su 'chi'o// bsod nams zad pas ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can de dag snyoms par 'jug pa'i ro myang ba dang mtshungs par ldan pas ni skye bar mi 'gyur ro// gal te skyes nas ro myong bar byed na yang de las 'chi 'pho bar 'gyur ro// zhes so/ bas tshe 'phen par byed pa'i bsod nams kyi bag chags la gnod par byas nas zad par 'gyur te/ des na tshe zad dam rdzogs pas/ dus la ma bab kyang dus min du 'chi ba'o// las zad pas ji lta bu zhe na/ gnas gang nas 'chi 'pho ba der skyes nas myong bar 'gyur ba'i las spyad zin pa'i phyir dang*/

lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las bsags pa med pa'i phyir yongs su gtugs pa ste rgyun 'chad pa'i 'chi 'pho ba'o// tshe dang bsod nams zad kyang las ma zad na slar yang gnas der skye'i/ las zad pa ni re zhig mi skye ba nyid do// sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ lan la gnyis las/ dang po/ don dngos bshad zin dran pa la sbyar ba ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid la sogs pa gsum dang*/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa rnam pa brgyad ni sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa'am mtshan nyid can zhes bya'o// gnyis pa/ de dang mdo'i don mthun par bstan pa la 'o na ci'i phyir mdo las gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal du gsungs zhe na/ gnyis las/ dang po/ mi rtag pa la sdug bsngal gsum rtogs tshul la/ mdor bstan ni/ mi rtag pa nyid ni gnyis kyi char gtogs pa ste zag bcas sngar ma byung ba las gsar du 'byung ba skye ba'i char gtogs pa dang*/ byung nas kyang skad cig gnyis par mi gnas pas med par 'gyur ba 'jig pa'i char gtogs (483) pa'o// rgyas bshad ni/ skye ba'i char gtogs pa'i mi rtag pa nyid la brten nas/ sdug bsngal gyi phyogs kyi 'du byed skyes na gnod pa'i bdag nyid du rtogs pas/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid rab tu shes so// 'jig pa'i char gtogs pa'i mi rtag pa nyid la brten nas/ bde ba'i phyogs kyi 'du byed zhig na yid mi bde 'byung bas/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid rab tu shes so// skye 'jig de gnyis ka'i char gtogs pa'i mi rtag pa nyid la brten nas/ gnas ngan len dang bcas pa'i 'du byed rgyun du 'byung zhing 'jig pa yang 'dod pa ma yin pas/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid rab tu shes so// sdug bsngal skye ba ni 'jig rten na sdug bsngal du grags pa'i phyir dgos pa brjod mi dgos pas/ gnyis ka'i char gtogs 'du byed dang*/ 'jig pa'i char gtogs 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin pa de la dgongs te/

bcom ldan 'das kyis ngas btang snyoms kyi phyogs kyi 'du byed mi rtag pas grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pa nyid dang*/ bde ba'i phyogs kyi 'du byed 'gyur ba na yid mi bde 'byung ba nyid la dgongs nas zag bcas kyi bde sdug btang snyoms gang ci tshor yang 'dir ni 'dir sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo nyid du gsungs so zhes bka' stsal to// mi rtag pa la sdug bsngal brgyad gtogs tshul ni yang skye ba dang 'jig pa rkyen gzhan la mi ltos par chos nyid kyi rjes su 'brel ba'i 'du byed zag pa dang bcas pa rnams la skye ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal brgyad snang zhing mngon te/ de'i phyir mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal zhes bya'o// de ltar skye sogs dang 'brel ba'i mi rtag pa sdug bsngal yin gyi/ mi rtag pa gang yin pa ni sdug bsngal ma yin te/ lam yang sdug bsngal du thal ba'i phyir ro// 'dod (484) par mi nus te/ bsdu bar/ mi rtag pa yin la sdug bsngal ma yin pa yod de/ lam gyi bden pa'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// stong pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ ngo bo nyid gsum dang sbyar ba'o// dang po la/ gsum las dang po/ stong tshul mdor bstan ni/ stong pa'i gzhi gang la stong pa'i chos gang med par don la gnas pa na/ gzhi de ni chos stong par yang dag par thos bsam gyis rtogs pa'i rjes su so so rang rig gis mngon sum du mthong ste yod pa'i mtha' dang bral bar shes shing*/ 'di la lhag ma stong pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de ni 'dir nges par yod pa'i zhes yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin du phyin ci ma log par rtogs pas med pa'i mtha' dang ma bral bar rab tu shes so// de ltar yul mtha' gnyis dang bral ba la blos kyang mtha' gnyis dang bral bar rtogs pa 'di ni stong pa nyid la 'jug pa'i tshul yang dag pa ji lta ba ste/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab phyin ci ma log pa zhes bya'o// yum rgyas pa las so/

gyi 'grel par yang*/ stong pa ni gzhan dang gzhan bral ba ste/ dper na chu dang bral ba'i phyir bum pa stong pa zhes bya ba lta bu'o zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa/ rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gzhi gang la chos ci zhig med ce na/ stong pa'i gzhi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams la stong pa'i chos mi rtag pa med pa'i rtag pa dang*/ skad cig gis mi 'jig pa'i brtan pa dang*/ rgyun gyis mi 'jigs pa'i ther zug dang*/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i chos can gyi bdag brtags pa dang*/ de la ltos pa'i bdag gi ba ni med do// bdag don gzhan dang bral ba de lta bas na gzhi phung po la sogs pa de dag ni chos bdag dang bdag gi ba des stong ngo*// de la lhag ma ci zhig yod (485) ce na/ bdag med phung po tsam nyid do// zhes pa ltar gang brtags pa'i bdag med pa'i 'du byed phung po las de nyid snang tsam du yod pa ste/ de ltar rtag gcig rang dbang can la sogs pa'i bdag ni med kyi bdag med pa'i chos gsum ni re zhig yod pas mtha' dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid khong du chud par bya'o// zhes pa ni gnas skabs rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'i ched du kun rdzob bden pa la sbyar te bshad pa'o// mthar thug don dam pa'i bden pa la sbyar ba ni stong pa'i gzhi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams kyi rang bzhin chos nyid de bzhin nyid la/ stong pa'i chos kun rdzob glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag med cing mi dmigs pas yod pa'i mtha' dang bral zhing*/ chos kyi dbyings lhun gyis grub cing*/ 'gyur ba med pa ni dus rtag tu lhag mar yod pas med pa'i mtha' dang yang bral bas na/ don dam mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid khong du chud par bya'o// rgyud bla mar/ rnam dbye bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag ni dbyings stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyi stong ma yin// zhes gsungs shing*/

de'i 'brel bar yang 'phags pa 'di nyid de dang mthun par bshad la/ mdo las kyang*/ kun dga' bo de lta bas na gang la gang med pa de des stong ngo zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mthong yang*/ de la lhag ma gang yin pa de de la yod do zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ kun dga' bo 'di ltar ste zag pa rnams zad pas zag pa ni med cing*/ mngon par 'dus ma byas pa rnam par grol ba ni yod pa gang yin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid la 'jug pa bla na med pa yin no zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa/ shes (486) byed dgod pa ni/ gnas skabs kun rdzob snang tsam du yod cing dpyad na bdag dang bdag gi ba med pa dang*/ mthar thug don dam mi 'gyur bar yod cing glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag med pa 'di la dgongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ yod pa la yang yod par/ med pa la yang med par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so zhes gsungs so// dbus mthar yang*/ gnyis dngos med pa'i dngos med pa// dngos po stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs shing*/ rgyan las kyang*/ don med pa dang don yod dag /mi snang snang bas yin zhes bya// zhes pa dang*/ med pa gang yin de nyid ni// yod pa yi ni dam par 'dod// ces pa dang*/ rgyud las kyang*/ ye shes ldan pa yod med shes// zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher 'byung ba ltar ro// ngo bo nyid gsum dang sbyar ba la/ spyi don gsum ste/ mtshan nyid gsum ngos bzung*/ 'khrul pa'i skyon spang ba/ chos gsum la 'jug tshul lo// dang po la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ tha dad/ grangs nges so// dang po/ ngo bo la/ kun brtags ni med la med bzhin du rtag gcig rang dbang can la sogs pa'i gang zag gi bdag dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag tu brtags pa/ rtog byed kyi gzung char snang ba/ brtags pa'i cha ci yang med pa ri bong gi rwa lta bu ste/

sum cu par/ rnam par rtog par gang gang gis// dngos po gang gang rnam brtags pa// de nyid kun tu brtags pa yi// ngo bo nyid de de med do// zhes pa ltar ro// gzhan dbang ni khams gsum pa'i shes rig kun brtags kyi gdags gzhir gyur pa/ rtog byed rgyu rkyen la rag las pa ste/ gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid// rnam rtog yin te rkyen las byung*// zhes pa ltar ro// yongs grub ni/ stong pa nyid yin

(487) la de'ang gnas skabs kun rdzob la sbyar ba ni/ gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam de nyid// kun brtags bdag gnyis kyis stong ste// grub ni de la snga mas so// rtag tu med par gyur pa gang*// zhes pa dang*/ dbus mthar yang*/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod// de la gnyis po yod ma yin// zhes pa ltar ro// mthar thug don dam pa la sbyar ba ni/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba med pa de nyid/ kun brtags dang gzhan dbang gis bsdus pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag gis stong pa ste/ 'bum gyi 'grel par/ gzung 'dzin/ kun brtags pa dang rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs kyis stong pa gang yin pa de ni de bzhin nyid yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid chos kyi gzugs zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ rgyan gyi/ yod min med min zhes pa'i 'grel par/ kun brtags pa dang gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid dag gis ni yod pa ma yin no// yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid kyis ni med pa ma yin no zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod par yang*/ yongs grub/ dam pa'i don ni bcos ma yin// ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin dang*// yong dag rdzas dngos yod pa lags// kun/ brtags pa'i dngos po med pa nyid// gzhan gyi dbang yang yod ma lags// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa/ dbye ba la/ kun brtags gsum ni rjod pa ming ji lta bar don du 'du shes shing mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sems byung gi rgyu mtshan nam dmigs yul sngo ser la sogs pa kun tu brtag par bya ba gang yin pa dang*/ rjod pa ming de'i bag chags kun gzhi la yod pa'ang kun brtags kyi rgyu yin pas kun brtags su gzhag pa dang*/ bag chags de las kyang (488) ming don sbyar nas 'dzin pa'i 'du shes med kyang don rkyang par snang ba'i kun tu brtags pa ste/ rgyan las/ ji ltar don rjod 'du shes kyi// rgyu mtshan dang de'i bag chags dang*// de las kyang don snang ba ni// kun tu btags pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// yang kun brtags gnyis ni ming ji lta bar don du snang ba dang*/

don ji lta bar ming du snang ba yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa'i rgyu mtshan nam dmigs pa dag ste/ ming dang don ni ji lta bar// don dang ming du snang ba gang*// yang dag ma rtogs rgyu mtshan ni// kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// yang mig la sogs pa ste dngos po tsam nye bar 'dzin pa/ ngo bo kun brtags dang*/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i chos su brtags pa/ khyad par kun brtags gnyis su'ang 'gyur ro// gzhan dbang gi dbye ba ni/ gnas snod kyi 'jig rten du snang ba dang*/ don gzugs sogs yul lngar snang ba dang*/ lus dbang po gzugs can du snang ba gsum ni gzung ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi rnam par rig pa yin la/ yid nyon mongs pa can du snang ba dang*/ 'dzin pa sgo lnga'i rnam shes su snang ba dang*/ rtog pa yid kyi rnam shes su snang ba gsum ni 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rnam par rig pa yin pas/ de ltar gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rig pa/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa rgyu rkyen la rag las pa dag ste/ rnam gsum rnam gsum snang ba can// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid de// yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni// gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// yang na 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pas phye ba'i sems dang sems las byung ba rnams ste/ dbus mthar/ yang dag ma yin kun (489) rtog ni// sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa// zhes pa ltar ro// yongs grub ni de bzhin nyid yin la de yang byis pas brtags pa bzhin du don la med cing 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul du yod pas yod pa dang med pa mnyam pa nyid rang gi mtshan nyid can dang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma dag gis ma zhi yang rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas zhi ba nyid nyon mongs rnam byang gi mtshan nyid can dang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i spyod yul las 'das pas spros pa med pa nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid can te/

med dang yod nyid gang yin dang*// yod dang med pa mnyam nyid dang*// ma zhi zhi dang rnam mi rtog /yongs su grub pas mtshan nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// yang na chos nyid 'dus ma byas 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi ye shes 'dus byas phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis te/ dbus mthar/ 'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa'i// yongs su grub pa rnam pa gnyis// zhes pa ltar ro// yang yum rgyas pa la sogs pa'i 'grel par/ yongs grub dgur yang gsungs te/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang*/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang*/ chos nyid dang*/ chos kyi dbyings dang*/ chos gnas pa nyid dang*/ chos skyon med pa nyid dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings rnams ni rim pa ltar/ 'jig pa med par yongs su grub pa dang*/ de bzhin du phyin ci ma log pa dang*/ 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ rnam par byang ba'i chos kyi rgyu nyid dang*/ dus thams cad dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ de kho na nyid dang*/ rtog ge ba'i lam las 'das (490) par yongs su grub par bstan pa'o// gsum pa/ tha dad bsam pa ni/ kun brtags la ngo bo med cing yongs grub chos nyid yin pas/ de rnams phan tshun de nyid gzhan du brjod du med pa zhes bya ste/ sum cu par/ de phyir de nyid gzhan dbang las// gzhan min gzhan pa min pa'ang min// zhes gsungs shing*/ theg bsdus su'ang*/ de dag tha dad pa yang ma yin la/ tha dad ma yin pa yang ma yin par brjod par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ dbus mthar yang*/ tha dad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid min// zhes pa ltar ro// bzhi pa/ grangs nges ni/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad brtags pa bzhin don la med pa'i cha ni kun brtags dang*/ rkyen la ltos nas snang tsam du yod kyang dpyad na rang dbang can du med pa'i cha ni gzhan dbang dang*/

chos nyid mi 'gyur bar yod cing glo bur gyi dri ma med pa'i cha ni yongs grub ces bya ba gsum du nges pa ste/ yum bar mar/ byams pa yongs su brtags pa'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni rdzas su med par blta bar bya'o// rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs yin pa de ni rnam par rtog pa rdzas su yod pa'i phyir rdzas su yod par blta'i rang dbang du 'jug pa'i ni ma yin no// chos nyid kyi gzugs gang yin pa de ni rdzas med pa yang ma yin rdzas yod pa yang ma yin te don dam pas rab tu phye bar blta'o zhes pa la sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi bar la sbyar nas gsungs shing*/ de dag gi dgongs pa bsdus nas dbus mthar yang*/ ngo bo nyid gsum brtag med dang*// yod kyang kho na ma yin dang*// yod dang med de'i kho na ste// ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// yang gzugs sogs rang mtshan don la med kyang kun rtog tsam du dmigs pa dang*/ rtog byed kyi shes pa snang tsam du yod pa dang*/ de dag (491) gi chos nyid don dam du grub pa gsum du nges pa'i phyir yang ste/ kun tu rtog don rnam rtog don// chos nyid don gyis de dag der// zhes pa ltar ro// yang don la med bzhin du don du brtags pa'i phyir dang*/ rtog byed yang dag ma yin pa'i kun rtog re zhig dmigs pa'i phyir dang*/ dpyad na gzung 'dzin gnyis po med pa'i chos nyid yongs su grub pa'i phyir yang rnam pa gsum ste/ brtags pa dang ni gzhan dbang dang*// yongs su grub pa nyid kyang ste// don phyir yang dag min rtog phyir// gnyis po med pa'i phyir bshad do// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa/ 'khrul spong ni/ gang dag ngo bo nyid gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa 'di dag rnam rig sems tsam du smra ba kho na'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skad yin gyi/ dbu ma'i gzhung lugs su ni de ltar grags pa ma yin no zhes 'dod pa de dag ni 'khrul pa yin pas rgyang ring du spang bar bya ste/

dbu ma chen po'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams su ngo bo nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag shin tu gsal bar yang yang bstan pa'i phyir ro// de yang ji skad du/ yum bar mar/ byams pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing chos rab tu dbye ba la mkhas par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas rnam pa gsum gyi gzugs rab tu dbye ba gdags pa rjes su shes par bya'o// tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar du rab tu dbye ba gdags pa rjes su shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i gzugs 'di ni rnam par brtag pa'i gzugs so zhes pa la sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi bar la sbyar nas gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bum gyi 'grel par yang*/ kun brtags pa dang (492) rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs de gnyis kyi rnam pa dang bral ba/ yongs su grub pa'i de bzhin nyid tsam du zad pa gang yin pa de la ni chos nyid kyi gzugs zhes bya'o zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ brgyad stong don bsdur yang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin par ni// brten pa gsum la yang dag brten// brtags pa dang ni gzhan dbang dang*// yongs su grub pa kho na 'o// zhes mdor bstan nas/ med ces bya sogs tshig gis ni// brtags pa thams cad 'gog pa ste// sgyu ma la sogs dpe rnams kyis// gzhan gyi dbang ni yang dag bstan/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par byang ba dang*/ dri med de bzhin nyid dri ma med pa'i rnam par byang ba dang*/ lam gyi dmigs pa sher phyin dmigs pa'i rnam par byang ba dang*/ de dag gi rgyu mthun pa'i tshes bstan pa rgyu mthun pa'i rnam par byang bas te/ rnam par byang ba bzhi yis ni// yongs su grub par rab tu bsgrags// zhes rgyas par bshad cing*/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyis ngo bo nyid gsum las gzhan bstan med// ces mtha' gzhan bkag nas don bsdus te bstan pa'i phyir dang*/

dbu ma snang bar yang*/ dbu ma pa rnams kyang ngo bo nyid gsum rnam par gzhag pa khas mi len pa ni ma yin te/ gzhan du na mthong ba la sogs pa dang 'gal ba ci ltar spong bar 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma rgyan du yang*/ rang bzhin gsum du smra ba ni dbu ma'o// yang gang zhig thams cad rdzun pa nyid du smra ba de dag ni dbu ma pa ltar snang ba yin no zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher yang gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'di dag gis ni/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ dgongs pa nges 'grel dang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ dbus mtha' dang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa la sogs pa rnams ngo bo nyid gsum ston pa'i phyir sems tsam gyi gzhung yin no zhes smra ba'i 'khrul (493) pa yang bsal ba yin te/ de rnams su gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam kun brtags kyis stong pa'i yongs grub la sogs pa gnas skabs sems tsam pa dang mthun pa'i ngo bo nyid gsum yang gsungs mod/ mthar thug chos kyi dbyings bdag mtha' dag gis stong pa'i yongs grub la sogs pa dbu ma pa bzhed pa'i ngo bo nyid gsum brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i phyir ro// ci ste gnas skabs su sems tsam pa bstan pas sems tsam gyi rang gzhung du 'gyur na ni/ yum dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs par yang nyan thos kyi theg pa bstan pa'i phyir nyan thos kyi gzhung du ha cang thal bar 'gyur te de ltar yang ma yin no// 'jug tshul ni gzhi bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs shes par 'dod pas kun brtags gzung 'dzin la sogs pa med pa la med pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ gzhan dbang 'khrul pa'i rten kun rtog tsam de nyid spang bar bya zhing*/ yongs grub chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa glo bur gyi dri ma las rnam par sbyang bar bya ste/ rgyan las/ rtag tu gnyis bral gzhan dbang 'khrul pa'i rten gang yin dang yongs grub gang zhig rnam kun tu// brjod par nus ma yin zhing spros pa med pa'i bdag nyid de kho na// dang po/ shes bya gnyis pa spang bya gsum pa rang bzhin dri med 'dod gang rnam par sbyang bya ste// de ni nam mkha' gser dang chu ltar nyon mongs pa las kun brtags rnam dag 'dod// ces pa ltar ro// de yang yongs grub nam mkha' dang gser dang chu ltar rang bzhin gyis dag pa bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin yang glo bur gyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs la ni 'khor ba zhes bya zhing*/

kun brtags dang gzhan dbang gis bsdus pa'i dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i mngon sum du gyur pa la ni myang (494) ngan las 'das pa zhes kyang rig par bya ste/ dbus mthar/ kun nas nyon mongs rnam par dag /de ni dri bcas dri ma med// chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams// dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod// ces pa ltar ro// de bas na chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa chos can kun rdzob thams cad kyi rang bzhin du yod kyang*/ mngon sum du ma gyur gyi bar la byis pa rnams 'khrul pa la longs spyod cing*/ rim gyis mngon du gyur pa las ni 'phags pa rnams yang dag pa mthong ba zhes bya ste/ rgyan las/ 'gro ba dag na de las gzhan pa'ang cung zad yod min la// 'gro ba ma lus pa yang de la kun tu rmongs pa'i blos// yod pa kun nas spangs te med la mngon zhen gang yin pa// 'jig rten rmongs pa'i rnam pa tshabs chen 'di ko ji lta bu// zhes pa dang*/ byis pa yang dag nyid bsgribs nas// yang dag ma yin kun tu snang*// byang chub sems dpa' de bsal nas// yang dag nyid ni kun tu snang*// zhes pa ltar ro// lam zab mo nyams su blang bar 'dod pas kyang kun brtags yongs su shes nas gzhan dbang spang bar byas la yongs grub mngon sum du thob par bya ste/ dbus mthar/ yongs su shes nas spong ba dang*// thob pa mngon sum bya bas ni// lam gyi bden pa yang dag bshad// ces pa ltar ro// 'bras bu sku gsum thob par 'dod pas kyang kun brtags shes shing gzhan dbang spangs nas yongs grub dag pa gnyis ldan mngon sum du bya ste/ klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i mdor/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i sgor/ ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum po// yongs su shes kyi yang dag pas// sku gsum po dag 'thob 'gyur te// de phyir de dag de yis bsdus// zhes pa ltar ro// gzhung don ni/ yang mtshan nyid gsum dang sbyar na stong pa nyid rnam pa

(495) gsum ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid dang*/ snang tsam du yod kyang de bzhin du don la yod pa ma yin pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ nam yang gzhan du mi 'gyur ba rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid do// de la dang pos ni kun brtags pa'i ngo bo nyid nye bar gzung bar blta ste/ de ni rang gi mtshan nyid kho nas rnam pa gang gis kyang gtan med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'o// gnyis pas ni gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid nye bar gzung bar blta ste/ de ni ji ltar snang ba de bzhin du dpyad na yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'o// gsum pas ni yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid nye bar gzung bar blta ste/ de ni bdag mtha' dag gis stong pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'o// de dag kyang lung rnam par dag pa rnams las shin tu gsal te/ ji skad du/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par grub par/ ngas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum la dgongs nas ngo bo nyid gsum du gsungs so zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma snang bar yang*/ ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum gyi dgongs pa bstan pas/ dbu ma'i lam mtha' gnyis dang bral bar rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ nges pa'i don kho na gzhung 'dzugs par mdzad pa yin no zhes pa dang*/ dbus mthar yang*/ dngos med de yi dngos min dang*// rang bzhin gyis ni stong par 'dod// ces pa dang*/ rgyan las kyang*/ med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing*// de bzhin yod min stong nyid dang*// rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes na// stong pa shes pa zhes brjod do// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar stong pa nyid kyi dbye ba gsum bstan nas/ slar yang rnam dbye la mkhas pa'i don du/ rgyas par phye na stong pa nyid bcu drug ni/ nang dang phyi dang phyi nang chen po dang*// stong nyid don dam

(496) 'dus byas 'dus ma byas// mtha' 'das thog mtha' dor med rang bzhin dang*// rang mtshan chos kun dngos med ngo bo nyid// ces bar skabs kyi sdom du byas nas/ zab po mig la sogs pa nang gi skye mched rnams kyi stong pa ni nang stong pa nyid dang*/ bza' bar bya ba gzugs la sogs pa phyi'i skye mched rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid dang*/ phyi nang gi skye mched de dag gi lus sam khog pa'i stong pa ni phyi nang stong pa nyid dang*/ gnas kyi gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten rgya chen po'i stong pa ni chen po stong pa nyid dang*/ nang gi skye mched la sogs pa de yang gang gis stong par bsam zhing shes pa'i stong pa ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ ji ltar don dam pa'i rnam par mthong ba de'i stong pa ni don dam pa stong pa nyid dang*/ byang chub sems dpas bsgrub par bya ba lam gyi dge ba 'dus byas kyi stong pa ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge ba 'dus ma byas kyi stong pa ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang*/ phan gdags par bya ba'i sems can mtha' yas pa'i stong pa ni mtha' las 'das pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ blos mi gtang bar bya ba 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa'i stong pa ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ lhag med kyi myang 'das su yang dge ba mi zad par bya ba'i stong pa ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ rigs rang bzhin gyis dag pa dri mas kyang dag par bya ba'i stong pa ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang*/ thob par bya ba mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyi stong pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ dag par bya ba sangs rgyas kyi chos stobs la sogs pa'i stong pa ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang*/ de ltar stong pa nyid bcu bzhi po rnams kyi mtshan nyid mdor bsdu na/ kun rdzob glo bur (497) gyi dri ma gang zag dang chos kyi bdag mtha' dag gi dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang*/

don dam pa chos kyi dbyings bdag mtha' dag gis stong pa de'i ngo bor yod pa ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de/ dbus mthar/ za po bza' ba de yi lus// gnas kyi gzhi yi stong pa nyid// de yang gang gis ji ltar mthong*// gang phyir de yang stong pa nyid// dge gnyis thob par bya ba'i phyir// rtag tu sems can phan bya'i phyir// 'khor ba gtang bar mi bya'i phyir// dge ba mi zad bya ba'i phyir// rigs kyang rnam par dag bya'i phyir// mtshan dang dpe byad thob bya'i phyir// sangs rgyas chos rnams dag bya'i phyir// byang chub sems dpa' sgrub par byed// gang zag dang ni chos rnams kyi// dngos po med 'dir stong pa nyid// de dngos med pa'i dngos yod pa// de ni de las stong nyid gzhan// zhes pa ltar yin la/ sngags mtshan nyid nges don gcig pa'i phyir/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal yang dag par sbyor bar yang zab mo stong pa nyid kyi dbye ba 'di ji lta ba bzhin du gsungs so// gzhung gzhan du dus gsum gyi stong pa ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang*/ 'du 'phro las byung ba'i stong pa ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de bco brgyad du yang phye la/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ phung po lnga'i stong pa ni dngos po stong pa nyid dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyi stong pa ni gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid de nyi shur yang bshad do// de ltar bdag don gzhan dang bral ba'i stong pa bshad nas/ rang gi ngo bo bdag ma yin par ston pa la/ bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ lan la/ bdag gi mtshan nyid med tshul/ de la dgongs pa'i shes byed/ 'phros pa'i lung don (498) bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ ji ltar phyi rol pa rnams dang*/ nang pa yin yang gnas ma bu pa la sogs pa bdag rdzas yod du smra ba rnams kyis bdag tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid rtag gcig rang dbang can nam/ phung po las de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa la sogs pa bkod pa des gzhi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams ni chos bdag gi mtshan nyid dang bral bas bdag ma yin pa'o zhes pa ste/

de dag ni mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i phyir ro// de lta bas na phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams ni bdag gi mtshan nyid dang*/ mi mthun pa nyid kyis bdag med pa'o// gnyis pa/ shes byed ni/ chos thams cad phung po khams skye mched gsum du 'du zhing de dag la bdag med pa 'di la dgongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad bdag med pa'o zhes gsungs so// gsum pa/ lung don la/ mdo bkod de dri ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di dag thams cad ni nga'i ba'am bdag ma yin pa'o// 'di ni nga'am bdag ma yin pa ste/ chos 'di rnams ni bdag dang bdag gi ba med pa 'di bzhin no zhes yul can yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis yul bdag med pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o zhes pa 'di'i don ci yin/ bdag dang bdag gi ba bkag pas dgag bya thams cad khegs mod/ tshig gsum pa smos pa'i dgongs pa gang yin zhe na/ de lan gyis bshad pa ni/ shes par byed pa po'i rgyud la phyi rol gyi dngos po zin pa dang ma zin pa 'di ni dpyad na bdag gis dbang bsgyur bar bya ba ma yin pas nga'i ba med pa'o// nang gi dngos po rang gi lus 'di ni bdag tu bden par ma grub pas nga ma yin pa'o// dgag bya de dag tu zad kyang*/ slar yang nang gi (499) dngos po 'di ni nga'i ba dang 'brel ba'i bdag ma yin no zhes bya bar dgongs nas tshig gsum pa gsungs pa ste/ des na 'di ltar phyi'i dngos po la ni bdag tu mi 'dzin pas bdag gi ba'i rnam pa gcig pu dang*/ nang la ni gnyis kar 'dzin srid pas bdag dang bdag gi ba'i rnam pa gnyis ka bkag go /de dag la 'phros pa las/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid las 'phros pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ gzugs can skad cig mar bsgrub pa dang*/ zhar byung gzugs can la dpyad pa'o// dang po ni/ skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid ni mi rtag pa nyid do zhes mdo las gang gsungs zhing 'dir yang sngar bstan pa de ji lta bu zhe na/

gnas ma bu pa'i sde pa la sogs pa gzugs mi rtag par 'dod kyang skad cig mar mi 'dod pas de dag gi don du/ dpe ji ltar na sems dang sems las byung ba skad cig ma yin par 'jig rten na'ang grags shing sde pa de dag kyang 'dod pa de ltar/ don gzugs kyang skad cig ma yin par blta ste/ tshor ba 'byung ba'i gnas kyi gzugs ni sems skad cig ma nyid kyis zin pa'i phyir dang de yang sems dang ma thob pa las thob pa'i grub pa dang thob pa rjes su 'jug pa'i bde ba gcig pa'i phyir te/ sems dang bcas na lus rnal mar gnas shing med na lus rul ba la sogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ sems bde sdug dang chags sdang la sogs pas skad cig re re zhing 'gyur na lus de yang 'gyur bar snang ba'i phyir dang*/ dbang po dang bcas pa'i lus ni sems kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir te rang skad cig gis mi 'jig na 'jig pa'i gnas su mi rung ba'i phyir dang*/ phyi nang gi gzugs thams cad sems kyi bag chags kyi dbang gis byung (500) ba'i phyir te rgyu skad cig ma'i 'bras bu rtag par 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ rnam thar dang zad par la sogs pa mthu khyad par can thob pa'i sems skad cig mas sa la sogs pa'ang gser la sogs pa ji ltar mos pa bzhin du dbang sgyur ba'i phyir te/ skad cig ma ma yin na ni bsgyur bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro// yang gzhon nu las rgan po dang gsar pa las rnying pa la sogs pa mthar 'gyur bar snang ba'i phyir dang*/ dang por mi 'jig mthar mi 'gyur// zhes pa ltar dang po nas skad cig gis mi 'jig na mthar 'gyur ba 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ dngos po thams cad ni rgyu rkyen las skyes tsam nyid nas kyang 'jig byed phyir 'byung gi rkyen gzhan la mi ltos par/ rang gi ngang gis skad cig gis rnam par 'jig pa'i phyir/ phyi nang gi gzugs thams cad kyang skad cig ma nyid du grub par blta'o// gnyis pa/ zhar byung la gnyis las/

dang po/ gzugs rgyu 'bras la dpyad pa ni/ gzugs gang yin pa ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad kyang rgyu'i gzugs la 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag tshang ba dang*/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag rgyur byas pa 'bras bu'i gzugs la'ang 'byung gyur thams cad tshang ba'o zhes gang mdo las gsungs shing 'dir yang bstan pa de ci la dgongs nas gsungs zhe na/ sngar bstan pa ltar bye brag tu smra ba ni byed las la dpags nas khyab pa'i don du 'dod cing*/ mdo sde pa ni sa bon tsam tshang ba la dgongs par 'dod mod/ 'dir theg chen pa'i lugs kyis thams cad tshang ba srid pa la dgongs nas de skad ces gsungs so// 'byung ba'i phyogs sam yul gcig la brten pa'i dngos po'i don ni rgyur byas pa 'bras bu'i gzugs kyi don te/ 'byung ba ni 'byung gyur gyis brten pa'i rgyu yin pas/ 'byung (501) ba'i phyogs gang yin pa de kho na 'byung gyur gyi phyogs kyang yin zhing*/ 'byung ba las logs su 'byung gyur la rang dbang du 'jug pa'i mthu med pa'i phyir ro// de bas na rgyu'i gzugs 'dus pa gang las byung ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid can gang dmigs pa de ni de na yod kyi/ gang ma dmigs pa de ni med do zhes brjod par bya'o// de yang 'di ltar 'byung ba gcig las gyur pa'i 'dus pa yang yod de/ sa rdog skam po lta bu'o// 'byung ba gnyis las gyur pa yang yod de/ de nyid gsher ba lta bu'o// 'byung ba gsum las gyur pa yang yod de/ de nyid dro ba lta bu nas/ 'byung ba bzhi po thams cad las gyur pa yang yod de/ de nyid 'dril zhing 'gro ba lta bu nyid do// de bzhin du 'byung ba bzhi rgyur byas pa las byung ba 'bras bu'i gzugs la yang*/ rgyur byas pa'i 'bras bu'i gzugs 'dus pa gang la dmigs pa de ni de na yod kyi/ ma dmigs pa de ni med do zhes kyang rig par bya ste/ 'di ltar gzugs gcig ldan pa ni 'od lta bu dang*/

gnyis dang ldan pa ni sgra dri dang bcas pa'i rlung lta bu dang*/ gsum dang ldan pa ni gzugs dang dri dang reg bya yang ba can gyi du ba lta bu dang*/ bzhi dang ldan pa ni gzugs dang dri ro reg bya 'dus pa bu ram gyi gong bu lta bu dang*/ lnga dang ldan pa ni de nyid sgra dang bcas pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa/ rdul phra rab la dpyad pa ni mdo las/ rdul phra rab bsags pa ni gzugs 'dus pa'o zhes gang brjod pa de la/ rtsom byed rdul phra rab ni/ nyi shu par/ rags pa rtsom pa'i dus su rdul/ drug gis gcig car sbyar ba na// phra rab rdul phyogs cha drug tu 'gyur/ bas cha med du 'gal lo// drug po rnams ni go gcig nas sbyor na// brtsams pa'i/ gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa'i rigs pas (502) dpyad na lus sam rang gi ngo bo nyid rdzas su grub pa med par rig par bya'o// 'on kyang gong bu la blos ji tsam cha shas su bshig cing dbye bar nus pa de tsam du mthar rab tu phye nas gzugs kyi chung mtha' la rdul phra rab ces bya ba nyid du grub mthas brtags nas rnam par bzhag pa tsam ste/ don la med kyang de ltar bzhag pa'i dgos pa ni 'di thams cad gzugs gcig go zhes ril por 'dzin pa'i 'du shes rnam par gzhig cing gang zag gi bdag med la 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs rnams rdul phra rab tu bshigs nas de'ang med par bstan pas gzugs rdzas su bden par yongs grub med par rtogs te rnam rig la 'jug cing*/ mthar de yang med pas chos kyi bdag med la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir ro// sdug bsngal las 'phros pa la/ sdug bsngal thun mong gi dbye ba dang*/ 'chi ba sdug bsngal gyi khyad par ro// dang po la// gnyis las dang po/ dbye ba ni/ yang sdug bsngal 'di ni thams cad tshang bas shin tu rgyas la gnyen pos ma bsrabs pa dang*/ rgyas la gnyen pos bsrabs pa dang*/

rgyas la re zhig bsrabs pa yang yin la/ gtan nas ma bsrabs pa yang yin pa yang yod/ sdug bsngal bar ma gnyen po zag med kyis ma bsrabs pa yang yod/ sdug bsngal bsrabs pa la gnyen po zag med kyis ma bsrabs pa yang yod/ sdug bsngal phal cher zad pas ches bsrabs la bsrabs pa yang yod/ sdug bsngal rtsa ba nas zad pas shin tu ches bsrabs la bsrabs pa yang yod/ ngo bo sdug bsngal ma yin la 'phral du sdug bsngal du snang zhing gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel bas bsrabs pa chen po nye bar gnas pa yang yod do// gnyis pa/ ngo bo la sdug bsngal shin tu rgyas la ma bsrabs pa gang zhe na/ gang 'dod pa na spyod pa'i so so skye bo dge ba'i rtsa ba zag bcas dang zag (503) med gang yang ma bsags pa rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal te/ de ni 'gro ba lnga dang skye gnas bzhi dang*/ sdug bsngal gsum la sogs pa thams cad tshang bas shin tu rgyas shing*/ gnyen po gang gis kyang ma bsrabs pa'o// rgyas la bsrabs pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa na spyod pas shin tu rgyas pa de nyid thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i lam rgyud la skyes pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal te/ gnyen pos myang ngan las 'da' nges su byas pas bsrabs pa'o// shin tu rgyas la bsrabs pa yang yin la ma bsrabs pa'ang yin pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa na spyod pa'i de nyid 'jig rten pa'i lam bsgoms pas 'dod chags dang bral ba nyid du bya ba'i phyir bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal te/ re zhig sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa las 'da' bas bsrabs pa'ang yin la/ gtan du 'gro ba ma yin pas ma bsrabs pa'ang yin pa'o// bar ma ma bsrabs pa gang zhe na/ gzugs kyi khams su skyes pa'i so so skye bo thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par spangs pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal te/ de ni 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das pas bar ma yin la/ gnyen po zag med dang bral bas ma bsrabs pa'o// bsrabs la ma bsrabs pa gang zhe na/

gzugs med par skyes pa'i byis pa thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba rnams par spangs pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal te/ de'ang 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das pas bsrabs pa yin la/ gnyen po zag med dang bral bas ma bsrabs pa'o// ches bsrabs la bsrabs pa gang zhe na/ gang 'phags pa slob pa srid pa lan bdun la sogs pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal te/ de dag ni ngan 'gro dang sgong skyes dang drod gsher skyes la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ches bsrabs par gyur pa'o// (504) shin tu ches bsrabs la bsrabs pa gang zhe na/ gang phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i mi slob pa rnams kyi tshe de nyid kyi srog gi dbang po ma 'gags pa'i rkyen gyi ming bzhi dang gzugs so// zhes pa nyer len gyi phung po dag lhag mar lus pa ste/ de rnams 'gags pa na slar mi 'byung bas shin tu ches bsrabs pa'o// sdug bsngal yang ma yin la sdug bsngal du snang zhing bsrabs pa chen po nye bar gnas pa gang zhe na/ gang byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa sa bcu sa dang po sbyin pa la sogs pa rnams su dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu thob pa rnams kyis sems can du ma'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bsal ba'i ched du gzhan snang la sdug bsngal gyi rnam par bstan pa rnams te/ de dag ni bsam bzhin srid par skye ba blangs nas lus dang yan lag sbyin pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal bar snang yang las dang nyon mongs pa las grol bas sdug bsngal gyi nyes pa med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la lnga las/ gnyis pa/ 'chi sems kyi dbye ba bstan pa ni/ 'chi ba sdug bsngal lo zhes mdo las gang gsungs shing 'dir yang sngar bstan pa de la/ tshe dang dbang po rnams dang srog /'gags pa 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid de// 'chi ba slu ba'i/ thabs kyis yun ring 'tsho ba ni// 'chi ba slu ba zhes bshad do// zhes pa ltar srog 'gag pa'i 'chi ba ni rnam pa gsum ste/
