thugs rje nyid las 'khor bar khyod// yun ring nyon mongs 'ba' zhig go /zhes pa ltar gzhan don du yun ring por dka' ba spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams kyis rab tu nyon mongs par byas te/ sgom lam yongs su rdzogs pa las// byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes bsgyur nas bshad dgos pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa spang bya sdom gnyis kyi 'grel bar drangs gnyen por bsgyur ba'i ldem dgongs la/ gnyis las dang po/ sbyin pa'i dbang du byas pa ni/ yang ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' chos lnga dang ldan na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ lnga gang zhe na/ dngos kyi don/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna'i chos nyid 'phel bar byed pa dang*/ sbyin pas yongs su skyo ba dang*/ slong ba la tshig pa za ba dang*/ res 'ga' cung zad sbyin par mi byed pa dang*/ sbyin pa las ring du gyur pa'o zhes gsungs kyang*/ dgongs pa'i don ni/ ser sna bag chags dang bcas pa spangs nas/ de'i chos nyid de bzhin nyid gnas gyur pa mngon sum du 'phel bar byed pa dang*/ yun ring por sbyin pa'i ched du lus dang rgyal srid la sogs pa gtong ba'i dka' spyad rgya chen pos yongs su ngal zhing skyo skyo ltar byed pa dang*/ bdog pa thams cad gzhan la btang zin pas bslang ci dgos khyer bas chog mod snyam du slong ba la tshig pa za ba dang*/ dus res 'gar dngos po cung zad tsam sbyin par mi byed kyi/ dus rtag tu dngos po thams cad sbyin par byed pa dang*/ nye ba la sbyin pa dang*/ khe dang grags pa'i ched du sbyin pa la sogs pa ma dag pa'i sbyin pa rnams las ring (904) du gyur pa'o zhes bsgyur nas bshad dgos pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa tshangs spyod kyi dbang du byas pa ni/ yang ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' chos lnga dang ldan na tshangs par spyod pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhing*/

tshangs par spyod pa'i mchog 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam dang ldan pa yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ dngos kyi don/ 'khrig pa las gzhan du 'khrig pa las nges par 'byung ba mi tshol zhing 'khrig pa spyod pa dang*/ 'khrig pa spong ba la g.yel zhing btang snyoms su byed pa dang*/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags skyed pa dwang du len zhing bsten pa dang*/ 'khrig pa'i gnyen po'i chos mi sdug pa sgom pa la sogs pa rnams kyis skrag pa dang*/ rgyun mi 'chad par pho mo gnyis kyis dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'o zhes gsungs kyang*/ dgongs pa'i don ni/ rgyan las/ chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa// gang phyir chos med de yi phyir// sangs rgyas rnams kyis de rnams las// nges 'byung chags sogs yin par dgongs// zhes pa ltar 'khrig pa'i chos nyid las gzhan du 'khrig pa las nges par 'byung ba mi tshol zhing*/ de'i de bzhin nyid yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pas spong ba dang*/ g.yel ba ni u pek+ṣa zhes pa ste de nges tshig gi bshad na/ u pa ya thabs dang*/ ī k+ṣa ṇaṃ rtog pa yin pas/ 'khrig pa spong ba'i thabs la legs par rtog pa dang*/ dwang du len pa ni ā dhi wā pa na zhes pa ste de yang ā dh+yād adamand/ dang pra wā panamra phyi rol yin pas/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags nang du skyes pa phyi rol tu spong bar byed pa dang*/ skrag pa ni u tra s+ya zhes pa ste de yang u dra tā ra ṇā ya bsgral ba'i ched dang*/ byā ba s+ya ti rtsol ba yin pas/ 'khrig pa spong byed gnyen po'i chos kyis sems (905) can thams cad bsgral ba'i ched du brtson par byed pa dang*/ rgyun mi 'chad par zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis kyis nyon mongs rnam byang rgyu 'bras kyis phye ba'i bden pa bzhi rtogs pa'i don du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis la sbyor zhing*/ snyoms par 'jug pa'o zhes bsgyur nas bshad dgos pa lta bu'o// chos mngon pa kun las btus pa las/

'bel gtam rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba ste kun las btus pa lnga pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// ༈ //mtshan gyi nges tshig gis bsdus pa la/ gnyis las dang po/ dri ba ni/ de ltar legs par bshad zin pa'i bstan bcos 'di rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir chos mngon pa kun las btus pa zhes bya zhe na/ gnyis pa/ lan ni sa mu ts+tsha ya zhes pa nges tshig gis bshad na/ rtsom pa po phal pas btus pa ma yin gyi/ sa me t+ya rtogs nas/ uñtsa ya btus pa ste/ 'phags pas don dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud nas legs par btus pa'i phyir ro// de yang phyogs re tsam ston pa ma yin gyi/ sa man ta dra kun nas te/ chos mngon pa'i mdo la sogs pa gzhung mngon pa'i sde snod mtha' yas pa kun nas bsam par nus shing*/ bsams pa las phan yon yod pa bsam bya'i gnas thams cad btus nas bstan pa'i phyir ro// brtsams pa la phan yon med pa ma yin gyi samyag yang dag par uñtsa twa mthong ba nyid kyi a ya ta na mra gnas te 'di las 'byung ba ltar shes rab gsum goms par byas nas blang dor nyams su blangs na/ phyin ci ma log pa'i thabs kyis 'bras bu mngon par sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar thob par byed pa'i gzhi'am gnas mchog tu gyur (906) pa yin pa'i phyir ro// de lta bas na/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag spangs te thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba chen po thob par 'dod pa'i blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ de'i lam zab mo bsgom pa la 'khrul pa spang ba'i ched du/ rnam par dag pa'i gzhung lugs 'di lta bu la thos pa dang*/ bsam pas tshul bzhin du 'jug par bya ba nyid do// dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa slob dpon chen po 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so zhes kyang bya ste/ tshig don mtha' dag gsal bar bshad zin to// //don de legs par bsgyur ba'i tshul ni/ bstan bcos 'di nyid slob dpon gyis legs par sbyar ba'i skad du brtsams shing rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na gnas pa las/

sngon skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bod kyi yul du'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i dus su/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra ste rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ shī len dra bo dhi ste tshul khrims dbang po'i byang chub dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban dhe zhang sna nam ye shes sdes rgya gar gyi dpe las bod kyi skad du bsgyur cing zhus dag kyang mdzad de/ 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab nas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad pa'o// //rab 'byams gsung rab rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur rnam dag gzhung gi rnam bshad 'di// rgyal dang rgyal sras gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnam dag lung dang rigs pa dang*// blo gros gsal ldan brtan pa'i thugs mnga' 'dren pa mchog gi legs bshad sogs// dam pa rnams kyi gsung la brten nas don gnyer rnams la phan phyir bkod/ 1 /ji ltar dkar gsal gangs kyi ri bo yang*// zla ba'i 'od kyis ches gsal 'gyur ba bzhin// rnam dag (907) gzhung 'di mchog tu gsal mod kyang*// rnam bshad 'dis kyang shin tu gsal bar bgyis/ 2 /gzhung 'di sngon gyi dam pa mang po'i rnam 'grel dag gis rim par bshad mod de lta na'ang*// gzhung rnams ma lus yongs su rdzogs shing gsal ba'i tshig gis bde blag nyid du rtogs bya'i phyir// bsod nams chen po'i dpal 'byor dang ldan gdan sar gnas sogs bshes gnyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor// legs par bsams te 'bad pas bsdebs mod nyes pa mchis na dam pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ 3 /ji ltar mkha' la mkha' lding bgrod pa ltar// 'dab chags gzhan yang 'gro ba ji bzhin du// mkhas mchog rnams kyis legs bshad spel ba ltar// bdag kyang legs bshad 'chad la spro bar gyur/ 4 /rnyed la brkams zhing sdig grogs dang ldan log pa'i nga rgyal la brten pa'i// dman pa mchog 'dzin gzu lum can dag rnam bshad 'di yis mgu dka' mod// gnas lugs rtogs nas phyogs 'dzin spangs te rnam dag gzhung 'di 'chad 'dod pa'i// skal bzang dang ldan dam pa'i tshogs kun legs bshad 'dis kyang dgyes par mdzod/

5 /ji ltar nor bu rin chen mchog la yang*// lta mi shes pa'i mi rnams mi mgu zhing*// rtog mkhas ded dpon mchog rnams mgu ba ltar// chos tshul 'di la'ang de bzhin 'gyur ba nyid/ 6 /blo gros yangs pa'i mkha' las legs 'ongs rnam bshad nyin byed 'od zer gyis// dam chos mngon pa'i pad tshal yid 'ong rnam par phye ba las byung ba'i// zab cing rgya che'i ro mchog dang ldan legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'dis// blo ldan don gnyer rkang drug ldan rnams phan bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig 7 /tshul 'di bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin las// (908) mang du thos shing rnam dpyod gsal ldan pa'i// blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis rnam par sbyar// dge bas 'gro kun kun mkhyen myur thob shog 8 /dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i rnam par bshad pa shes bya rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa/ bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyis nye bar sbyar ba dge ldan sa bzangs su legs par grub pa'o// bstan pa rin po che dang sems can mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// //mngon pa'i mdo ni rgyal bas rgyal tshab la// gsungs shing de yis rgyal sras thogs med la'o// bstan bcos 'di ni thogs med dbyig gnyen dang*// blo brtan gang ba spel las rim brgyud de// dzi na mi tras ka cog zhang gsum la'o// de rnams kyis ni nam nang zla ba'i rdo rje dang*// lha lung */dpal gyi rdo rje dpa' rgyal ba'i ye shes gsum ka la'o// de nas rgyal ba'i ye shes dang gru mchog gi ye shes la'o// de nas rim bzhin gzhon nu dbang phyug dang*// 'gar mi yon tan khu ston g.yung drung brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang*// khri bzang 'bar ra rgyal tshul seng li chos grags gsum dar ma snying po dang*// ye 'byung 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje dang tho ston dang ston skyabs dang*// 'jad pa gzhon byang 'bri mtshams se bcun zhang dang ni// bo dong rin rtse stag sde seng rgyal dang*// mkhas chen blo gros brtan pa las brgyud de// sa bzangs paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag la gnang ba'o//
